abandon.example: The doctors refused to abandon hope for the patient.
abandon.example_zh: 醫生們拒絕對病人放棄希望。

abandoned.example: The abandoned clinic stood empty for years.
abandoned.example_zh: 那間廢棄的診所空置了多年。

abate.example: The storm finally began to abate, and the winds grew calmer.
abate.example_zh: 暴風雨終於開始減弱，風勢漸漸平靜下來。

aberrant.example: Doctors removed the tumor caused by the aberrant growth of cells.
aberrant.example_zh: 醫師切除了由細胞異常增生所造成的腫瘤。

ability.example: Years of training gave her the ability to diagnose rare diseases.
ability.example_zh: 多年的訓練讓她具備診斷罕見疾病的能力。

aboard.example: A nurse was aboard the flight in case of emergency.
aboard.example_zh: 一名護理師隨機，以防緊急狀況。

abroad.example: She joined a medical expedition abroad after training.
abroad.example_zh: 受訓後她參加了一支海外醫療團。

absence.example: In the absence of fever, she was sent home.
absence.example_zh: 由於沒有發燒，她被送回家。

absent.example: The patient was absent from his appointment.

absolute.example: There is no absolute guarantee that the drug will work.
absolute.example_zh: 沒有絕對的保證說這種藥一定有效。

absolutely.example: It is absolutely essential to finish the course.
absolutely.example_zh: 把療程服完是絕對必要的。

absorb.example: The kidneys filter the blood and absorb what the body needs.
absorb.example_zh: 腎臟過濾血液，並吸收身體所需。

abstract.example: The lecture stayed abstract until she illustrated it with a real case.
abstract.example_zh: 這場講課一直很抽象，直到她用真實案例加以說明。

absurd.example: It seemed absurd to wait weeks for a simple test.
absurd.example_zh: 為一項簡單的檢查等上數週似乎很荒謬。

abundance.example: There was an abundance of fresh fruit at the market.
abundance.example_zh: 市場上有大量的新鮮水果。

abundant.example: The region has an abundant supply of clean water.
abundant.example_zh: 這個地區有充足的乾淨水源。

abuse.example: Long-term abuse of painkillers can damage the liver.
abuse.example_zh: 長期濫用止痛藥會損害肝臟。

academic.example: She left academic research to practice medicine.
academic.example_zh: 她離開學術研究去行醫。

academy.example: She trained at a respected medical academy.
academy.example_zh: 她在一所受敬重的醫學院受訓。

accelerate.example: Stress can accelerate the progress of the disease.
accelerate.example_zh: 壓力會加速病情的進展。

access.example: Everyone deserves access to basic healthcare.
access.example_zh: 人人都應享有基本醫療的管道。

accessible.example: The new ramp made the clinic accessible to all.
accessible.example_zh: 新的坡道讓所有人都能進入診所。

accident.example: He broke his leg in a cycling accident.
accident.example_zh: 他在一場單車意外中摔斷了腿。

accidentally.example: She accidentally took a double dose of the pill.
accidentally.example_zh: 她不小心服用了雙倍劑量的藥丸。

accommodate.example: The new ward can accommodate twenty more beds.
accommodate.example_zh: 新病房可再容納二十張床。

accompany.example: A nurse will accompany you to the scan.
accompany.example_zh: 一名護理師會陪你去做掃描。

accomplice.example: The thief was caught, but his accomplice managed to escape.
accomplice.example_zh: 竊賊被抓到了，但他的共犯卻成功逃脫。

accomplish.example: He accomplished his goal of walking unaided.
accomplish.example_zh: 他達成了不靠協助行走的目標。

accomplishment.example: Walking the corridor was a real accomplishment for him.
accomplishment.example_zh: 走完這條走廊對他來說是項真正的成就。

accord.example: The two doctors were in full accord on the plan.
accord.example_zh: 兩位醫生對這項計畫完全一致。

account.example: The nurse gave a clear account of what happened.
account.example_zh: 護理師清楚地說明了事發經過。

accountability.example: Clear records ensure accountability in care.
accountability.example_zh: 清楚的紀錄確保了照護上的問責。

accountant.example: The clinic's accountant kept the books in order.
accountant.example_zh: 診所的會計把帳目管理得井井有條。

accounting.example: The clinic keeps careful accounting of its costs.
accounting.example_zh: 這間診所仔細記帳，控管費用。

accredit.example: Only hospitals that meet strict standards are accredited by the board.
accredit.example_zh: 只有符合嚴格標準的醫院才會獲得委員會的認證。

accumulate.example: Fluid began to accumulate in his lungs.

accumulated.example: Over the years, fatty deposits had accumulated in his arteries.
accumulated.example_zh: 多年來，脂肪沉積物在他的動脈中累積。

accuracy.example: The accuracy of the diagnosis was vital.
accuracy.example_zh: 診斷的準確性至關重要。

accurate.example: An accurate diagnosis depends on careful testing.
accurate.example_zh: 準確的診斷有賴於仔細的檢查。

accusation.example: The nurse denied the accusation of carelessness.
accusation.example_zh: 護理師否認了粗心的指控。

accuse.example: The patient accused the clinic of negligence.
accuse.example_zh: 病人指控這間診所疏忽。

achieve.example: With effort, she achieved her objective of walking again.
achieve.example_zh: 經過努力，她達成了重新走路的目標。

achievement.example: Walking again was a huge achievement for him.
achievement.example_zh: 重新走路對他來說是巨大的成就。

acid.example: Too much stomach acid can cause a painful ulcer.
acid.example_zh: 胃酸過多可能導致疼痛的潰瘍。

acknowledge.example: The doctor acknowledged that the diagnosis was wrong.

acquaintance.example: He is not a close friend, just a casual acquaintance.
acquaintance.example_zh: 他不是好友，只是個普通的點頭之交。

acquire.example: Patients can acquire infections during a long hospital stay.
acquire.example_zh: 病人在長期住院期間可能感染疾病。

acquisition.example: The hospital's acquisition of new scanners helped patients.
acquisition.example_zh: 醫院購置新掃描儀嘉惠了病人。

acre.example: The hospital sits on a ten-acre plot of land.
acre.example_zh: 這家醫院坐落在十英畝的土地上。

action.example: Quick action by the nurse saved his life.
action.example_zh: 護理師迅速的行動救了他一命。

activate.example: Warmth helps activate the healing cells.
activate.example_zh: 溫暖有助於啟動修復細胞。

active.example: An active lifestyle should consist of daily walking.
active.example_zh: 積極的生活方式應包含每日步行。

actively.example: She actively took part in her own recovery.
actively.example_zh: 她積極參與自己的康復。

actual.example: The actual cause turned out to be quite simple.
actual.example_zh: 真正的原因結果相當單純。

actually.example: The medicine actually tasted better than she feared.
actually.example_zh: 這藥其實比她擔心的好喝。

acute.example: He was rushed in with acute chest pain.
acute.example_zh: 他因急性胸痛被緊急送來。

adapt.example: The body slowly adapts to the high altitude.
adapt.example_zh: 身體會慢慢適應高海拔。

adaptation.example: Recovery requires slow adaptation to new limits.
adaptation.example_zh: 康復需要慢慢適應新的限制。

addict.example: He was once an addict but has been clean for years.
addict.example_zh: 他曾是個癮君子，但已戒了多年。

addition.example: In addition to new staff, the scanner is a real enhancement.
addition.example_zh: 除了新進人員，這台掃描儀更是一大提升。

additional.example: The doctor requested an additional blood test.
additional.example_zh: 醫師要求再做一次血液檢查。

additive.example: Many processed foods contain artificial additives to extend their shelf life.
additive.example_zh: 許多加工食品含有人工添加物，以延長保存期限。

address.example: The doctor acknowledged and addressed her fears one by one.
address.example_zh: 醫師逐一肯認並回應了她的恐懼。

adequate.example: The clinic had adequate supplies for the winter.
adequate.example_zh: 這間診所有足夠的物資撐過冬天。

adjacent.example: The recovery ward is adjacent to the operating room for quick access.
adjacent.example_zh: 恢復病房緊鄰手術室，方便快速進出。

adjust.example: The doctor adjusted the dose to suit her weight.
adjust.example_zh: 醫生調整劑量以配合她的體重。

adjustment.example: A small adjustment to the dose eased the side effects.
adjustment.example_zh: 劑量的小幅調整減輕了副作用。

administer.example: A nurse will administer the injection.
administer.example_zh: 一名護理師將施打這針。

administration.example: The drug's administration to children remains controversial.
administration.example_zh: 這種藥對兒童的給藥仍有爭議。

administrative.example: Excessive administrative interference pulls doctors away from their patients.
administrative.example_zh: 過多的行政干擾把醫師從病人身邊拉開。

administrator.example: The hospital administrator approved the budget.
administrator.example_zh: 醫院的行政主管批准了預算。

admire.example: The students admire her steady hands in surgery.
admire.example_zh: 學生們欽佩她手術時穩定的雙手。

admission.example: His admission to hospital was delayed by hours.
admission.example_zh: 他的住院被延誤了好幾個小時。

admit.example: Doctors decided to admit him overnight and watch his status.
admit.example_zh: 醫師決定讓他住院過夜，觀察他的狀況。

adolescent.example: The disorder is especially prevalent among adolescent girls.
adolescent.example_zh: 這種疾病在青春期少女中尤其普遍。

adopt.example: The hospital decided to adopt the new safety system.
adopt.example_zh: 醫院決定採用新的安全系統。

adoption.example: The adoption of the new rule cut infections.
adoption.example_zh: 採用這項新規定後感染減少了。

advance.example: Recent advances in medicine have saved countless lives.
advance.example_zh: 醫學近年的進展拯救了無數生命。

advanced.example: The hospital uses advanced imaging equipment.
advanced.example_zh: 這家醫院使用先進的影像設備。

adventure.example: For the children, the hospital stay became an adventure.
adventure.example_zh: 對孩子們來說，這趟住院成了一場冒險。

adversary.example: In the debate, she treated her adversary with respect.
adversary.example_zh: 在辯論中，她對對手以禮相待。

adverse.example: Report any adverse reaction to the drug at once.
adverse.example_zh: 對這種藥若有任何不良反應請立即回報。

advertise.example: The clinic does not advertise its services.
advertise.example_zh: 這間診所不為自己的服務打廣告。

advice.example: She quoted her doctor's advice word for word.
advice.example_zh: 她一字不差地引述了醫師的建議。

advise.example: The doctor advised her to modify her diet and rest.
advise.example_zh: 醫師建議她調整飲食並多休息。

advocacy.example: Her advocacy helped change the health law.
advocacy.example_zh: 她的倡議促成了衛生法的修改。

advocate.example: She is a tireless advocate for the most vulnerable patients.
advocate.example_zh: 她是最脆弱病人堅定不懈的擁護者。

advocates.example: She advocates a low-salt diet for all her heart patients.
advocates.example_zh: 她為所有心臟病患者提倡低鹽飲食。

aesthetic.example: The clinic was redesigned with aesthetic appeal in mind.
aesthetic.example_zh: 這間診所重新設計時考量了美感。

affair.example: Her illness became a family affair.
affair.example_zh: 她的病成了全家人共同面對的事。

affect.example: Lack of sleep can seriously affect your concentration.
affect.example_zh: 睡眠不足會嚴重影響你的專注力。

affected.example: The affected limb was swollen and painful to the touch.
affected.example_zh: 受影響的肢體又腫又痛，一碰就疼。

affection.example: She cared for him with great affection.
affection.example_zh: 她以深厚的情感照顧著他。

affiliation.example: The clinic has an affiliation with the city hospital.
affiliation.example_zh: 這間診所與市立醫院有合作關係。

affinity.example: Hemoglobin has a strong affinity for oxygen, allowing it to carry it in blood.
affinity.example_zh: 血紅素對氧氣有很強的親和力，因此能在血液中攜帶氧氣。

affirm.example: The test affirmed that she was healthy.
affirm.example_zh: 這項檢查確認了她很健康。

afflict.example: A rare disease afflicts thousands of children around the world each year.
afflict.example_zh: 一種罕見疾病每年折磨著全球數以千計的兒童。

affluent.example: She grew up in an affluent neighborhood where every house had a pool.
affluent.example_zh: 她在一個富裕的社區長大，家家戶戶都有泳池。

afford.example: Not everyone can afford private treatment.
afford.example_zh: 不是每個人都負擔得起私人治療。

affordable.example: The clinic offers affordable care to low-income families.
affordable.example_zh: 這間診所為低收入家庭提供負擔得起的照護。

aftermath.example: In the aftermath of the crash, medics rushed in.
aftermath.example_zh: 車禍發生後，醫護人員立刻趕到。

afterthought.example: The safety features seemed like an afterthought rather than a priority.
afterthought.example_zh: 那些安全措施看起來像是事後才補上的，而非首要考量。

age.example: The risk of the disease rises with age.
age.example_zh: 這種病的風險隨年齡上升。

agenda.example: Patient safety topped the meeting's agenda.
agenda.example_zh: 病人安全是這場會議議程的首要事項。

agent.example: Soap is a simple but powerful cleaning agent.
agent.example_zh: 肥皂是一種簡單卻強效的清潔劑。

aggression.example: The illness sometimes caused sudden aggression.
aggression.example_zh: 這種病有時會引發突然的攻擊性。

aggressive.example: The aggressive tumor proved lethal within months.
aggressive.example_zh: 這個侵襲性腫瘤在幾個月內就奪走性命。

aggrieved.example: The aggrieved family demanded a full investigation.
aggrieved.example_zh: 受委屈的家屬要求徹底調查。

agoraphobia.example: Her agoraphobia was so severe that she rarely left her apartment.
agoraphobia.example_zh: 她的廣場恐懼症嚴重到幾乎不敢踏出自己的公寓。

agriculture.example: Many of his patients work in agriculture.
agriculture.example_zh: 他的許多病人從事農業。

aim.example: The treatment's aim is to ease the pain.
aim.example_zh: 這項治療的目的是緩解疼痛。

air.example: Polluted air, full of harmful emissions, worsened her asthma.
air.example_zh: 充滿有害排放物的污濁空氣使她的氣喘惡化。

aircraft.example: An aircraft was used to transport the patient to the city.
aircraft.example_zh: 動用了一架飛機把病人運送到城裡。

alarm.example: The monitor's alarm woke the whole ward.
alarm.example_zh: 監測儀的警報吵醒了整個病房。

albeit.example: He recovered, albeit more slowly than hoped.
albeit.example_zh: 他康復了，儘管比預期的慢。

alert.example: The nurse stayed alert through the long night.
alert.example_zh: 護理師整個漫漫長夜都保持警覺。

alien.example: The hospital felt cold and alien at first.
alien.example_zh: 醫院起初讓人覺得冰冷又陌生。

align.example: The surgeon worked to align the broken bones.
align.example_zh: 外科醫生設法把斷骨接正。

aligned.example: The surgeon made sure the broken bones were properly aligned.
aligned.example_zh: 外科醫生確保斷骨正確接合對位。

alike.example: The two patients looked very much alike.
alike.example_zh: 這兩名病人長得非常相像。

allegation.example: The hospital denied the allegation of neglect.
allegation.example_zh: 醫院否認了疏於照顧的指控。

allege.example: The report alleged that the drug was unsafe.
allege.example_zh: 報告聲稱這種藥不安全。

alleviated.example: The new medication alleviated her chronic back pain within days.
alleviated.example_zh: 新藥在幾天內就減輕了她的慢性背痛。

alliance.example: An alliance of clinics shared the new equipment.
alliance.example_zh: 一個診所聯盟共用了這套新設備。

ally.example: Sleep is a powerful ally in healing.
ally.example_zh: 睡眠是癒合的強大盟友。

alone.example: The elderly man lives alone and rarely sees a doctor.
alone.example_zh: 這位老先生獨居，很少看醫生。

along.example: We walked along the river until we reached the clinic.
along.example_zh: 我們沿著河走，直到抵達診所。

alter.example: Stress can alter the way the heart beats.
alter.example_zh: 壓力會改變心臟跳動的方式。

alternate.example: Patients should alternate hot and cold compresses to reduce swelling.
alternate.example_zh: 病人應交替使用熱敷和冷敷以減輕腫脹。

alternative.example: When surgery failed, they looked for an alternative treatment.
alternative.example_zh: 手術失敗後，他們尋求替代療法。

altitude.example: At high altitude, the thin air can leave climbers short of breath.
altitude.example_zh: 在高海拔處，稀薄的空氣會讓登山者呼吸困難。

aluminum.example: The pills come in a sealed aluminum strip.
aluminum.example_zh: 這些藥丸裝在密封的鋁製泡殼裡。

amassed.example: Over decades he amassed a vast collection of rare medical texts.
amassed.example_zh: 數十年間他累積了大量珍稀的醫學典籍。

amateur.example: An amateur cook, he changed his diet with care.
amateur.example_zh: 身為業餘廚師，他細心地改變了飲食。

amazing.example: Her recovery was, quite literally, amazing.
amazing.example_zh: 她的康復可以說是名副其實地驚人。

ambient.example: The ambient temperature in the lab must be kept constant for the experiment.
ambient.example_zh: 實驗室的周遭環境溫度必須維持恆定，以利實驗進行。

ambiguity.example: The vague diagnosis left a lot of ambiguity about the next steps.
ambiguity.example_zh: 模糊的診斷讓後續步驟充滿了不確定性。

ambition.example: Her ambition was to open a rural hospital.
ambition.example_zh: 她的志向是開一家鄉村醫院。

ambitious.example: The hospital had an ambitious plan to expand.
ambitious.example_zh: 醫院有一項雄心勃勃的擴建計畫。

amendment.example: An amendment to the law improved patient rights.
amendment.example_zh: 這項法律修正案改善了病人的權益。

amid.example: The nurse stayed calm amid the chaos.
amid.example_zh: 在一片混亂中，護理師保持鎮定。

amnesty.example: The new government granted amnesty to all political prisoners.
amnesty.example_zh: 新政府對所有政治犯實施了大赦。

amount.example: Even a small amount of the drug can be dangerous.
amount.example_zh: 即使少量這種藥也可能危險。

ample.example: There was ample time to prepare for the surgery.
ample.example_zh: 有充裕的時間為手術做準備。

amputation.example: Severe diabetes can lead to amputation of the toes or even the foot.
amputation.example_zh: 嚴重的糖尿病可能導致腳趾甚至整隻腳的截肢。

analogy.example: The doctor used an analogy to explain the heart.
analogy.example_zh: 醫生用一個比喻來解釋心臟。

analysis.example: A blood analysis revealed a vitamin deficiency.
analysis.example_zh: 血液分析顯示出維生素缺乏。

analyze.example: The lab will analyze the sample for bacteria.
analyze.example_zh: 實驗室會分析這個樣本是否含有細菌。

anatomy.example: First-year students spend hours studying human anatomy.
anatomy.example_zh: 一年級學生花大量時間研讀人體解剖學。

ancestor.example: The disease ran in the family from a distant ancestor.
ancestor.example_zh: 這種病從遠祖開始就在家族中遺傳。

anchor.example: Hope was the anchor that kept her calm.
anchor.example_zh: 希望是讓她保持平靜的支柱。

anecdotal.example: Anecdotal evidence is interesting, but it cannot replace rigorous clinical trials.
anecdotal.example_zh: 個別軼事性的證據雖有趣，卻無法取代嚴謹的臨床試驗。

anesthetic.example: The dentist applied a local anesthetic before drilling the tooth.
anesthetic.example_zh: 牙醫在鑽牙之前先施打了局部麻醉劑。

angle.example: The X-ray was taken from a different angle.
angle.example_zh: X 光從另一個角度拍攝。

announce.example: The hospital announced new visiting hours.
announce.example_zh: 醫院公布了新的探病時間。

announcement.example: The hospital made an announcement about new rules.
announcement.example_zh: 醫院發布了關於新規定的公告。

annual.example: Don't skip your annual health check.

annually.example: Staff are screened for the disease annually.
annually.example_zh: 員工每年都會接受這種病的篩檢。

anonymous.example: Anonymous data prevents bias in the interpretation of results.
anonymous.example_zh: 匿名資料可避免在解讀結果時產生偏誤。

anonymously.example: The donor wished to give the money anonymously.
anonymously.example_zh: 這位捐贈者希望匿名捐出這筆錢。

anosmia.example: Anosmia, the loss of the sense of smell, was a common early symptom of COVID-19.
anosmia.example_zh: 嗅覺缺失（嗅覺喪失）是 COVID-19 常見的早期症狀。

anthropologist.example: An anthropologist studied the village's healing customs.
anthropologist.example_zh: 一位人類學家研究了這個村莊的治療習俗。

antibiotic.example: The doctor prescribed an antibiotic to clear the infection.
antibiotic.example_zh: 醫生開了抗生素來清除感染。

anticipate.example: Doctors could not yet anticipate the full magnitude of the outbreak.
anticipate.example_zh: 醫師當時還無法預料這場疫情的全面規模。

anticipation.example: In anticipation of flu season, they stocked up on vaccines.
anticipation.example_zh: 為了因應流感季，他們囤積了疫苗。

antique.example: An antique clock ticked in the waiting room.
antique.example_zh: 候診室裡一座古董鐘滴答作響。

anxiety.example: Anxiety can grip a patient waiting for results.
anxiety.example_zh: 等待結果時，焦慮會緊緊攫住病人。

anxious.example: She felt anxious as she waited for the results.
anxious.example_zh: 等待結果時她感到焦慮。

apathy.example: Voter apathy led to the lowest turnout in the country's history.
apathy.example_zh: 選民的冷漠造成該國史上最低的投票率。

apologize.example: The clinic was quick to apologize for the delay.

apology.example: The clinic offered a sincere apology for the delay.
apology.example_zh: 診所為延誤誠摯地道歉。

appeal.example: The charity made an urgent appeal for blood donors.
appeal.example_zh: 該慈善機構緊急呼籲民眾捐血。

appear.example: Symptoms may not appear until weeks after infection.
appear.example_zh: 症狀可能在感染數週後才出現。

appendage.example: A crab uses its claws and other appendages to capture prey.
appendage.example_zh: 螃蟹用牠的螯和其他附肢來捕捉獵物。

appetite.example: Her appetite returned as she got better.
appetite.example_zh: 隨著她好轉，她的食慾也回來了。

appetizer.example: We ordered a light appetizer to share before the main course arrived.
appetizer.example_zh: 在主菜上桌前，我們點了一道清爽的開胃菜一起分享。

applaud.example: The crowd applauded the brave young patient.
applaud.example_zh: 群眾為這位勇敢的小病人鼓掌。

applause.example: Warm applause greeted the recovered patient.
applause.example_zh: 熱烈的掌聲迎接這位康復的病人。

appliance.example: A small breathing appliance helped her at night.
appliance.example_zh: 一個小型的呼吸輔助器在夜裡幫助她。

applicant.example: Each applicant for the trial had a health check.
applicant.example_zh: 每位試驗的申請者都做了健康檢查。

application.example: He filled in an application for the clinical trial.
application.example_zh: 他填了一份參加臨床試驗的申請書。

apply.example: Apply the cream twice a day to the rash.
apply.example_zh: 一天兩次把藥膏塗在疹子上。

appoint.example: The board will appoint a new head of surgery.
appoint.example_zh: 董事會將任命新的外科主任。

appointment.example: She missed her appointment because of the storm.
appointment.example_zh: 因為暴風雨，她錯過了預約。

appraise.example: The expert was hired to appraise the value of the antique painting.
appraise.example_zh: 這位專家受聘來鑑定那幅古董畫作的價值。

appreciate.example: Patients appreciate a clear explanation, which enhances their trust.
appreciate.example_zh: 病人欣賞清楚的說明，這能增進他們的信任。

appreciation.example: She wrote a card to show her appreciation to the nurses.
appreciation.example_zh: 她寫了張卡片，向護理師們表達感激。

apprehension.example: She waited for her test results with growing apprehension.
apprehension.example_zh: 她懷著愈來愈強的憂懼，等待著檢驗結果。

approach.example: The doctor took a gentle approach with the frightened child.
approach.example_zh: 醫生對受驚的孩子採取溫和的方式。

appropriate.example: The doctor chose an appropriate dose for her age.
appropriate.example_zh: 醫生為她的年齡選了適當的劑量。

appropriation.example: Congress approved a large appropriation for medical research this year.
appropriation.example_zh: 國會今年批准了一大筆用於醫學研究的撥款。

approval.example: The drug is still waiting for government approval.
approval.example_zh: 這種藥仍在等待政府核准。

approve.example: The agency was slow to approve the new vaccine.
approve.example_zh: 該機構遲遲未核准這款新疫苗。

approximately.example: The surgery takes approximately two hours.
approximately.example_zh: 這場手術大約需要兩小時。

arc.example: The needle followed a smooth arc into the skin.
arc.example_zh: 針沿著一道平滑的弧線扎入皮膚。

arch.example: The arch of her foot ached after standing all day.
arch.example_zh: 站了一整天後，她的足弓痠痛。

archetypal.example: Sherlock Holmes is the archetypal brilliant detective in fiction.
archetypal.example_zh: 福爾摩斯是小說中聰明絕頂偵探的典型原型。

architect.example: An architect designed the airy new clinic.
architect.example_zh: 一位建築師設計了這間通風明亮的新診所。

architectural.example: The hospital won an architectural award.
architectural.example_zh: 這家醫院贏得了一座建築獎。

architecture.example: The hospital's open architecture lets in plenty of light.
architecture.example_zh: 醫院開闊的建築設計引入了充足的光線。

arctic.example: The arctic cold made his old wound ache.
arctic.example_zh: 極地般的寒冷讓他的舊傷隱隱作痛。

ardent.example: She is an ardent supporter of public healthcare reform.
ardent.example_zh: 她是公共醫療改革的熱忱支持者。

arena.example: The hospital became an arena in the fight against the virus.
arena.example_zh: 這家醫院成了對抗病毒的戰場。

arise.example: Complications can arise even after a simple operation.
arise.example_zh: 即使是簡單的手術也可能出現併發症。

armor.example: The skin is like armor against everyday germs.
armor.example_zh: 皮膚就像抵禦日常病菌的盔甲。

arrange.example: The nurse arranged a follow-up appointment.
arrange.example_zh: 護理師安排了一次回診。

arrangement.example: The nurse made an arrangement for home care.
arrangement.example_zh: 護理師為居家照護做了安排。

array.example: The lab held an array of testing machines.
array.example_zh: 實驗室裡擺著一整排的檢驗儀器。

arrest.example: The drug can cause cardiac arrest in rare cases.
arrest.example_zh: 這種藥在罕見情況下可能引起心臟驟停。

artery.example: A blocked artery can lead to a heart attack.
artery.example_zh: 阻塞的動脈可能導致心臟病發作。

arthritis.example: Years of heavy labor left him with painful arthritis in his hands.
arthritis.example_zh: 多年的粗重工作讓他的雙手患上了疼痛的關節炎。

article.example: She read an article about preventing heart disease.
article.example_zh: 她讀了一篇關於預防心臟病的文章。

articulate.example: She was articulate in explaining her symptoms.
articulate.example_zh: 她把自己的症狀說得清清楚楚。

artifact.example: The shadow on the scan was just an artifact.
artifact.example_zh: 掃描上的陰影只是個假影。

artificial.example: Early artificial limbs were primitive and heavy.
artificial.example_zh: 早期的人工義肢既原始又笨重。

aspect.example: Diet is just one aspect of good health.
aspect.example_zh: 飲食只是健康的一個面向。

aspiration.example: Her lifelong aspiration was to cure the sick.
aspiration.example_zh: 她畢生的志向是醫治病人。

aspire.example: Many students aspire to an affluent and stable life.
aspire.example_zh: 許多學生嚮往富裕而安穩的生活。

assault.example: The patient survived a brutal assault.
assault.example_zh: 病人在一場殘暴的攻擊中倖存下來。

assemble.example: The team assembled quickly for the emergency surgery.
assemble.example_zh: 團隊迅速集結，準備進行緊急手術。

assembly.example: The whole assembly fell silent as the doctor spoke.
assembly.example_zh: 醫生開口時，全場一片寂靜。

assert.example: He will assert that he feels fine, but he is pretending.
assert.example_zh: 他會聲稱自己沒事，但他是裝的。

assess.example: The nurse will assess your pain on a scale of ten.
assess.example_zh: 護理師會用十分量表評估你的疼痛。

assessment.example: The nurse made a quick assessment of his injuries.
assessment.example_zh: 護理師對他的傷勢做了快速評估。

asset.example: Illness can diminish a person's greatest asset: good health.
asset.example_zh: 疾病會削弱一個人最大的資產——健康。

assign.example: Each nurse is assigned to a group of patients.
assign.example_zh: 每位護理師被分配照顧一組病人。

assignment.example: Her first assignment was on the night ward.
assignment.example_zh: 她的第一份工作是在夜間病房。

assimilate.example: Immigrants often take years to fully assimilate into a new culture.
assimilate.example_zh: 移民往往需要多年才能完全融入一個新的文化。

assist.example: A newly appointed junior doctor will assist in the operation.
assist.example_zh: 一位新任命的住院醫師將協助這場手術。

assistance.example: Assistance from a nurse will enable her to walk again.
assistance.example_zh: 護理師的協助將使她能再次行走。

assistant.example: The lab assistant prepared the samples for testing.
assistant.example_zh: 實驗室助理把樣本備好以供檢驗。

associate.example: Doctors associate the rash with a food allergy.
associate.example_zh: 醫生把這種疹子與食物過敏聯想在一起。

association.example: There is a clear association between smoking and cancer.
association.example_zh: 吸菸與癌症之間有明確的關聯。

assuage.example: The doctor's calm words helped assuage the patient's fears about surgery.
assuage.example_zh: 醫師平靜的話語有助於緩和病人對手術的恐懼。

assume.example: Don't assume mild pain has no serious implication.
assume.example_zh: 別以為輕微的疼痛就沒有嚴重的含意。

assumed.example: The intern assumed full responsibility for the ward overnight.
assumed.example_zh: 實習醫生夜間承擔了病房的全部責任。

assumption.example: The treatment was based on a false assumption.
assumption.example_zh: 這項治療建立在一個錯誤的假設上。

assure.example: The doctor assured her the operation was safe.
assure.example_zh: 醫生向她保證手術是安全的。

asteroid.example: The museum showed a fragment of an asteroid.
asteroid.example_zh: 博物館展出了一塊小行星的碎片。

astronomer.example: The astronomer spent cold nights at the telescope.
astronomer.example_zh: 這位天文學家在寒夜裡守著望遠鏡。

athlete.example: The young athlete tore a muscle in training.
athlete.example_zh: 這名年輕運動員在訓練中拉傷了肌肉。

atmosphere.example: The ward had a calm and reassuring atmosphere.
atmosphere.example_zh: 病房裡有種平靜而令人安心的氣氛。

atom.example: Everything around us is made of atoms.
atom.example_zh: 我們周遭的一切都是由原子構成的。

atomic.example: The scan uses energy from an atomic source.
atomic.example_zh: 這項掃描使用來自原子源的能量。

attach.example: The nurse attached the drip to his arm.
attach.example_zh: 護理師把點滴接到他的手臂上。

attachment.example: She formed a deep attachment to her young patient.
attachment.example_zh: 她對她年幼的病人產生了深厚的感情。

attain.example: With therapy, she hoped to attain full mobility again.
attain.example_zh: 透過治療，她希望再次恢復完全的行動能力。

attempt.example: Doctors made one last attempt to save the patient.
attempt.example_zh: 醫生做了最後一次嘗試來搶救病人。

attend.example: Two nurses attended the patient through the night.
attend.example_zh: 兩名護理師整夜照料這名病人。

attendance.example: Attendance at the clinic doubled this winter.
attendance.example_zh: 這個冬天診所的就診人數倍增。

attendant.example: A flight attendant helped the sick passenger.
attendant.example_zh: 一名空服員協助了這名生病的乘客。

attention.example: The wound needs urgent medical attention.
attention.example_zh: 這個傷口需要緊急的醫療處置。

attenuate.example: The vaccine uses an attenuated form of the virus.
attenuate.example_zh: 這款疫苗使用了減毒型的病毒。

attorney.example: The family hired an attorney after the error.
attorney.example_zh: 那次疏失之後，家屬請了一位律師。

attract.example: The clinic attracts patients from across the region.
attract.example_zh: 這間診所吸引了整個地區的病人。

attraction.example: The hospital's garden was a quiet attraction for patients.
attraction.example_zh: 醫院的花園是病人一處寧靜的去處。

attractive.example: A clean, bright ward is more attractive to patients.
attractive.example_zh: 乾淨明亮的病房對病人更有吸引力。

attributable.example: Many deaths are directly attributable to smoking.
attributable.example_zh: 許多死亡可直接歸因於吸菸。

attribute.example: She attributes her recovery to a positive attitude.
attribute.example_zh: 她把康復歸功於正向的心態。

auction.example: A charity auction raised money for the ward.
auction.example_zh: 一場慈善拍賣為病房募了款。

audacity.example: He had the audacity to lie to the judge right in the courtroom.
audacity.example_zh: 他竟然有膽量在法庭上當著法官的面說謊。

audience.example: The speaker engaged her audience with vivid case studies.
audience.example_zh: 講者用生動的案例研究吸引了她的聽眾。

audit.example: An audit found the drug records were in order.
audit.example_zh: 一次稽核發現藥品紀錄井然有序。

auspicious.example: The clear sky was an auspicious start to their wedding day.
auspicious.example_zh: 晴朗的天空為他們的婚禮揭開了吉祥的序幕。

authentic.example: The herb was sold with an authentic label.
authentic.example_zh: 這種草藥附有真品標籤販售。

authenticate.example: A signature is required to authenticate the prescription.
authenticate.example_zh: 處方需要簽名來證明其真實性。

authoritative.example: This textbook is the most authoritative reference on human anatomy available.
authoritative.example_zh: 這本教科書是目前最具權威性的人體解剖學參考書。

authority.example: The health authority ordered the clinic to close.
authority.example_zh: 衛生主管機關下令這間診所關閉。

authorize.example: Only a doctor can authorize this strong drug.
authorize.example_zh: 只有醫生能授權使用這種強效藥。

automatic.example: The pump gives an automatic dose every hour.
automatic.example_zh: 這台幫浦每小時自動給予一次劑量。

autonomy.example: Patients have the autonomy to refuse treatment.
autonomy.example_zh: 病人有拒絕治療的自主權。

available.example: A bed became available in the children's ward.
available.example_zh: 兒童病房空出了一張床。

avenue.example: New research opened an avenue to a cure.
avenue.example_zh: 新的研究為治癒開闢了一條途徑。

average.example: The average dose is derived from the patient's weight.
average.example_zh: 平均劑量是依病人體重推算出來的。

avoid.example: Avoid greasy food while your stomach heals.
avoid.example_zh: 胃在復原期間要避免油膩的食物。

aware.example: Be aware of the early signs that predict a relapse.
aware.example_zh: 留意那些預示復發的早期徵兆。

awareness.example: The campaign raised awareness of heart disease.
awareness.example_zh: 這項活動提高了大眾對心臟病的認識。

awkward.example: There was an awkward silence after the diagnosis.
awkward.example_zh: 診斷宣布後，出現了一陣尷尬的沉默。

axis.example: The chart's vertical axis shows blood pressure.

bachelor.example: She earned a bachelor of nursing last year.
bachelor.example_zh: 她去年取得了護理學士學位。

background.example: From the patient's background, the doctor constructed a clear risk picture.
background.example_zh: 根據病人的背景病史，醫師建構出清楚的風險輪廓。

backward.example: He took a step backward and nearly fell.
backward.example_zh: 他往後退了一步，差點跌倒。

bacteria.example: Harmful bacteria can live on unwashed hands.
bacteria.example_zh: 有害的細菌能在未洗的手上存活。

bacterium.example: A single bacterium can multiply into millions.
bacterium.example_zh: 一個細菌能繁殖成數百萬個。

balance.example: Good health depends on a balance of diet and exercise.
balance.example_zh: 健康有賴於飲食與運動的平衡。

balanced.example: A balanced diet keeps the body strong.
balanced.example_zh: 均衡的飲食能讓身體強健。

balancing.example: Treating the disease is a balancing act between risk and benefit.
balancing.example_zh: 治療這種疾病是在風險與效益之間求取平衡。

balcony.example: She sat on the balcony to get some fresh air.

bald.example: The drug left him temporarily bald.
bald.example_zh: 這種藥讓他暫時掉光了頭髮。

balloon.example: A red balloon cheered up the sick child.
balloon.example_zh: 一顆紅氣球讓生病的孩子開心起來。

ballot.example: The staff voted by secret ballot on the new shifts.
ballot.example_zh: 員工以不記名投票表決新的班表。

ban.example: The hospital placed a ban on smoking in its grounds.
ban.example_zh: 醫院在院區內全面禁菸。

band.example: A tight band was placed around his arm to draw blood.
band.example_zh: 抽血時，他的手臂上綁了一條止血帶。

bang.example: He hit his head with a bang on the cabinet.
bang.example_zh: 他的頭砰一聲撞上了櫃子。

banish.example: In ancient times, kings would banish their rivals to distant lands.
banish.example_zh: 古時候，國王會把對手流放到遙遠的地方。

banker.example: The banker collapsed from stress at work.
banker.example_zh: 這名銀行家因工作壓力而昏倒。

bankruptcy.example: Huge medical liabilities drove the family into bankruptcy.
bankruptcy.example_zh: 龐大的醫療債務使這家人陷入破產。

banner.example: A banner outside urged people to get vaccinated.
banner.example_zh: 外頭一條布條呼籲民眾接種疫苗。

bar.example: A metal bar supported his broken leg.
bar.example_zh: 一根金屬桿支撐著他斷掉的腿。

bare.example: The doctor pressed gently on his bare stomach.
bare.example_zh: 醫生輕輕按壓他裸露的腹部。

barely.example: He could barely lift his arm after the stroke.
barely.example_zh: 中風後他幾乎舉不起手臂。

bargain.example: Good health is no bargain you can buy.
bargain.example_zh: 健康可不是你能買到的便宜貨。

bark.example: Some old remedies are made from tree bark.
bark.example_zh: 有些古老的藥方是用樹皮製成的。

barn.example: The injured man was carried into a nearby barn.
barn.example_zh: 受傷的男子被抬進附近的一間穀倉。

barrel.example: The chemicals were stored in a sealed barrel.
barrel.example_zh: 這些化學品存放在一個密封的桶子裡。

barrier.example: Cost is a barrier that can undermine access to care.
barrier.example_zh: 費用是一道可能削弱就醫機會的障礙。

base.example: The hospital is the base for the region's air ambulance.
base.example_zh: 這家醫院是該地區空中救護的基地。

basement.example: The records were stored in the hospital basement.
basement.example_zh: 病歷存放在醫院的地下室。

basic.example: Hand washing is a basic but vital habit.
basic.example_zh: 洗手是基本卻重要的習慣。

basin.example: The nurse filled a basin with warm water.
basin.example_zh: 護理師在臉盆裡裝滿溫水。

battery.example: The pacemaker's battery saves power in sleep mode.
battery.example_zh: 心律調節器的電池在睡眠模式下省電。

battle.example: She fought a long battle against cancer.
battle.example_zh: 她與癌症進行了一場漫長的搏鬥。

bead.example: A bead of sweat ran down his forehead.
bead.example_zh: 一滴汗珠從他的額頭滑落。

beam.example: A warm beam of sunlight fell across the bed.
beam.example_zh: 一道溫暖的陽光灑落在床上。

bean.example: A simple bean soup was all he could keep down.
bean.example_zh: 一碗簡單的豆湯是他唯一吃得下的。

bear.example: She could no longer bear the pain in her knee.
bear.example_zh: 她再也無法忍受膝蓋的疼痛。

beard.example: He grew a beard during his long stay in hospital.
beard.example_zh: 長期住院期間他留起了鬍子。

beast.example: The fever raged in him like a wild beast.
beast.example_zh: 高燒在他體內肆虐，宛如一頭野獸。

beat.example: The drummer kept a steady beat throughout the song.
beat.example_zh: 鼓手整首歌都維持穩定的節拍。

beg.example: She had to beg him to see a doctor.
beg.example_zh: 她不得不央求他去看醫生。

behalf.example: She spoke on behalf of all the patients.

behave.example: The children behaved well while waiting at the clinic.
behave.example_zh: 孩子們在診所候診時很守規矩。

behavior.example: Sudden changes in behavior can be a warning sign.
behavior.example_zh: 行為的突然改變可能是個警訊。

belief.example: There is a common belief that colds come from cold weather.
belief.example_zh: 普遍有種說法認為感冒來自寒冷的天氣。

believer.example: She was a firm believer in the power of rest.

belong.example: These records belong in the locked cabinet.
belong.example_zh: 這些病歷應該放在上鎖的櫃子裡。

below.example: Her blood pressure dropped below the safe level.
below.example_zh: 她的血壓降到了安全值以下。

belt.example: Always fasten your seat belt to avoid injury.
belt.example_zh: 一定要繫好安全帶以避免受傷。

bench.example: He rested on a bench outside the clinic.
bench.example_zh: 他在診所外的長椅上歇息。

bend.example: Keep the joint flexible, but do not bend it sharply.
bend.example_zh: 保持關節靈活，但別猛然彎曲它。

beneath.example: The pain was deep beneath the surface of the skin.
beneath.example_zh: 疼痛深藏在皮膚表面之下。

beneficial.example: A short walk each day is beneficial to the heart.
beneficial.example_zh: 每天散步片刻對心臟有益。

benefit.example: The benefits of the drug outweigh the risks.
benefit.example_zh: 這種藥的益處大於風險。

benevolence.example: The hospital was founded through the benevolence of a wealthy donor.
benevolence.example_zh: 這家醫院是靠一位富有捐助者的善心而創立的。

benevolent.example: A benevolent donor paid for the new equipment.
benevolent.example_zh: 一位仁慈的捐贈者支付了新設備的費用。

benign.example: The biopsy showed that the lump was benign.
benign.example_zh: 切片顯示那個腫塊是良性的。

besides.example: Besides rest, she needs plenty of fluids.
besides.example_zh: 除了休息，她還需要大量補充水分。

beta.example: The company released a beta version of the app to test for bugs.
beta.example_zh: 公司推出了應用程式的測試版（beta版），以找出程式錯誤。

betray.example: Her shaking hands betrayed her fear.
betray.example_zh: 她顫抖的雙手洩露了她的恐懼。

bias.example: The study was designed to avoid any bias.
bias.example_zh: 這項研究的設計是為了避免任何偏差。

bid.example: The hospital made a bid for new funding.

bilateral.example: The scan revealed bilateral swelling in the patient's knees.
bilateral.example_zh: 掃描顯示病人雙側膝蓋都有腫脹。

billion.example: The disease drains billions, widening the national deficit.
billion.example_zh: 這種疾病耗費數十億，擴大了國家財政赤字。

bin.example: Used dressings go in the yellow bin.
bin.example_zh: 用過的敷料丟進黃色的桶子裡。

bind.example: The nurse used a clean cloth to bind the wound.
bind.example_zh: 護理師用一塊乾淨的布包紮傷口。

biography.example: She wrote a biography of the famous surgeon.
biography.example_zh: 她寫了這位知名外科醫生的傳記。

biologist.example: The biologist studied how the virus reproduces.
biologist.example_zh: 這位生物學家研究病毒如何繁殖。

biomarker.example: Researchers identified a blood biomarker that signals early kidney damage.
biomarker.example_zh: 研究人員找到一種能反映早期腎臟損傷的血液生物標記。

biopsy.example: The doctor ordered a biopsy to determine whether the lump was malignant.
biopsy.example_zh: 醫生安排了切片檢查，以判斷這個腫塊是否為惡性。

bit.example: Eat just a bit at a time while you recover.
bit.example_zh: 復原期間每次只吃一點點。

bite.example: The insect bite swelled into a red lump.
bite.example_zh: 蟲咬處腫成一個紅色的硬塊。

bitter.example: The medicine had a bitter, unpleasant taste.
bitter.example_zh: 這種藥有股苦澀難喝的味道。

bizarre.example: He developed a bizarre rash overnight.
bizarre.example_zh: 他一夜之間長出了一片奇怪的疹子。

blade.example: The surgeon's blade made a clean, shallow cut.
blade.example_zh: 外科醫生的刀刃劃出一道乾淨的淺切口。

blame.example: It would be unfair to blame the nurse.
blame.example_zh: 把責任推給護理師並不公平。

blanket.example: The nurse tucked a warm blanket around him.
blanket.example_zh: 護理師把一條溫暖的毯子掖在他身邊。

blast.example: A blast of cold air rushed in when the door opened.
blast.example_zh: 門一開，一陣冷空氣灌了進來。

bleed.example: The deep cut began to bleed heavily.
bleed.example_zh: 那道深深的傷口開始大量出血。

blend.example: The drug is a careful blend of two compounds.
blend.example_zh: 這種藥是兩種化合物的精心調配。

blessing.example: A safe delivery was a great blessing.

blink.example: He could only blink to answer the questions.
blink.example_zh: 他只能用眨眼來回答問題。

block.example: A clot can block the flow of blood to the brain.
block.example_zh: 血塊可能阻斷流向大腦的血液。

blow.example: The diagnosis came as a heavy blow.
blow.example_zh: 這個診斷是個沉重的打擊。

blue.example: His lips turned blue from the lack of oxygen.
blue.example_zh: 他的嘴唇因缺氧而發青。

blur.example: Tears blurred her vision as she read the letter.
blur.example_zh: 讀信時，淚水模糊了她的視線。

board.example: The hospital board approved the new ward.
board.example_zh: 醫院董事會核准了新病房。

boast.example: The clinic can boast a perfect safety record.
boast.example_zh: 這間診所擁有完美的安全紀錄，足以自豪。

boil.example: Boil the water before mixing the medicine.

bold.example: It was a bold decision to operate so soon.
bold.example_zh: 這麼快就動手術是個大膽的決定。

bolster.example: The good test results helped bolster her confidence.
bolster.example_zh: 良好的檢查結果有助於增強她的信心。

bolt.example: A loose bolt made the hospital bed wobble.
bolt.example_zh: 一顆鬆掉的螺栓讓病床晃動。

bond.example: A strong bond formed between the nurse and the child.
bond.example_zh: 護理師與孩子之間建立了深厚的情誼。

bonus.example: Recovering early was an unexpected bonus.
bonus.example_zh: 提早康復是個意外的收穫。

boom.example: There was a boom in demand for the new vaccine.
boom.example_zh: 這款新疫苗的需求激增。

boost.example: A good meal gave him a much-needed boost.
boost.example_zh: 一頓好飯給了他急需的能量。

border.example: Authorities imposed checks at the border to stop the disease.
border.example_zh: 當局在邊境實施檢查以阻止疾病擴散。

bore.example: The dentist's drill can bore through hard enamel.
bore.example_zh: 牙醫的鑽頭能鑽穿堅硬的琺瑯質。

boring.example: The long recovery was boring but necessary.
boring.example_zh: 漫長的復原期很無聊，卻是必要的。

boulder.example: A fallen boulder blocked the road to the clinic.
boulder.example_zh: 一塊掉落的巨石擋住了通往診所的路。

bounce.example: Children seem to bounce back from illness quickly.
bounce.example_zh: 孩子似乎能很快從疾病中復原。

boundary.example: Doctors must not overlook the boundary between care and overtreatment.
boundary.example_zh: 醫師不能忽視照護與過度治療之間的界線。

bout.example: He had a nasty bout of flu last winter.
bout.example_zh: 去年冬天他得了一場嚴重的流感。

bow.example: The old doctor gave a slight bow to his patient.
bow.example_zh: 老醫生向他的病人微微鞠了個躬。

bowl.example: She could only manage a bowl of plain rice.
bowl.example_zh: 她只勉強吃得下一碗白飯。

brain.example: A stroke cuts off the blood supply to part of the brain.
brain.example_zh: 中風會切斷腦部某個區域的血液供應。

brake.example: The driver hit the brake but it was too late.
brake.example_zh: 駕駛踩了剎車，但為時已晚。

brand.example: The doctor prescribed a cheaper brand of the drug.
brand.example_zh: 醫生開了這種藥較便宜的品牌。

brass.example: The old hospital sign was made of polished brass.
brass.example_zh: 那塊舊醫院招牌是用擦亮的黃銅做的。

brave.example: The brave nurse stayed by her patients throughout the epidemic.
brave.example_zh: 這位勇敢的護理師在整場疫情中始終守在病人身邊。

breakdown.example: Months of stress led to a complete breakdown.
breakdown.example_zh: 數月的壓力導致她徹底崩潰。

breakthrough.example: The new vaccine marked a major breakthrough in cancer treatment.
breakthrough.example_zh: 這款新疫苗是癌症治療上的一大突破。

breath.example: Take a deep breath and hold it for the scan.
breath.example_zh: 深吸一口氣並屏住，以便掃描。

breathe.example: It hurt to breathe deeply after the surgery.

breathing.example: Her breathing slowed as she fell asleep.
breathing.example_zh: 她入睡時呼吸漸漸放慢。

breed.example_zh: 髒水會孳生危險的細菌。

breeze.example: A cool breeze drifted through the open window.
breeze.example_zh: 一陣涼風從敞開的窗戶飄了進來。

brick.example: The old clinic was a small brick building.
brick.example_zh: 那間舊診所是一棟小磚房。

brief.example: The doctor gave a brief account of the risks.
brief.example_zh: 醫生簡短地說明了風險。

bring.example: Please bring your medical records to the appointment.
bring.example_zh: 請把你的病歷帶到看診時。

broadcast.example: A health warning was broadcast on the radio.
broadcast.example_zh: 一則健康警示透過收音機播送。

broker.example: An insurance broker helped explain her coverage.
broker.example_zh: 一位保險經紀人幫她解釋了保險給付。

bronze.example: He won a bronze medal before his injury.
bronze.example_zh: 受傷前他贏得了一面銅牌。

brown.example: The old bruise had faded to a dull brown.
brown.example_zh: 那塊舊瘀青已褪成暗褐色。

brutal.example: Recovery from the burn was slow and brutal.
brutal.example_zh: 從燒傷中康復既緩慢又煎熬。

bubble.example: An air bubble in the drip line worried the nurse.
bubble.example_zh: 點滴管裡的一個氣泡讓護理師擔憂。

buck.example: The medicine cost only a few bucks at the pharmacy.
buck.example_zh: 這種藥在藥局只要幾塊錢。

bucket.example: She filled a bucket with warm water to clean the floor.
bucket.example_zh: 她在桶子裡裝滿溫水來清理地板。

buddy.example: His old army buddy visited him in hospital.
buddy.example_zh: 他的老戰友到醫院探望他。

budget.example: The clinic ran on a very tight budget.
budget.example_zh: 這間診所靠著極為拮据的預算運作。

bulb.example: The nurse replaced the dim bulb above the bed.
bulb.example_zh: 護理師換掉了床上方那顆昏暗的燈泡。

bulk.example: The bulk of the patients recovered fully.
bulk.example_zh: 大部分的病人都完全康復了。

bump.example: He got a small bump on his head from the fall.
bump.example_zh: 他跌倒後頭上腫了一個小包。

bunch.example: She brought a bunch of flowers to the ward.

bundle.example: The nurse carried a bundle of clean towels.
bundle.example_zh: 護理師抱著一捆乾淨的毛巾。

burden.example: Chronic illness places a heavy burden on families.
burden.example_zh: 慢性病為家庭帶來沉重的負擔。

bureaucracy.example: Too much bureaucracy slowed her treatment.
bureaucracy.example_zh: 過多的官僚程序拖慢了她的治療。

burial.example: The family held a quiet burial for the old doctor.
burial.example_zh: 這家人為這位老醫生舉行了簡單的葬禮。

burning.example: She had a burning pain in her chest.
burning.example_zh: 她胸口有種灼熱的疼痛。

burst.example: The appendix can burst if surgery is delayed.
burst.example_zh: 若延誤手術，闌尾可能會破裂。

bust.example: Police busted the gang for selling counterfeit prescription drugs.
bust.example_zh: 警方破獲了這個販售偽造處方藥的集團。

butt.example: He stubbed out the cigarette butt and quit for good.
butt.example_zh: 他熄掉菸頭，從此戒了菸。

butter.example: Butter is high in calories but low in nutrient density.
butter.example_zh: 奶油熱量高，但營養密度低。

butterfly.example: A butterfly rash across the cheeks can signal lupus.
butterfly.example_zh: 橫過雙頰的蝴蝶斑可能是紅斑性狼瘡的徵兆。

buzz.example: There was a buzz of excitement when the cure was announced.
buzz.example_zh: 療法公布時，現場洋溢著一陣興奮的騷動。

cab.example: She took a cab straight to the hospital.

cabin.example: He recovered in a quiet cabin by the lake.
cabin.example_zh: 他在湖邊一間寧靜的小屋裡休養。

cabinet.example: Medicines are locked in a cabinet at night.
cabinet.example_zh: 藥物在夜間鎖在櫃子裡。

cable.example: Thin cables connect the sensors to the monitor.
cable.example_zh: 細電纜把感測器連到監測儀。

calcium.example: Milk gives the body the calcium it needs.
calcium.example_zh: 牛奶提供身體所需的鈣質。

calculate.example: The pharmacist calculated the dose by weight.
calculate.example_zh: 藥師按體重計算了劑量。

calculation.example: A small error in calculation changed the dose.
calculation.example_zh: 計算上的一個小錯誤改變了劑量。

calendar.example: She marked her checkups on the calendar.
calendar.example_zh: 她把回診的日子標在日曆上。

calm.example: The nurse's calm voice settled the frightened child.
calm.example_zh: 護理師平靜的聲音安撫了受驚的孩子。

camp.example: A medical camp offered free checkups in the village.
camp.example_zh: 一個義診營在村裡提供免費健檢。

campaign.example: The campaign urged people to get vaccinated.
campaign.example_zh: 這項宣導活動呼籲民眾接種疫苗。

campus.example: The medical school sits on a quiet campus.
campus.example_zh: 這所醫學院坐落在一個寧靜的校園裡。

can.example: She can walk a little further each day now.
can.example_zh: 她現在每天都能多走一點路。

canal.example: The ear canal was blocked with wax.

cancel.example: She had to cancel her appointment due to the storm.
cancel.example_zh: 因為暴風雨，她不得不取消預約。

candidate.example: She is a strong candidate for the transplant.
candidate.example_zh: 她是接受移植的合適人選。

cane.example: He leaned on a cane as he learned to walk again.
cane.example_zh: 他重新學走路時拄著一根拐杖。

canvas.example: The artist stretched a fresh canvas before painting.
canvas.example_zh: 畫家在作畫前繃好一塊新的畫布。

canyon.example: An echo carried across the deep canyon.

cap.example: Always put the cap back on the medicine bottle.
cap.example_zh: 藥瓶用完一定要把蓋子蓋回去。

capability.example: The small clinic lacks the capability for surgery.
capability.example_zh: 這間小診所沒有進行手術的能力。

capable.example: With the new app, she is capable of conducting a virtual consultation.
capable.example_zh: 有了新的應用程式，她就有能力進行視訊看診。

capacious.example: The new clinic has a capacious waiting room that seats over a hundred.
capacious.example_zh: 這家新診所有一間寬敞的候診室，可容納上百人就座。

capacity.example: The hospital's limited capacity forced some transfers.
capacity.example_zh: 醫院有限的收治量迫使部分病人轉院。

capture.example: The scan captured a clear image of the tumor.
capture.example_zh: 掃描捕捉到腫瘤的清晰影像。

carbohydrate.example: Bread and rice are rich in carbohydrate.
carbohydrate.example_zh: 麵包和米飯富含碳水化合物。

carbon.example: Carbon is the backbone element of every organic molecule in the body.
carbon.example_zh: 碳是體內每一個有機分子的骨架元素。

career.example: An injury nearly ended her career as a dancer.
career.example_zh: 一次受傷差點結束她的舞者生涯。

careful.example: Be careful to apply direct pressure to the wound.
careful.example_zh: 小心地對傷口直接加壓。

cargo.example: A cargo of medical supplies arrived by ship.
cargo.example_zh: 一批醫療物資由船運抵達。

carnivore.example: Lions are carnivores that survive almost entirely on the meat of other animals.
carnivore.example_zh: 獅子是肉食動物，幾乎完全以其他動物的肉為生。

cart.example: The nurse wheeled the medicine cart down the hall.
cart.example_zh: 護理師推著藥車走過走廊。

cartoon.example: A cartoon on the wall made the children laugh.
cartoon.example_zh: 牆上的一幅卡通逗笑了孩子們。

carve.example: The surgeon carved away the dead tissue with care.
carve.example_zh: 外科醫生小心地切除了壞死的組織。

cast.example: He accidentally cracked the cast on his broken arm.
cast.example_zh: 他不小心弄裂了打在斷臂上的石膏。

casual.example: He gave only a casual glance at the report.
casual.example_zh: 他只是隨意地瞄了一眼報告。

casualty.example: The first casualty was rushed to the emergency room.
casualty.example_zh: 第一名傷患被緊急送進急診室。

catalog.example: The pharmacy keeps a catalog of every drug.
catalog.example_zh: 藥局保有一份每種藥的目錄。

catalyst.example: The new funding acted as a catalyst for groundbreaking research.
catalyst.example_zh: 這筆新資金成為突破性研究的催化劑。

catapult.example: The surprise victory catapulted the young athlete to instant fame.
catapult.example_zh: 這場意外的勝利使這位年輕運動員瞬間聲名大噪。

category.example: This drug falls into a high-risk category.
category.example_zh: 這種藥屬於高風險類別。

catholic.example: She was raised in a strict Catholic family.
catholic.example_zh: 她在一個嚴格的天主教家庭中長大。

cause.example: Doctors are still searching for the cause of the illness.
cause.example_zh: 醫生仍在尋找這種病的病因。

caution.example: The label carried a clear caution about side effects.
caution.example_zh: 標籤上有關於副作用的清楚警語。

cautious.example: Be cautious about mixing different medicines.
cautious.example_zh: 對於混用不同藥物要謹慎。

cavity.example: Left untreated, a small cavity leads to progressive decay.
cavity.example_zh: 若不治療，一個小蛀洞會導致漸進性的牙齒崩壞。

cease.example: The bleeding finally ceased after an hour.
cease.example_zh: 出血在一小時後終於停止。

ceiling.example: The patient stared blankly at the ceiling.
ceiling.example_zh: 病人茫然地盯著天花板。

celebrate.example: The family gathered, trying to compose themselves and celebrate.
celebrate.example_zh: 家人聚在一起，努力穩住情緒，一同慶祝。

celebrity.example: A local celebrity opened the new ward.
celebrity.example_zh: 一位當地名人為新病房揭幕。

cell.example: Each cell in the body needs oxygen to survive.
cell.example_zh: 身體裡的每個細胞都需要氧氣才能存活。

cellular.example: The drug works at the cellular level.
cellular.example_zh: 這種藥在細胞層面發揮作用。

cemetery.example: The old cemetery lies just behind the chapel.
cemetery.example_zh: 那座古老的墓地就在小教堂後面。

census.example: The census showed an aging population in the town.
census.example_zh: 人口普查顯示這個鎮人口老化。

centenarian.example: The centenarian credited her long life to daily walks and a simple diet.
centenarian.example_zh: 這位百歲人瑞把長壽歸功於每天散步和清淡飲食。

cereal.example: A bowl of cereal was all she could eat.
cereal.example_zh: 一碗麥片是她唯一吃得下的。

ceremony.example: A short ceremony marked the ward's reopening.
ceremony.example_zh: 一場簡短的儀式慶祝了病房重新開放。

certainty.example: There is no certainty that the drug will work.
certainty.example_zh: 沒有十足的把握說這種藥會有效。

certification.example: She earned her nursing certification last spring.
certification.example_zh: 她去年春天取得了護理證照。

challenge.example: Quitting smoking was his biggest challenge.

chamber.example: The heart has four chambers that pump blood.
chamber.example_zh: 心臟有四個用來輸送血液的腔室。

champion.example: She became a champion for better mental health care.
champion.example_zh: 她成了爭取更好心理照護的鬥士。

championship.example: He won the championship before the injury.

chance.example: Early treatment gives the best chance of recovery.
chance.example_zh: 早期治療給予最好的康復機會。

channel.example: The nerve runs through a narrow channel in the bone.
channel.example_zh: 這條神經穿過骨頭裡一條狹窄的通道。

chaos.example: The emergency room descended into chaos after the crash.
chaos.example_zh: 車禍後，急診室陷入一片混亂。

character.example: Years of caring for others shaped her gentle character.
character.example_zh: 多年照顧他人塑造了她溫柔的性格。

characteristic.example: A barking cough is characteristic of croup.
characteristic.example_zh: 像狗吠的咳嗽是哮吼症的特徵。

characterize.example: A dry, aggressive cough characterizes the early illness.
characterize.example_zh: 乾咳且來勢洶洶，是這種疾病早期的特徵。

charge.example: The nurse in charge handled the emergency calmly.
charge.example_zh: 負責的護理師冷靜地處理了這場急症。

charity.example: A local charity paid for her surgery.
charity.example_zh: 一個當地的慈善團體支付了她的手術費。

charm.example: The old nurse had a calming charm.
charm.example_zh: 這位老護理師有種令人安心的魅力。

chart.example: The nurse updated the chart at the foot of the bed.
chart.example_zh: 護理師更新了床尾的病歷表。

charter.example: A charter sets out the patients' basic rights.
charter.example_zh: 一份憲章列出了病人的基本權利。

chase.example: The toddler led the nurse on a merry chase.
chase.example_zh: 這名幼兒讓護理師追得團團轉。

chasm.example: A deep chasm separated the two cliffs, making the crossing impossible.
chasm.example_zh: 一道深邃的裂谷將兩座懸崖隔開，使人無法跨越。

chat.example: A friendly chat eased the patient's nerves.
chat.example_zh: 一段友善的閒聊緩解了病人的緊張。

check.example: The nurse came to check his temperature.

chef.example: The hospital chef cooked a soft, gentle meal.
chef.example_zh: 醫院的廚師煮了一頓軟嫩好入口的餐。

chest.example: He felt a tightness in his chest while climbing.
chest.example_zh: 爬樓時他感到胸口發悶。

chicanery.example: The lawyer won the case through clever chicanery rather than honest argument.
chicanery.example_zh: 那名律師靠著巧妙的詭辯而非誠實的論證贏得了官司。

chief.example: She was promoted to chief of the surgical team.
chief.example_zh: 她升任外科團隊的主任。

chill.example: She felt a sudden chill as the fever began.
chill.example_zh: 發燒開始時她突然感到一陣寒意。

chip.example: A chip in the bone showed up on the X-ray.
chip.example_zh: X 光顯示骨頭上有一塊碎裂。

choice.example: Stopping smoking was the best choice he ever made.
choice.example_zh: 戒菸是他做過最好的選擇。

choir.example: A children's choir sang in the hospital lobby.
choir.example_zh: 一個兒童合唱團在醫院大廳獻唱。

choke.example: He began to choke on a piece of bread.

choose.example: Patients may choose between two treatment plans.
choose.example_zh: 病人可在兩種治療方案之間選擇。

chop.example: She chopped the vegetables for a healthy soup.
chop.example_zh: 她切好蔬菜煮一鍋健康湯。

chore.example: Taking his pills became a daily chore.
chore.example_zh: 吃藥成了他每天的例行雜事。

chorus.example: A chorus of beeps filled the busy ward.
chorus.example_zh: 一片嗶嗶聲此起彼落，充滿了忙碌的病房。

christian.example: Founded on Christian faith, the hospital welcomes every religion.
christian.example_zh: 這家醫院以基督信仰創立，歡迎各種宗教信仰的人。

chronic.example: He suffers from chronic pain in his knees.
chronic.example_zh: 他的膝蓋有慢性的疼痛。

chuckle.example: The old man gave a soft chuckle at the joke.
chuckle.example_zh: 老先生聽了笑話輕聲笑了笑。

chunk.example: She could only eat a small chunk of bread.
chunk.example_zh: 她只吃得下一小塊麵包。

circle.example: The doctor drew a circle around the affected area.
circle.example_zh: 醫生在患部周圍畫了一個圈。

circuit.example: The doctor made her morning circuit of the ward.
circuit.example_zh: 醫生進行了她早上的病房巡視。

circulate.example: Blood must circulate freely through the legs.
circulate.example_zh: 血液必須在雙腿中順暢地循環。

circulation.example_zh: 輕緩的活動能改善血液循環。

circumstance.example: Under the circumstances, surgery was the only choice.
circumstance.example_zh: 在這種情況下，手術是唯一的選擇。

circumvented.example: They circumvented the rule by using a clever loophole.
circumvented.example_zh: 他們利用一個巧妙的漏洞規避了這項規定。

cite.example: The doctor cited a recent study to support her advice.
cite.example_zh: 醫生引用了一份近期研究來佐證她的建議。

citizenship.example: She gained citizenship and free access to healthcare.
citizenship.example_zh: 她取得公民身分，得以免費享有醫療。

civic.example: The new hospital was a source of civic pride.
civic.example_zh: 這座新醫院是市民的驕傲。

civil.example: The two doctors stayed civil, though they continued to contend.
civil.example_zh: 兩位醫師雖仍各執己見，仍保持風度。

civilian.example: The army doctors also treated civilian patients.
civilian.example_zh: 軍醫也為平民病人看診。

civilization.example: Clean water transformed public health across the civilization.
civilization.example_zh: 乾淨的水改變了整個文明的公共衛生。

claim.example: He filed a claim with his health insurer.
claim.example_zh: 他向健康保險公司提出了理賠申請。

clan.example: The whole clan gathered at her bedside.
clan.example_zh: 整個家族聚集在她的床邊。

clandestine.example: The reporters uncovered a clandestine meeting between the two rival officials.
clandestine.example_zh: 記者揭露了兩名敵對官員之間的一場秘密會面。

clarify.example: The doctor clarified the dosing instructions.
clarify.example_zh: 醫生釐清了用藥的指示。

clarity.example: The new lens gave the scan great clarity.
clarity.example_zh: 新鏡頭讓掃描有極佳的清晰度。

clash.example: There was a clash between the two test results.
clash.example_zh: 兩份檢驗結果之間出現了矛盾。

classification.example: The drug falls under a strict classification.
classification.example_zh: 這種藥屬於一個嚴格的分類。

classify.example: Doctors classify foods by their sugar content.
classify.example_zh: 醫師依食物的含糖量加以分類。

clay.example: Children shaped little animals out of clay.
clay.example_zh: 孩子們用黏土捏出小動物。

clean.example: Keep the wound clean and the dressing secure.
clean.example_zh: 保持傷口清潔、敷料牢固。

clerk.example: The clerk at the desk checked her appointment.
clerk.example_zh: 櫃檯的職員核對了她的預約。

cliff.example: The hikers were stranded on a steep cliff.
cliff.example_zh: 登山客被困在一處陡峭的懸崖上。

climate.example: The dry climate eased her breathing problems.
climate.example_zh: 乾燥的氣候緩解了她的呼吸問題。

cling.example: A frightened child will cling to whoever fosters a sense of safety.
cling.example_zh: 受驚的孩子會緊抓住任何能給他安全感的人。

clinic.example: The clinic is a small but well-equipped facility.
clinic.example_zh: 這家診所雖小，卻是設備完善的醫療機構。

clinical.example: The drug is still in clinical trials.
clinical.example_zh: 這種藥仍在臨床試驗階段。

clip.example: The nurse used a clip to close the small wound.
clip.example_zh: 護理師用一個夾子來閉合這道小傷口。

clog.example: Fatty deposits can clog the arteries and restrict blood flow.
clog.example_zh: 脂肪沉積會阻塞動脈，限制血液流動。

close.example: Keep a close watch on the patient's temperature.

closet.example: Spare blankets are kept in the hall closet.
closet.example_zh: 備用毯子放在走廊的壁櫥裡。

closure.example: The closure of the clinic left the village without care.
closure.example_zh: 診所的關閉讓這個村莊失去了醫療。

clothing.example: Loose clothing is best while the wound heals.
clothing.example_zh: 傷口癒合期間穿寬鬆的衣物最好。

clue.example: The rash was the first clue to her illness.
clue.example_zh: 那疹子是她生病的第一條線索。

cluster.example: A cluster of cases appeared in one village.
cluster.example_zh: 一個村莊出現了一群聚集的病例。

clutch.example: She felt a sudden clutch of fear in her chest.
clutch.example_zh: 她胸口突然感到一陣揪緊的恐懼。

coach.example: A physiotherapist coached him through each training session.
coach.example_zh: 物理治療師指導他完成每一次訓練課程。

coalition.example: A coalition of charities funded the new ward.
coalition.example_zh: 一個慈善聯盟資助了新病房。

coat.example: The pill has a smooth coat that is easy to swallow.
coat.example_zh: 這顆藥丸有層光滑的外衣，容易吞嚥。

code.example: The hospital follows a strict code of ethics.
code.example_zh: 這家醫院遵守嚴格的倫理守則。

cognitive.example: The illness caused a slow cognitive decline.
cognitive.example_zh: 這種疾病造成緩慢的認知衰退。

coin.example: She flipped a coin to decide who would go first.

coincidence.example: It was no coincidence that both fell ill together.
coincidence.example_zh: 兩人同時病倒並非巧合。

collaboration.example: The cure came from close collaboration between labs.
collaboration.example_zh: 這帖解藥來自各實驗室之間的密切合作。

collapse.example: He suffered a sudden collapse at work.

collar.example: A soft collar supported his injured neck.
collar.example_zh: 一個軟頸圈支撐著他受傷的脖子。

colleague.example: A trusted colleague covered her night shift.
colleague.example_zh: 一位信任的同事代了她的夜班。

collection.example: The museum acquired a rare collection of antique medical instruments.
collection.example_zh: 博物館收購了一批罕見的古董醫療器械收藏。

collective.example: Patient safety is a collective responsibility.
collective.example_zh: 病人安全是大家共同的責任。

collision.example: He broke his arm in a collision on the field.
collision.example_zh: 他在場上的一次撞擊中摔斷了手臂。

colonial.example: The hospital dates back to the colonial era.
colonial.example_zh: 這家醫院可追溯到殖民時代。

colony.example: A colony of bacteria grew in the dish.
colony.example_zh: 培養皿中長出了一群細菌。

coma.example: After the severe head injury, the patient slipped into a deep coma.
coma.example_zh: 嚴重的頭部外傷後，病患陷入深度昏迷。

combat.example: New antibiotics are needed to combat resistant bacteria.
combat.example_zh: 需要新的抗生素來對抗抗藥性細菌。

combination.example: A combination of rest and medicine cured her.
combination.example_zh: 休息加上藥物的搭配治好了她。

combine.example: Doctors combine two drugs for a stronger effect.
combine.example_zh: 醫生合併使用兩種藥以增強效果。

comedy.example: A light comedy helped the patients pass the time.
comedy.example_zh: 一部輕鬆的喜劇幫病人打發了時間。

comet.example: A bright comet crossed the night sky.
comet.example_zh: 一顆明亮的彗星劃過夜空。

comic.example: A comic on the wall made the children laugh.
comic.example_zh: 牆上的一幅漫畫逗笑了孩子們。

commander.example: The commander ordered every wounded soldier evacuated.
commander.example_zh: 指揮官下令撤離每一名負傷的士兵。

comment.example: The doctor wrote a brief comment in the chart.
comment.example_zh: 醫生在病歷上寫了簡短的註記。

commentary.example: The textbook had a clear commentary on each diagram.
commentary.example_zh: 這本教科書對每張圖都有清楚的註解。

commentator.example: A medical commentator explained the new vaccine.
commentator.example_zh: 一位醫療評論員解說了這款新疫苗。

commerce.example: The drug trade is a huge part of global commerce.
commerce.example_zh: 藥品貿易是全球商業的一大部分。

commercial.example: The new drug brought huge commercial revenue.
commercial.example_zh: 這款新藥帶來龐大的商業營收。

commission.example: An independent commission reviewed the clinic's records.
commission.example_zh: 一個獨立委員會審查了診所的紀錄。

commissioner.example: The health commissioner ordered an urgent review.
commissioner.example_zh: 衛生首長下令進行緊急檢討。

commit.example: She commits herself fully, devoting every hour to her patients.
commit.example_zh: 她全心投入，把每一小時都奉獻給病人。

commitment.example: Recovery entails real commitment and patience.
commitment.example_zh: 康復需要真正的投入與耐心。

committee.example: A committee reviewed the hospital's safety record.
committee.example_zh: 一個委員會審查了醫院的安全紀錄。

commodious.example: The hotel suite was commodious enough for the whole family.
commodious.example_zh: 這間飯店套房寬敞到足以容納全家人。

commodity.example: Clean water is a precious commodity in the camp.
commodity.example_zh: 在這個營地裡，乾淨的水是寶貴的物資。

communicate.example: It is vital that doctors communicate clearly.
communicate.example_zh: 醫生清楚地溝通至關重要。

communication.example: Clear communication prevents many medical errors.
communication.example_zh: 清楚的溝通能防止許多醫療疏失。

community.example: The clinic serves a large rural community.
community.example_zh: 這間診所服務著廣大的鄉村社區。

compact.example: The clinic packed everything into a compact space.
compact.example_zh: 這間診所把一切塞進了一個緊湊的空間。

companion.example: A faithful companion sat with her every day.
companion.example_zh: 一位忠實的同伴每天陪著她。

company.example: Good company can lift a patient's spirits.
company.example_zh: 好的陪伴能振奮病人的精神。

comparable.example: The two drugs have comparable side effects.
comparable.example_zh: 這兩種藥的副作用相當。

comparative.example: The two drugs were tried in a comparative study.
comparative.example_zh: 這兩種藥在一項比較研究中受測。

compare.example: It helps to compare the scan with last year's image.
compare.example_zh: 把這次掃描和去年的影像比較會有幫助。

comparison.example: In comparison with last year, infections have dropped.
comparison.example_zh: 與去年相比，感染人數下降了。

compartmentalize.example: Surgeons learn to compartmentalize emotions so they can focus during operations.
compartmentalize.example_zh: 外科醫師學會把情緒區隔開來，才能在手術中保持專注。

compassion.example: She treated every patient with warmth and compassion.
compassion.example_zh: 她以溫暖與同情心對待每一位病人。

compel.example: Severe pain compelled him to seek help at once.

compelling.example: There is compelling evidence that the drug works.
compelling.example_zh: 有令人信服的證據顯示這種藥有效。

compensate.example: The good ear compensates for the loss in the other.
compensate.example_zh: 好的那隻耳朵彌補了另一隻的聽力損失。

compensation.example: The body speeds up the heart as compensation to maintain blood flow.
compensation.example_zh: 身體會加快心跳作為代償，以維持血流。

compete.example: The two clinics compete for the same patients.
compete.example_zh: 這兩間診所爭奪同一批病人。

competence.example: No one doubted the surgeon's competence.
competence.example_zh: 沒有人懷疑這位外科醫生的能力。

competent.example: She is a competent nurse, calm under pressure.
competent.example_zh: 她是個能幹的護理師，臨危不亂。

competing.example: The doctors weighed two competing treatments.
competing.example_zh: 醫生們權衡了兩種互相牴觸的療法。

competition.example: There is fierce competition for hospital beds.

compile.example: She compiled a list of his daily medicines.
compile.example_zh: 她整理了一份他每日用藥的清單。

complacent.example: After early success, the team grew complacent and stopped working hard.
complacent.example_zh: 在初期的成功之後，這支團隊變得自滿，不再努力。

complain.example: He began to complain of a sharp pain in his side.
complain.example_zh: 他開始抱怨側腹一陣劇痛。

complaint.example: Her main complaint was a sharp pain in the chest.
complaint.example_zh: 她主要的不適是胸口一陣劇痛。

complementary.example: The two therapies have a complementary effect.
complementary.example_zh: 這兩種療法有互補的效果。

complete.example: Skipping rehab could jeopardize a complete recovery.
complete.example_zh: 略過復健可能會危及完全的康復。

complex.example: The brain is the most complex organ in the body.
complex.example_zh: 大腦是人體中最複雜的器官。

complexity.example: The complexity of the case puzzled the doctors.
complexity.example_zh: 這個病例的複雜讓醫生們困惑。

compliance.example: Good recovery depends on compliance with the plan.
compliance.example_zh: 良好的康復有賴於遵從計畫。

complicate.example: Other illnesses can complicate the treatment.
complicate.example_zh: 其他疾病可能使治療變得複雜。

complicated.example: Her complicated case overturned every early assumption.
complicated.example_zh: 她複雜的病情推翻了一開始的所有假設。

complication.example: A rare complication delayed her recovery.
complication.example_zh: 一個罕見的併發症延緩了她的康復。

compliment.example: He paid her a warm compliment, but she stayed modest about her recovery.
compliment.example_zh: 他熱情地稱讚她，但她對自己的康復仍很謙虛。

complimentary.example: The hotel offered a complimentary health check to guests.
complimentary.example_zh: 飯店為房客提供免費的健康檢查。

comply.example: The clinic must comply with strict safety rules.
comply.example_zh: 這間診所必須遵守嚴格的安全規定。

component.example: Deep sleep is a key component that contributes to recovery.
component.example_zh: 深度睡眠是促進康復的關鍵要素。

compose.example: She tried to compose herself before the surgery.
compose.example_zh: 手術前她試著讓自己鎮定下來。

composer.example: The old composer lost his hearing late in life.
composer.example_zh: 這位老作曲家在晚年失去了聽力。

composition.example: The lab studied the chemical composition of the synthetic dye.
composition.example_zh: 實驗室研究了這種合成染料的化學成分。

compost.example: The garden waste was turned into compost.
compost.example_zh: 花園的廢料被製成了堆肥。

compound.example: The compound is extracted from a rare mountain plant.
compound.example_zh: 這種化合物萃取自一種稀有的高山植物。

comprehend.example: It took years for scientists to fully comprehend how the virus spreads.
comprehend.example_zh: 科學家花了多年才完全理解這種病毒如何傳播。

comprehensive.example: She was given a comprehensive health check.
comprehensive.example_zh: 她接受了一次全面的健康檢查。

comprise.example: The team comprises doctors, nurses, and therapists.
comprise.example_zh: 這個團隊由醫生、護理師和治療師組成。

compromise.example: The two doctors reached a compromise on the dose.
compromise.example_zh: 兩位醫生在劑量上達成了折衷。

compulsorily.example: All staff were compulsorily tested before returning to work.
compulsorily.example_zh: 所有員工在復工前都被強制接受檢測。

conceal.example: He tried to conceal the pain from his family.
conceal.example_zh: 他試圖向家人隱藏疼痛。

concede.example: The doctor conceded that the treatment had failed.
concede.example_zh: 醫生承認這項治療失敗了。

conceive.example: It is hard to conceive how much she suffered.
conceive.example_zh: 很難想像她受了多少苦。

concentrate.example: Intense pain made every intellectual task hard to concentrate on.
concentrate.example_zh: 劇痛讓人難以專注於任何需要動腦的工作。

concept.example: The concept of germs was once widely doubted.
concept.example_zh: 病菌的概念曾一度廣受懷疑。

conception.example: The drug must be avoided around the time of conception.
conception.example_zh: 受孕前後應避免使用這種藥。

conceptual.example: The plan was still at a conceptual stage.
conceptual.example_zh: 這項計畫還在概念階段。

concerned.example: The doctor was concerned and gave only a tentative diagnosis.
concerned.example_zh: 醫師有些擔心，只給了一個暫定的診斷。

concerning.example: She had a question concerning her medication.
concerning.example_zh: 她有個關於用藥的問題。

concert.example: She was well enough to attend a concert again.
concert.example_zh: 她康復到能再次去聽音樂會。

concession.example: The hospital made a concession on the bill.
concession.example_zh: 醫院在帳單上做了讓步。

conclude.example: The doctors concluded that surgery was needed.
conclude.example_zh: 醫生們斷定需要動手術。

concomitant.example: Weight loss was a concomitant symptom of the disease.
concomitant.example_zh: 體重減輕是這種疾病的伴隨症狀。

concrete.example: The doctor gave no concrete answer about the cause.
concrete.example_zh: 醫生對病因沒有給出具體的答案。

condemn.example: The report condemned the clinic's poor hygiene.
condemn.example_zh: 報告譴責了這間診所惡劣的衛生。

condition.example: Her condition improved steadily after surgery.
condition.example_zh: 她的病況在手術後穩定好轉。

conditioning.example: Gentle conditioning rebuilt his weak muscles.
conditioning.example_zh: 溫和的鍛鍊重建了他虛弱的肌肉。

conduct.example: The lab will conduct a full analysis of the sample.
conduct.example_zh: 實驗室將對檢體進行完整的分析。

conductor.example: The nerve acts as a conductor of signals.
conductor.example_zh: 神經充當訊號的傳導體。

cone.example: The eye test used a brightly colored cone.
cone.example_zh: 視力檢查用了一個色彩鮮豔的圓錐。

conference.example: At the conference she demonstrated a new surgical technique.
conference.example_zh: 在研討會上她示範了一種新的手術技術。

confess.example: He confessed that he had not taken his pills.

confession.example: His confession that he had skipped his pills shocked the nurse.
confession.example_zh: 他坦承漏服了藥，令護理師震驚。

confidant.example: She told her closest confidant a secret she shared with no one else.
confidant.example_zh: 她把一個從未對別人說過的秘密告訴了她最親密的知己。

confidence.example: Each small step helped strengthen her confidence.
confidence.example_zh: 每跨出一小步，都有助於增強她的信心。

confident.example: The surgeon was confident the operation would go well.
confident.example_zh: 外科醫生有信心手術會順利。

configuration.example: The new ward has a more open configuration.
configuration.example_zh: 新病房的格局較為開放。

confine.example: The illness confined her to bed for weeks.

confirm.example: A second test was needed to confirm the diagnosis.
confirm.example_zh: 需要第二次檢查來確認診斷。

confirmation.example: She waited anxiously for confirmation of the diagnosis.
confirmation.example_zh: 她焦急地等待診斷的確認。

confiscated.example: Security confiscated the sharp objects at the door.
confiscated.example_zh: 保全在門口沒收了尖銳物品。

conflict.example: A careful comparison revealed a conflict between the two results.
conflict.example_zh: 仔細比對後發現兩項結果之間有矛盾。

confront.example: She had to confront her fear of needles.
confront.example_zh: 她必須面對自己對針的恐懼。

confuse.example: It is easy to confuse the two diseases.
confuse.example_zh: 這兩種疾病很容易被混淆。

confusion.example: Sudden confusion can be a sign of a stroke.
confusion.example_zh: 突然的意識混亂可能是中風的徵兆。

congenial.example: They worked together in a warm, congenial atmosphere.
congenial.example_zh: 他們在溫馨融洽的氣氛中共事。

congress.example: Congress passed legislation funding cancer research.
congress.example_zh: 國會通過了資助癌症研究的立法。

congressional.example: A congressional vote approved the health budget.
congressional.example_zh: 國會表決通過了醫療預算。

congressman.example: A congressman visited the new children's ward.
congressman.example_zh: 一位國會議員參觀了新的兒童病房。

connect.example: A thin tube connects the bag to the vein.
connect.example_zh: 一條細管把點滴袋連到靜脈。

connection.example: Doctors found a connection between the drug and the rash.
connection.example_zh: 醫生發現這種藥與疹子之間有關聯。

conscience.example: His conscience would not let him ignore the sick man.
conscience.example_zh: 他的良心不容許他對這名病人視而不見。

conscientious.example: A conscientious student reviews her notes the same day she takes them.
conscientious.example_zh: 盡責的學生當天就會複習當天的筆記。

conscious.example: The patient was awake and fully conscious.
conscious.example_zh: 病人清醒，意識完全清楚。

consciousness.example: He slowly drifted back to consciousness.

consecutive.example: She worked five consecutive night shifts.

consensus.example: The doctors reached a consensus on the treatment plan.
consensus.example_zh: 醫生們對治療方案達成了共識。

consent.example: The patient gave written consent for the surgery.
consent.example_zh: 病人為手術簽署了書面同意。

consequence.example: Ignoring the symptoms had a serious consequence.
consequence.example_zh: 忽視這些症狀造成了嚴重的後果。

consequently.example: He skipped the dose and consequently fell ill again.
consequently.example_zh: 他漏服了一劑，因此再度病倒。

conservation.example: Energy conservation is vital for a weakened patient.
conservation.example_zh: 對虛弱的病人來說，保存體力至關重要。

conservative.example: The doctor took a conservative approach and avoided surgery.
conservative.example_zh: 醫生採取保守的做法，避免動手術。

consider.example: Doctors must consider the patient's history as fundamental to diagnosis.
consider.example_zh: 醫師必須把病人的病史視為診斷的根本。

considerable.example: The drug brought considerable relief from the pain.
considerable.example_zh: 這種藥大幅緩解了疼痛。

considerably.example: Her health improved considerably this month.
considerably.example_zh: 這個月她的健康狀況大有起色。

considerate.example: The nurses were so considerate that patients deeply appreciated it.
considerate.example_zh: 護理師非常體貼，病人對此深深感激。

consideration.example: The doctor gave her wishes careful consideration.
consideration.example_zh: 醫生仔細考量了她的意願。

consist.example: A balanced meal should consist of several food groups.
consist.example_zh: 均衡的一餐應由多個食物類別組成。

consistency.example: The medicine has the consistency of thick syrup.
consistency.example_zh: 這種藥的稠度像濃稠的糖漿。

consistent.example: Take the drug at a consistent time, not at random.
consistent.example_zh: 固定時間服藥，而非隨意亂服。

consistently.example: She consistently took her pills on time.
consistently.example_zh: 她始終如一地準時服藥。

consolidation.example: The consolidation of several small clinics into one hospital improved efficiency.
consolidation.example_zh: 將數家小診所合併成一家醫院後，效率大為提升。

conspicuous.example: The bright red rash was conspicuous against her pale skin.
conspicuous.example_zh: 鮮紅的疹子在她蒼白的皮膚上格外顯眼。

conspiracy.example: He spread a wild conspiracy about the vaccine.
conspiracy.example_zh: 他散布了一則關於疫苗的離譜陰謀論。

constant.example: Patients in constant pain often cling to any hope.
constant.example_zh: 長期疼痛的病人常會緊抓住任何一線希望。

constantly.example: The monitor beeps constantly through the night.
constantly.example_zh: 監測儀整夜不停地嗶嗶作響。

constipation.example: A diet low in fiber often leads to constipation.
constipation.example_zh: 低纖維的飲食常會導致便秘。

constituent.example: Each constituent of the drug was tested.
constituent.example_zh: 這種藥的每個成分都經過檢驗。

constitute.example: Three missed doses constitute a real risk.
constitute.example_zh: 漏服三次藥構成真正的風險。

constitution.example: He has a strong constitution and rarely falls ill.

constitutional.example: His constitutional weakness made recovery slow.
constitutional.example_zh: 他體質上的虛弱使康復變得緩慢。

constraint.example: Time was the biggest constraint in the surgery.
constraint.example_zh: 時間是這場手術最大的限制。

construct.example: Workers will construct a new wing for the clinic.
construct.example_zh: 工人將為診所興建一座新側翼。

construction.example: Noise from the construction disturbed the patients.
construction.example_zh: 施工的噪音打擾了病人。

consult.example: Always consult a doctor before stopping a drug.

consultant.example: A heart consultant reviewed her case.
consultant.example_zh: 一位心臟科顧問醫師看了她的病例。

consume.example: Patients should consume plenty of fluids to maintain hydration.
consume.example_zh: 病人應攝取大量水分以維持身體的水分平衡。

consumer.example: Patients, as consumers, deserve strong protection.
consumer.example_zh: 病人作為消費者，理應受到有力的保護。

consumption.example: Excessive salt consumption raises blood pressure.
consumption.example_zh: 過量攝取鹽分會使血壓升高。

contact.example: Avoid close contact with anyone who is sick.
contact.example_zh: 避免與任何生病的人密切接觸。

contagious.example: Measles is highly contagious and spreads through the air.
contagious.example_zh: 麻疹傳染性極強，會透過空氣傳播。

contain.example: This supplement is said to contain several essential vitamins.
contain.example_zh: 據說這款保健品含有多種必需維生素。

container.example: Store the tablets in their original container.
container.example_zh: 藥片請存放在原本的容器裡。

contemplate.example: He had time to contemplate his life while ill.
contemplate.example_zh: 生病期間他有時間沉思自己的人生。

contemporary.example: Contemporary medicine relies heavily on imaging.
contemporary.example_zh: 當代醫學十分仰賴影像檢查。

contempt.example: He treated the fake cure with open contempt.
contempt.example_zh: 他對這種假療法毫不掩飾地嗤之以鼻。

contemptuous.example: He was contemptuous of every plausible alternative.
contemptuous.example_zh: 他對任何看似合理的替代方案都嗤之以鼻。

contend.example: Many patients have to contend with chronic pain.
contend.example_zh: 許多病人必須與慢性疼痛搏鬥。

content.example: He was perfectly content to recover quietly at home.
content.example_zh: 他很滿足於在家靜靜養病。

contentious.example: Funding for the project remains a contentious issue in the committee.
contentious.example_zh: 該計畫的經費在委員會中仍是個有爭議的議題。

contentment.example: A simple life brought her a deep sense of contentment and peace.
contentment.example_zh: 簡樸的生活帶給她深深的滿足與平靜。

contest.example: Quitting smoking felt like a daily contest.
contest.example_zh: 戒菸感覺像是每天的一場較量。

context.example: A word's meaning often depends on its context.
context.example_zh: 一個字的意思往往取決於它的上下文。

continent.example: The disease spread across the whole continent.
continent.example_zh: 這種病蔓延了整個大陸。

continually.example: The pump beeps continually until it is reset.
continually.example_zh: 這台幫浦會持續嗶嗶叫，直到被重設。

continuous.example: The patient needs continuous monitoring overnight.
continuous.example_zh: 病人需要整夜持續的監測。

contract.example: Babies can contract the infection from their mother.
contract.example_zh: 嬰兒可能從母親身上感染這種疾病。

contractor.example: A contractor built the new wing in record time.
contractor.example_zh: 一位承包商以破紀錄的速度蓋好了新側翼。

contradictory.example: The two studies reached completely contradictory conclusions.
contradictory.example_zh: 這兩項研究得出了完全相互矛盾的結論。

contrary.example: Contrary to fears, the surgery went smoothly.
contrary.example_zh: 與大家的擔憂相反，手術很順利。

contrast.example: In contrast to last year, infections are down.
contrast.example_zh: 與去年相比，感染人數下降了。

contribute.example: Poor sleep can contribute to high blood pressure.
contribute.example_zh: 睡眠不足可能造成高血壓。

control.example: The drug helps control his blood pressure.
control.example_zh: 這種藥幫助控制他的血壓。

controversial.example: The controversial drug was pulled from the market.
controversial.example_zh: 這款引發爭議的藥被撤出市場。

controversy.example: The new treatment sparked a heated controversy.
controversy.example_zh: 這項新療法引發了激烈的爭議。

convenience.example: The clinic opens late for the convenience of workers.
convenience.example_zh: 這間診所為了上班族的方便而開到很晚。

convenient.example: The clinic's hours are convenient for working parents.
convenient.example_zh: 這間診所的時間對上班的家長很方便。

convention.example: By established convention, hands are washed before each patient.
convention.example_zh: 依照既有慣例，每次看診前都要洗手。

conventional.example: They tried conventional medicine before herbal remedies.
conventional.example_zh: 他們先嘗試了常規西醫治療，才改用草藥療法。

conversation.example: A quiet conversation calmed the anxious patient.
conversation.example_zh: 一段平靜的交談安撫了焦慮的病人。

conversion.example: The conversion of the old ward took six months.
conversion.example_zh: 舊病房的改建花了六個月。

convert.example: The old ward was converted into a research lab.
convert.example_zh: 舊病房被改建成研究實驗室。

converted.example: The old library was converted into a lab to facilitate research.
converted.example_zh: 舊圖書館被改建成實驗室，以促進研究。

convey.example: The nurse tried to convey hope to the family.
convey.example_zh: 護理師試著把希望傳達給家屬。

convict.example: The convict was treated in the prison clinic.
convict.example_zh: 這名囚犯在監獄診所接受治療。

conviction.example: Her calm conviction won over the skeptical patient.
conviction.example_zh: 她沉靜的信念說服了原本存疑的病人。

convince.example: A clear demonstration will convince him to try therapy.
convince.example_zh: 一次清楚的示範會說服他嘗試治療。

convinced.example: She was convinced the treatment would work.
convinced.example_zh: 她確信這項治療會有效。

convincing.example: The trial gave convincing proof of the drug's value.
convincing.example_zh: 這項試驗給出了藥物價值的有力證明。

cooperate.example: The patient agreed to cooperate with the tests.
cooperate.example_zh: 病人同意配合接受檢查。

cooperation.example: Recovery requires close cooperation with the doctor.
cooperation.example_zh: 康復需要與醫生密切配合。

cooperative.example: A cooperative, curious patient asks good questions.
cooperative.example_zh: 一個配合又好奇的病人會問出好問題。

coordinate.example: The team coordinated their care of the patient.
coordinate.example_zh: 團隊協調了對這名病人的照護。

coordination.example: The illness slowly affected his hand coordination.
coordination.example_zh: 這種病慢慢影響了他手部的協調。

cope.example: Over time she built a tolerance and learned to cope with pain.
cope.example_zh: 久而久之她建立了耐受度，學會與疼痛共處。
