copper.example: Copper pipes carried clean water to the ward.
copper.example_zh: 銅管把乾淨的水輸送到病房。

copy.example: Register first, then ask for a copy of your records.
copy.example_zh: 先登記，再索取你的病歷副本。

coral.example: Diving near the coral, he cut his foot.
coral.example_zh: 在珊瑚附近潛水時，他割傷了腳。

cord.example: The doctor cut and tied the baby's cord.
cord.example_zh: 醫生剪斷並結紮了嬰兒的臍帶。

core.example: A strong core helps prevent back pain.
core.example_zh: 強健的核心肌群有助於預防背痛。

corn.example: Fresh corn is a good source of fiber.
corn.example_zh: 新鮮的玉米是良好的纖維來源。

corporate.example: The clinic is owned by a large corporate group.
corporate.example_zh: 這間診所由一個大型企業集團擁有。

corps.example: A medical corps was sent to the disaster zone.
corps.example_zh: 一支醫療隊被派往災區。

corpse.example: The corpse was taken to the morgue for examination.
corpse.example_zh: 屍體被送往太平間檢驗。

correct.example: The nurse made sure the dose was correct.

correlate.example: Poor sleep correlates with a weaker immune system.
correlate.example_zh: 睡眠不足與較弱的免疫系統相關。

correspond.example: His symptoms correspond to a mild infection.
correspond.example_zh: 他的症狀符合輕微的感染。

correspondence.example: She kept up a warm correspondence with her old doctor.
correspondence.example_zh: 她和她的老醫生一直保持著溫暖的書信往來。

correspondent.example: A health correspondent reported on the outbreak.
correspondent.example_zh: 一名衛生線記者報導了這場疫情。

corridor.example: She walked slowly down the long corridor.
corridor.example_zh: 她沿著長長的走廊慢慢走著。

corrupt.example: A corrupt official sold the donated drugs.
corrupt.example_zh: 一名貪腐的官員把捐贈的藥品賣掉了。

corruption.example: Corruption left the public hospitals starved of funds.
corruption.example_zh: 貪腐使公立醫院經費拮据。

cosmic.example: Looking up at the cosmic scale of the night sky, her worries felt small.
cosmic.example_zh: 抬頭望向宇宙般浩瀚的夜空，她的煩惱顯得渺小。

costume.example: The volunteer wore a clown costume for the children.
costume.example_zh: 志工為孩子們穿上小丑裝。

cotton.example: The nurse pressed a ball of cotton on the cut.
cotton.example_zh: 護理師用一團棉花按住傷口。

counsel.example: The doctor's counsel was to wait and watch.
counsel.example_zh: 醫生的建議是觀察等待。

counseling.example: The hospital offers free counseling to families.
counseling.example_zh: 醫院為家屬提供免費的諮商。

counselor.example: A counselor helped her cope with the diagnosis.
counselor.example_zh: 一位諮商師幫助她面對這個診斷。

counterpart.example: The generic drug is cheaper than its branded counterpart.
counterpart.example_zh: 這種學名藥比它的品牌對應產品便宜。

countless.example: Countless lives have been saved by the vaccine.
countless.example_zh: 這款疫苗拯救了無數的生命。

coup.example: Saving the patient was a real medical coup.
coup.example_zh: 救活這名病人是醫療上的一大成就。

couple.example: The elderly couple visited the clinic together.
couple.example_zh: 這對年長的夫妻一起來到診所。

court.example: The clinic was taken to court over the error.
court.example_zh: 這間診所因這項疏失被告上法庭。

courteous.example: The staff were courteous even under great pressure.
courteous.example_zh: 即使在巨大壓力下，員工仍彬彬有禮。

courthouse.example: The injured clerk was treated near the courthouse.
courthouse.example_zh: 受傷的職員在法院附近接受了治療。

cover.example: A clean dressing should cover the wound.
cover.example_zh: 乾淨的敷料應覆蓋傷口。

coverage.example: His insurance coverage included a provision for home care.
coverage.example_zh: 他的保險給付包含居家照護的條款。

cow.example: Fresh milk came from the farm's own cows.
cow.example_zh: 新鮮的牛奶來自農場自己養的乳牛。

cowboy.example: The injured cowboy was thrown from his horse.
cowboy.example_zh: 這名受傷的牛仔從馬背上摔了下來。

crab.example: He came out in a rash after eating crab.
crab.example_zh: 他吃了螃蟹後起了疹子。

crack.example: A small crack appeared in the bone.
crack.example_zh: 骨頭上出現了一道小裂縫。

craft.example: Surgery is as much a craft as a science.
craft.example_zh: 外科手術既是科學，也是一門手藝。

crash.example: He broke three ribs in the car crash.
crash.example_zh: 他在車禍中斷了三根肋骨。

crawl.example: The baby could barely crawl across the floor.
crawl.example_zh: 寶寶才剛能勉強在地上爬。

crazy.example: The pain was so bad it nearly drove him crazy.
crazy.example_zh: 疼痛劇烈到幾乎把他逼瘋。

credential.example: Her credentials as a surgeon were impressive.
credential.example_zh: 她身為外科醫生的資歷令人印象深刻。

credible.example: The patient gave a credible account of the fall.
credible.example_zh: 病人對這次跌倒給出了可信的說法。

credit.example: The nurse deserves credit for spotting the problem.
credit.example_zh: 這位護理師發現問題，值得讚賞。

creditable.example: The young doctor gave a creditable performance under pressure.
creditable.example_zh: 這位年輕醫生在壓力下表現可圈可點。

credulous.example: Credulous patients are easily fooled by false cures.
credulous.example_zh: 輕信的病人容易被假療法所騙。

creek.example: The clinic stood beside a small creek.
creek.example_zh: 這間診所坐落在一條小溪旁。

creep.example: A cold fear began to creep over her.
creep.example_zh: 一股冰冷的恐懼開始悄悄爬上她的心頭。

crew.example: The ambulance crew arrived within minutes.
crew.example_zh: 救護車組員在幾分鐘內就抵達。

crisp.example: She nibbled a crisp cracker between doses.
crisp.example_zh: 她在兩劑藥之間啃了一塊脆餅乾。

criteria.example: The patient met all the criteria for the trial.
criteria.example_zh: 這名病人符合試驗的所有條件。

criterion.example: Age is just one criterion for the surgery.
criterion.example_zh: 年齡只是這項手術的一個標準。

critic.example: Even his harshest critic praised the surgery.
critic.example_zh: 連他最嚴厲的批評者都讚揚這次手術。

critical.example: Internal bleeding is critical and must be treated at once.
critical.example_zh: 內出血很危急，必須立刻處理。

critique.example: The doctor wrote a critique of the new method.
critique.example_zh: 醫生對這種新方法寫了一篇評論。

cross.example: Do not cross your legs right after the surgery.

crossing.example: He was hit by a car at the crossing.
crossing.example_zh: 他在路口被一輛車撞了。

crowd.example: A crowd gathered outside the emergency room.
crowd.example_zh: 急診室外聚集了一群人。

crown.example: The dentist fitted a crown on the broken tooth.
crown.example_zh: 牙醫為這顆斷牙裝上牙冠。

crucial.example: The first hour after a stroke is crucial.
crucial.example_zh: 中風後的第一個小時至關重要。

crude.example: In the field, they used a crude but effective splint.
crude.example_zh: 在野外，他們用了一個簡陋卻有效的夾板。

cruel.example: It seemed cruel that she fell ill on her birthday.
cruel.example_zh: 她偏偏在生日當天病倒，似乎很殘忍。

crush.example: He crushed the pill and mixed it into her food.
crush.example_zh: 他把藥丸壓碎，混進她的食物裡。

crust.example: A dry crust formed over the healing wound.
crust.example_zh: 癒合的傷口上結了一層乾痂。

crutch.example: After breaking his ankle, he had to walk on crutches for six weeks.
crutch.example_zh: 摔斷腳踝後，他得拄著拐杖走路六個星期。

crystal.example: The kidney stone was made of tiny crystals.
crystal.example_zh: 這顆腎結石是由微小的結晶組成的。

cuban.example: The Cuban doctor had trained in three countries.
cuban.example_zh: 這位古巴醫生曾在三個國家受訓。

cube.example: She dropped a cube of ice into the water.
cube.example_zh: 她把一塊冰塊丟進水裡。

cue.example: A nod from the surgeon was the cue to begin.
cue.example_zh: 外科醫生點頭就是開始的暗號。

culprit.example: Investigators finally identified the real culprit behind the data breach.
culprit.example_zh: 調查人員終於查出這起資料外洩事件背後的真正禍首。

cult.example: The fake healer ran a dangerous cult.
cult.example_zh: 這名假治療師經營著一個危險的邪教。

cultivate.example: A doctor must cultivate the trust of her patients.
cultivate.example_zh: 醫生必須培養病人的信任。

culture.example: A warm, fertile culture let the bacteria multiply fast.
culture.example_zh: 溫暖肥沃的培養基讓細菌快速繁殖。

curator.example: The curator gave a tour of the medical museum.
curator.example_zh: 館長帶領參觀了醫學博物館。

cure.example: There is still no cure for the common cold.
cure.example_zh: 普通感冒至今仍無法根治。

curiosity.example: Her curiosity about the body led her to medicine.
curiosity.example_zh: 她對人體的好奇引領她走向醫學。

curious.example: The student was curious about the body's internal defenses.
curious.example_zh: 這名學生對身體的內部防禦感到好奇。

currency.example: Trust is the real currency between doctor and patient.
currency.example_zh: 信任是醫病之間真正的通貨。

current.example: The current treatment is working better than the last.
current.example_zh: 目前的治療比上一個有效。

currently.example: She is currently taking three different drugs.
currently.example_zh: 她目前正在服用三種不同的藥。

curriculum.example: Anatomy is a core part of the medical curriculum.
curriculum.example_zh: 解剖學是醫學課程的核心部分。

curtail.example: The hospital had to curtail visiting hours during the outbreak.
curtail.example_zh: 疫情期間，醫院不得不縮減探病時間。

curtain.example: The nurse drew the curtain for some privacy.
curtain.example_zh: 護理師拉上簾子以保有隱私。

curve.example: The chart showed a steady curve of recovery.
curve.example_zh: 圖表顯示出一條穩定的康復曲線。

custody.example: The drugs are kept in the pharmacist's custody.

custom.example: It is the ward's custom to greet each new patient.
custom.example_zh: 問候每位新病人是這個病房的習慣。

customer.example: The pharmacy treats every customer with patience.
customer.example_zh: 這家藥局耐心對待每一位顧客。

cynical.example: Years of broken promises had made him cynical.
cynical.example_zh: 多年來不斷被毀棄的承諾使他變得憤世嫉俗。

dairy.example: He avoids dairy because it upsets his stomach.
dairy.example_zh: 他避吃乳製品，因為會讓他的胃不舒服。

dam.example: The new dam changed the flow of the river.
dam.example_zh: 新水壩改變了這條河的水流。

damn.example: He didn't give a damn about his own health.
damn.example_zh: 他對自己的健康毫不在乎。

damp.example: A damp cloth cooled the feverish child's brow.
damp.example_zh: 一塊溼布讓發燒孩子的額頭涼了下來。

dangerous.example: A high fever can be dangerous if ignored.
dangerous.example_zh: 高燒若被忽視可能很危險。

dangle.example: The drip tube dangled beside the bed.

date.example: The pills are past their use-by date.
date.example_zh: 這些藥丸已過了有效期限。

dawn.example: She finally fell asleep just before dawn.
dawn.example_zh: 她終於在天亮前睡著了。

dead.example: The dead tissue was cut away to save the remaining limb.
dead.example_zh: 切除壞死組織以保住剩餘的肢體。

deadly.example: The bite of this snake is deadly without treatment.
deadly.example_zh: 這種蛇若不治療，咬傷足以致命。

deal.example: Patients deal with fear better when staff show empathy.
deal.example_zh: 當醫護展現同理心，病人更能面對恐懼。

dealer.example: The art dealer donated a painting to the ward.
dealer.example_zh: 這位藝術品商捐了一幅畫給病房。

dealing.example: Honest dealing with patients builds trust.
dealing.example_zh: 與病人誠實往來能建立信任。

debate.example: There is ongoing debate about the drug's safety.
debate.example_zh: 關於這種藥的安全性，爭論仍在持續。

debris.example: Surgeons cleaned the wound of dirt and debris.
debris.example_zh: 外科醫生清除了傷口裡的汙物與碎屑。

debt.example: The surgery left the family deep in debt.
debt.example_zh: 這場手術讓這家人負債累累。

debut.example: The young surgeon made her debut in the operating room.
debut.example_zh: 這位年輕外科醫生在手術室首次登場。

decay.example: Without brushing, teeth begin to decay as bacteria erode the enamel.
decay.example_zh: 若不刷牙，細菌侵蝕琺瑯質，牙齒便開始蛀蝕腐壞。

decent.example: After surgery he finally got a decent night's sleep.
decent.example_zh: 手術後他終於睡了個像樣的好覺。

deceptive.example: The calm before a seizure can be deceptive.
deceptive.example_zh: 癲癇發作前的平靜可能具有欺騙性。

decide.example: The doctors will decide tomorrow whether to operate.
decide.example_zh: 醫生明天會決定是否動手術。

decimate.example: The epidemic decimated the population of the small village.
decimate.example_zh: 這場流行病使這個小村莊的人口大量減少。

deck.example: He took a slow walk around the ship's deck.
deck.example_zh: 他在船的甲板上慢慢走了一圈。

declaration.example: She signed a declaration of consent before surgery.
declaration.example_zh: 手術前她簽署了一份同意聲明。

declare.example: The country declared the epidemic over.

decline.example: His decline was slow but, sadly, inevitable.
decline.example_zh: 他的衰退雖慢，卻令人遺憾地無可避免。

decorate.example: The children helped decorate the ward for the festival.
decorate.example_zh: 孩子們幫忙布置病房過節。

decoration.example: Simple decoration made the ward feel less clinical.
decoration.example_zh: 簡單的布置讓病房少了點冰冷的醫療感。

decrease.example: There was a steady decrease in his fever.

dedicate.example: She chose to dedicate her life to caring for others.
dedicate.example_zh: 她選擇把一生奉獻給照顧他人。

dedication.example: Her dedication to her patients earned the respect of every colleague.
dedication.example_zh: 她對病人的奉獻贏得了每位同事的尊敬。

deed.example: A kind deed by the nurse lifted his spirits.
deed.example_zh: 護理師的一個善舉振奮了他的精神。

deem.example: The doctor deemed him fit to go home.

defeat.example: Early detection can mean defeat for the disease.
defeat.example_zh: 早期發現可能意味著戰勝這種疾病。

defect.example: The baby was born with a small heart defect.
defect.example_zh: 這名嬰兒生來就有一個小小的心臟缺陷。

defective.example: The company recalled thousands of cars because of a defective brake part.
defective.example_zh: 由於煞車零件有瑕疵，該公司召回了數千輛汽車。

defend.example: The body's white cells defend it against germs.
defend.example_zh: 身體的白血球保衛它抵抗病菌。

defendant.example: The clinic was the defendant in the lawsuit.
defendant.example_zh: 這間診所是這宗訴訟的被告。

defense.example: Vaccines reinforce the body's natural defense against germs.
defense.example_zh: 疫苗強化身體對抗病菌的天然防禦。

defensive.example: The body's defensive cells attack the bacteria.
defensive.example_zh: 身體的防禦細胞會攻擊細菌。

deficiency.example: A deficiency of vitamin D can lead to weakened bones.
deficiency.example_zh: 維生素 D 缺乏可能導致骨骼變弱。

deficit.example: The tests revealed a deficit in his short-term memory.
deficit.example_zh: 檢查顯示他的短期記憶有缺損。

definitely.example: The scan definitely shows a fracture.
definitely.example_zh: 這張掃描明確顯示有骨折。

definition.example: The textbook gives a clear definition of the term.
definition.example_zh: 教科書對這個術語給出了清楚的定義。

deflect.example: The politician tried to deflect every difficult question with a joke.
deflect.example_zh: 那位政治人物試圖用笑話迴避每一個棘手的問題。

defy.example: Her recovery seemed to defy all the odds.
defy.example_zh: 她的康復彷彿違背了一切機率。

degeneration.example: The disease causes a slow degeneration of the nerves.
degeneration.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成神經的緩慢退化。

dehydrate.example: A high fever can quickly dehydrate a small child.
dehydrate.example_zh: 高燒可能很快讓幼童脫水。

delay.example: Any delay in treatment can be dangerous.
delay.example_zh: 治療上的任何延誤都可能很危險。

delegate.example: The hospital sent a delegate to the conference.
delegate.example_zh: 醫院派了一名代表參加會議。

deliberate.example: She made a deliberate choice to change her diet.
deliberate.example_zh: 她有意識地選擇改變飲食。

deliberately.example: She deliberately abused her authority to silence critics.
deliberately.example_zh: 她故意濫用職權來壓制批評者。

delicate.example: The surgeon's work on the eye was extremely delicate.
delicate.example_zh: 外科醫生在眼睛上的手術極為精細。

delicious.example: After days of fasting, the soup tasted delicious.
delicious.example_zh: 禁食數日後，這碗湯嚐起來美味極了。

delineate.example: The report clearly delineates each step of the procedure.
delineate.example_zh: 這份報告清楚地勾勒出手術的每個步驟。

delineates.example: The manual clearly delineates each safety step.
delineates.example_zh: 這本手冊清楚地界定了每個安全步驟。

delinquency.example: The clinic struggles with the delinquency of unpaid bills.
delinquency.example_zh: 這間診所為帳單拖欠的問題而苦惱。

delinquent.example: The hospital sent reminders to patients with delinquent accounts.
delinquent.example_zh: 醫院向帳款逾期的病人寄出催繳通知。

delirious.example: The patient's fever was so high that he became delirious and saw things.
delirious.example_zh: 病人的高燒嚴重到出現譫妄，開始看見幻覺。

demand.example: The flu season put huge demand on the clinic.
demand.example_zh: 流感季為診所帶來巨大的需求。

demanding.example: Nursing is a physically demanding job.
demanding.example_zh: 護理是一份體力負荷很重的工作。

demeanor.example: Despite the chaos around her, the nurse kept a calm, professional demeanor.
demeanor.example_zh: 儘管周遭一片混亂，那位護理師仍保持冷靜、專業的舉止。

democracy.example: Democracy rests on a philosophy of equal voice.
democracy.example_zh: 民主建立在人人平等發聲的理念之上。

democrat.example: The senator is a lifelong democrat.
democrat.example_zh: 這位參議員是終生的民主黨人。

demonstrate.example: The nurse demonstrated how to clean the wound.
demonstrate.example_zh: 護理師示範了如何清理傷口。

demonstration.example: The nurse gave a demonstration of how to inject insulin.
demonstration.example_zh: 護理師示範了如何注射胰島素。

den.example: The fox lay sick in its earthy den.
den.example_zh: 那隻狐狸生病了，躺在牠的土穴裡。

denigrate.example: He constantly denigrates his colleagues to make himself look better.
denigrate.example_zh: 他不斷詆毀同事，好讓自己顯得更出色。

denote.example: On the chart, a red dot denotes an abnormal result.
denote.example_zh: 在圖表上，紅點表示異常的結果。

denounce.example: Experts denounced the fake cure as dangerous.
denounce.example_zh: 專家譴責這種假療法很危險。

dense.example: The X-ray showed a dense white spot on the lung.
dense.example_zh: X 光顯示肺部有一個緻密的白點。

density.example: The scan measures the density of the bone.
density.example_zh: 這項掃描測量骨骼的密度。

dentist.example: The dentist gently checked her aching tooth.
dentist.example_zh: 牙醫輕輕地檢查了她疼痛的牙齒。

deny.example: He could no longer deny that something was wrong.
deny.example_zh: 他再也無法否認身體出了問題。

depart.example: She did not depart the hospital until she was fully well.
depart.example_zh: 她直到完全康復才離開醫院。

departure.example: Her departure from hospital was a happy day.
departure.example_zh: 她出院的那天是個快樂的日子。

dependable.example: She is the most dependable nurse on the night shift.
dependable.example_zh: 她是夜班裡最可靠的護理師。

dependence.example: Long use of the drug can lead to dependence.
dependence.example_zh: 長期使用這種藥可能導致依賴。

dependent.example: After the stroke he became dependent on his family.
dependent.example_zh: 中風後，他變得依賴家人。

depict.example: The chart depicts how the disease spreads.
depict.example_zh: 這張圖描繪了疾病如何傳播。

deplete.example: Intense exercise can quickly deplete the body's energy reserves.
deplete.example_zh: 劇烈運動會迅速耗盡身體的能量儲備。

deplored.example: Critics deplored the cuts to the health budget.
deplored.example_zh: 批評者強烈譴責削減醫療預算的做法。

deported.example: The court issued a mandate to have him deported.
deported.example_zh: 法院發出將他遣返的命令。

deposit.example: A fatty deposit had narrowed the artery.
deposit.example_zh: 一處脂肪沉積使動脈變窄了。

depressed.example: He felt depressed during the long recovery.
depressed.example_zh: 漫長的康復期讓他感到憂鬱。

depression.example: Depression slowly drained her energy and her engagement with friends.
depression.example_zh: 憂鬱慢慢耗盡了她的精力，以及她與朋友的往來。

deprivation.example: Long-term sleep deprivation harms the immune system.
deprivation.example_zh: 長期的睡眠剝奪會損害免疫系統。

deprive.example: Illness deprived him of a normal childhood.
deprive.example_zh: 疾病剝奪了他正常的童年。

deputy.example: The deputy director ran the clinic in her absence.
deputy.example_zh: 副主任在她不在時打理診所。

derivative.example: Aspirin is a derivative of a substance found in willow bark.
derivative.example_zh: 阿斯匹靈是柳樹皮中一種物質的衍生物。

derive.example: The medicine is derived from a tropical plant.
derive.example_zh: 這種藥提取自一種熱帶植物。

descend.example: A calm seemed to descend over the ward at night.
descend.example_zh: 夜裡一股平靜彷彿籠罩了整個病房。

descendant.example: He is a descendant of a long line of doctors.
descendant.example_zh: 他是一個醫生世家的後代。

descent.example: The patient's slow descent into sleep worried no one.
descent.example_zh: 病人緩緩入睡，沒人擔心。

desert.example: The travelers ran low on water crossing the desert.
desert.example_zh: 旅人們穿越沙漠時水快用盡了。

deserve.example: After such service, she deserves the privilege of a long rest.
deserve.example_zh: 付出這麼多後，她理當享有長假的優待。

design.example: The new ward was built to a child-friendly design.
design.example_zh: 新病房以兒童友善的設計建造。

designate.example: The doctor designated a nurse to watch him.
designate.example_zh: 醫生指派了一名護理師看守他。

designer.example: A designer planned the calming layout of the ward.
designer.example_zh: 一位設計師規劃了病房令人放鬆的格局。

desirable.example: A quiet room is desirable for a resting patient.
desirable.example_zh: 安靜的房間對休息中的病人是理想的。

desire.example: She had a strong desire to recover quickly.
desire.example_zh: 她有強烈的渴望想快點康復。

desist.example: The court ordered the firm to desist from making misleading health claims.
desist.example_zh: 法院命令該公司停止發布誤導性的健康聲明。

desperate.example: The family was desperate for any kind of cure.
desperate.example_zh: 這家人迫切渴望任何能治癒的方法。

desperately.example: She fought desperately to stay awake.
desperately.example_zh: 她拚命掙扎著想保持清醒。

dessert.example: She skipped dessert to control her blood sugar.
dessert.example_zh: 她不吃甜點以控制血糖。

destination.example: The ambulance reached its destination in minutes.
destination.example_zh: 救護車在幾分鐘內抵達了目的地。

destiny.example: She felt that nursing was her destiny.
destiny.example_zh: 她覺得護理是她的天命。

destruction.example: The disease causes the destruction of healthy tissue.
destruction.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成健康組織的破壞。

destructive.example: The disease is slow but ultimately destructive.
destructive.example_zh: 這種病進展緩慢，但終究具破壞性。

detachment.example: The patient was diagnosed with retinal detachment.
detachment.example_zh: 病人被診斷出視網膜剝離。

detect.example: The scan can detect tumors at an early stage.
detect.example_zh: 這項掃描能在早期偵測出腫瘤。

detection.example: Early detection of the tumor saved her life.
detection.example_zh: 早期發現腫瘤救了她一命。

detective.example: Diagnosing the rare illness was like detective work.
detective.example_zh: 診斷這種罕見疾病就像偵探辦案。

determination.example: Her determination to walk again amazed everyone.
determination.example_zh: 她重新走路的決心讓所有人驚嘆。

determine.example: Tests will determine whether the cells are cancerous.
determine.example_zh: 檢查將判定這些細胞是否為癌細胞。

detestable.example: Most people find cruelty to animals utterly detestable.
detestable.example_zh: 大多數人都覺得虐待動物的行為令人深惡痛絕。

detested.example: As a child she detested the taste of cough syrup.
detested.example_zh: 小時候她極討厭咳嗽糖漿的味道。

devastating.example: The diagnosis was devastating news for the whole family.
devastating.example_zh: 這個診斷對全家來說是毀滅性的消息。

develop.example: Some patients develop a rash after the injection.
develop.example_zh: 有些病人在注射後會出現疹子。

deviant.example: Researchers studied why some individuals develop deviant behavior in society.
deviant.example_zh: 研究人員探討為何某些人會發展出偏離常軌的行為。

device.example: A small device monitors his heart rhythm.
device.example_zh: 一個小裝置監測他的心律。

devise.example: The team devised a new way to ease the pain.
devise.example_zh: 團隊想出了一種緩解疼痛的新方法。

devote.example: She devoted her life to rural medicine.
devote.example_zh: 她把一生奉獻給了鄉村醫療。

devoted.example: She was a devoted nurse who never gave up.
devoted.example_zh: 她是個盡心盡力、從不放棄的護理師。

diabetes.example: Her diabetes is controlled with daily insulin.
diabetes.example_zh: 她的糖尿病靠每天施打胰島素來控制。

diagnose.example: It can be hard to diagnose the illness early on.
diagnose.example_zh: 這種病在早期可能很難診斷。

diagnosis.example: An early diagnosis greatly improves the chance of recovery.
diagnosis.example_zh: 早期診斷能大幅提高康復的機會。

dialogue.example: Honest dialogue and cooperation build trust with patients.
dialogue.example_zh: 誠實的對話與合作能與病人建立信任。

diameter.example: The tumor was about a centimeter in diameter.
diameter.example_zh: 這顆腫瘤的直徑約一公分。

diarrhea.example: The infection left him with fever and diarrhea.
diarrhea.example_zh: 這次感染讓他發燒並腹瀉。

dichotomy.example: There is a false dichotomy between traditional medicine and modern science.
dichotomy.example_zh: 把傳統醫學與現代科學對立起來，是一種錯誤的二分法。

dictate.example: The doctor dictated her notes to the nurse.
dictate.example_zh: 醫生口述她的筆記讓護理師記下。

dictator.example: The country suffered for decades under a ruthless dictator.
dictator.example_zh: 這個國家在殘酷的獨裁者統治下苦了數十年。

didactic.example: The novel felt too didactic, lecturing readers instead of telling a story.
didactic.example_zh: 這部小說過於說教，只顧訓誡讀者，而非講述故事。

die.example: Without the transplant, he would surely die.

diet.example: A healthy diet can lower your risk of heart disease.
diet.example_zh: 健康的飲食能降低你罹患心臟病的風險。

dietary.example: The doctor suggested several dietary changes to lower his cholesterol.
dietary.example_zh: 醫生建議他在飲食上做幾項改變以降低膽固醇。

dignity.example: The hospice let her die with dignity.
dignity.example_zh: 安寧病房讓她有尊嚴地離世。

dilemma.example: The doctor faced a hard ethical dilemma.
dilemma.example_zh: 醫生面臨一個棘手的道德兩難。

dilute.example: Dilute the medicine with water before giving it to a child.
dilute.example_zh: 給孩子服用前，先用水稀釋藥物。

dim.example: The nurse dimmed the lights for the night.
dim.example_zh: 護理師把燈光調暗準備過夜。

dimension.example: The scan measures the dimension of the tumor.

diminish.example: The swelling will diminish over the next week.
diminish.example_zh: 腫脹會在接下來一週內消退。

dinosaur.example: The child loved the dinosaur painted on the ward wall.
dinosaur.example_zh: 這孩子很喜歡病房牆上畫的恐龍。

dioxide.example: Carbon dioxide is breathed out by the lungs.

diplomacy.example: It took some diplomacy to calm the angry patient.
diplomacy.example_zh: 安撫這名憤怒的病人費了一番交際手腕。

diplomatic.example: The doctor was diplomatic in breaking the bad news.
diplomatic.example_zh: 醫生在告知壞消息時很有分寸。

direct.example: The nurse gave him direct, simple instructions.
direct.example_zh: 護理師給了他直接而簡單的指示。

disadvantage.example: Poor sleep puts the body at a disadvantage.
disadvantage.example_zh: 睡眠不足讓身體處於劣勢。

disappointment.example: The failed treatment was a deep disappointment.
disappointment.example_zh: 治療失敗是個深深的失望。

disaster.example: The outbreak turned into a public health disaster.
disaster.example_zh: 這場疫情演變成公共衛生的災難。

discard.example: Discard any pills that are past their date.
discard.example_zh: 過期的藥丸請一律丟棄。

discharge.example: The doctor agreed to discharge her the next morning.
discharge.example_zh: 醫生同意隔天早上讓她出院。

discipline.example: Recovery takes patience and daily discipline.
discipline.example_zh: 康復需要耐心與每日的自律。

disclose.example: Doctors must disclose the risks of the drug.
disclose.example_zh: 醫生必須揭露這種藥的風險。

discontinuity.example: A sudden discontinuity in the data suggested the sensor had malfunctioned.
discontinuity.example_zh: 數據中突然的不連續，顯示感測器曾經故障。

discount.example: The pharmacy gave her a discount on the drug.
discount.example_zh: 藥局給了她這種藥的折扣。

discourage.example: A slow start should not discourage you.
discourage.example_zh: 起步緩慢不該讓你氣餒。

discourse.example: Her discourse used a vivid metaphor for the immune system.
discourse.example_zh: 她的論述用了一個生動的比喻來說明免疫系統。

discrimination.example: Patients should never face discrimination over their illness.
discrimination.example_zh: 病人絕不該因疾病而受到歧視。

dishonor.example: Cheating on the exam would dishonor both himself and his family.
dishonor.example_zh: 考試作弊不僅會使他自己蒙羞，也會玷辱他的家族。

disillusion.example: Years of broken promises left the voters deeply disillusioned with politics.
disillusion.example_zh: 多年的食言而肥使選民對政治徹底感到幻滅。

dismiss.example: Don't dismiss the symptom as simple tiredness.
dismiss.example_zh: 別把這個症狀當成單純的疲倦而不予理會。

display.example: The monitor displays the patient's heart rate.
display.example_zh: 螢幕顯示病人的心跳速率。

disposal.example: The clinic follows strict rules for waste disposal.
disposal.example_zh: 這間診所遵循嚴格的廢棄物處理規定。

disputatious.example: The disputatious committee argued for hours without reaching any agreement.
disputatious.example_zh: 這個愛爭論的委員會爭辯了好幾個小時，仍無法達成任何共識。

dispute.example: There was a dispute over who was to blame.
dispute.example_zh: 對於誰該負責有了爭執。

disregard.example: His careless disregard for safety rules led to a serious accident.
disregard.example_zh: 他對安全規定的漠視，釀成了一場嚴重的意外。

disrupt.example: Noise at night can disrupt a patient's healing.
disrupt.example_zh: 夜間的噪音會擾亂病人的康復。

dissect.example: Medical students must dissect a cadaver to study human anatomy.
dissect.example_zh: 醫學生必須解剖大體以研究人體解剖構造。

dissolve.example: The tablet will dissolve quickly in warm water.
dissolve.example_zh: 這顆藥片在溫水中會很快溶解。

dissolved.example: The tablet dissolved into a clear, uniform solution.
dissolved.example_zh: 藥片溶解成澄清而均勻的溶液。

distance.example: Each week brought an extension of the distance she could walk.
distance.example_zh: 每週她能走的距離都有所延長。

distant.example: The pain spread to a distant part of the body.
distant.example_zh: 疼痛蔓延到身體較遠的部位。

distend.example: A blockage in the intestine can cause the abdomen to distend painfully.
distend.example_zh: 腸道阻塞可能使腹部痛苦地膨脹起來。

distinct.example: The rash has a distinct ring-like shape.
distinct.example_zh: 這種疹子有明顯的環狀外形。

distinction.example: She clearly articulated the distinction between the two diseases.
distinction.example_zh: 她清楚地闡明了這兩種疾病之間的區別。

distinctive.example: The disease has a distinctive purple rash.
distinctive.example_zh: 這種病有一種獨特的紫色疹子。

distinguish.example: Doctors classify rashes to distinguish one disease from another.
distinguish.example_zh: 醫師將疹子分類，以區分不同的疾病。

distinguished.example: A distinguished surgeon was invited to lead the operation.
distinguished.example_zh: 一位傑出的外科醫生獲邀主刀。

distract.example: A toy helped distract the child during the shot.
distract.example_zh: 一個玩具幫助分散孩子打針時的注意力。

distress.example: The patient was in great distress before the drug.
distress.example_zh: 在用藥前，病人非常痛苦。

distributed.example: The medicine was distributed evenly among the clinics.
distributed.example_zh: 藥品被平均分配到各個診所。

distribution.example: The fair distribution of vaccines is a global concern.
distribution.example_zh: 疫苗的公平分配是全球關注的議題。

district.example: The clinic serves a poor district of the city.
district.example_zh: 這間診所服務城市裡一個貧困的地區。

disturb.example: Please do not disturb the resting patient.
disturb.example_zh: 請勿打擾正在休息的病人。

disturbance.example: A disturbance in the hall woke the patients.
disturbance.example_zh: 走廊裡的一陣騷動吵醒了病人。

dive.example: His blood pressure took a sudden dive.

divergent.example: The two doctors held sharply divergent views.
divergent.example_zh: 兩位醫生持有極為分歧的看法。

diverse.example: The clinic serves a diverse group of patients.
diverse.example_zh: 這間診所服務著背景各異的病人。

diversity.example: There is great diversity in how people heal.
diversity.example_zh: 人們癒合的方式有很大的差異。

divert.example: A funny story helped divert the child's attention.
divert.example_zh: 一個有趣的故事幫忙轉移了孩子的注意力。

divide.example: The cells divide rapidly to heal the wound.
divide.example_zh: 細胞快速分裂以修復傷口。

divine.example: In ancient times the cause of illness was obscure and thought divine.
divine.example_zh: 在古代，疾病的成因不明，被認為是神意。

division.example: His division collaborates with its counterpart at the city hospital.
division.example_zh: 他的部門與市立醫院的對口單位合作。

divorce.example: The stress of his illness nearly ended in divorce.
divorce.example_zh: 他生病的壓力差點以離婚收場。

dock.example: The supply ship pulled up to the dock.

doctrine.example: Do no harm is a central doctrine of medicine.
doctrine.example_zh: 「不造成傷害」是醫學的核心原則。

document.example: Every dose is documented in the patient's chart.
document.example_zh: 每一劑都記錄在病人的病歷上。

documentary.example: A documentary followed the lives of three nurses.
documentary.example_zh: 一部紀錄片跟拍了三位護理師的生活。

doll.example: The sick child clutched her favorite doll.
doll.example_zh: 生病的孩子緊抱著她最愛的娃娃。

domain.example: Rare diseases are the domain of specialist doctors.
domain.example_zh: 罕見疾病是專科醫生的領域。

dome.example: Light streamed through the glass dome above.
dome.example_zh: 光線從上方的玻璃圓頂灑下。

domestic.example: Most accidents happen in a domestic setting.
domestic.example_zh: 大多數意外發生在家庭環境中。

dominant.example: Brown eyes are caused by a dominant gene.
dominant.example_zh: 棕色眼睛是由顯性基因決定的。

dominate.example: One symptom came to dominate all the others.
dominate.example_zh: 有一個症狀變得比其他所有症狀都明顯。

donate.example: He chose to donate a kidney to his brother.
donate.example_zh: 他選擇捐一顆腎給弟弟。

donation.example: A generous donation funded the new scanner.
donation.example_zh: 一筆慷慨的捐款資助了新的掃描儀。

donor.example: The blood donor saved three lives that day.
donor.example_zh: 那位捐血者那天救了三條人命。

dose.example: Take one dose of the syrup before bed.

dot.example: A red dot on the chart marked the worst day.
dot.example_zh: 圖表上一個紅點標出了最糟的那天。

doubt.example: There is no legitimate doubt that exercise helps the heart.
doubt.example_zh: 運動有益心臟，這點沒有任何合理的懷疑。

down.example: The swelling slowly went down over a few days.
down.example_zh: 腫脹在幾天內慢慢消了下去。

downtown.example: The clinic moved to a downtown office.
downtown.example_zh: 診所搬到了市中心的一間辦公室。

draft.example: The nurse felt a cold draft from the open window.
draft.example_zh: 護理師感到從開著的窗戶吹來一陣冷風。

drag.example: He had to drag the heavy oxygen tank across the room.
drag.example_zh: 他得把沉重的氧氣瓶拖過房間。

drain.example: A small tube was placed to drain the wound.
drain.example_zh: 放入一根小管子來引流傷口。

drama.example: The recovery was full of unexpected drama.
drama.example_zh: 這段康復過程充滿了意想不到的波折。

dramatic.example: There was a dramatic drop in her fever overnight.
dramatic.example_zh: 她的高燒一夜之間戲劇性地退了。

dramatically.example: His health improved dramatically after the surgery.
dramatically.example_zh: 手術後他的健康狀況戲劇性地好轉。

draw.example: The nurse will draw a small sample of blood.
draw.example_zh: 護理師會抽取少量血液樣本。

drawer.example: The bandages are in the top drawer.
drawer.example_zh: 繃帶在最上層的抽屜裡。

drawing.example: His drawing of the heart closely resembles the real organ.
drawing.example_zh: 他畫的心臟與真正的器官極為相似。

drift.example: His attention began to drift as the fever rose.
drift.example_zh: 隨著高燒上升，他的注意力開始渙散。

drill.example_zh: 牙醫的鑽頭輕輕地嗡嗡作響。

drip.example: Water began to drip from the cracked pipe.
drip.example_zh: 水開始從裂開的水管滴落。

droop.example: Without enough water, the flowers began to droop in the afternoon heat.
droop.example_zh: 缺乏足夠的水分，花朵在午後的高溫下開始下垂枯萎。

drought.example: The long drought left the village without clean water.
drought.example_zh: 漫長的乾旱讓村莊沒有了乾淨的水。

dual.example: The drug has a dual effect on pain and fever.
dual.example_zh: 這種藥對疼痛與發燒有雙重作用。

dubbed.example: The drug was dubbed a miracle cure by the press.
dubbed.example_zh: 這種藥被媒體稱為神奇療法。

dubious.example: The salesman made dubious claims about the herb curing cancer.
dubious.example_zh: 推銷員提出該草藥能治癒癌症的可疑說法。

due.example: Her next check-up is due in two weeks.
due.example_zh: 她的下次回診排在兩週後。

dull.example: She felt a dull ache in her lower back all day.
dull.example_zh: 她整天感到下背部一陣隱隱的痠痛。

dumb.example: The shock left him momentarily dumb.
dumb.example_zh: 這個打擊讓他一時說不出話。

dump.example: Old medicines should never be dumped in the river.
dump.example_zh: 過期藥絕不該倒入河中。

duration.example: The duration of the treatment is about six weeks.
duration.example_zh: 這項治療的持續時間約六週。

dynamic.example: Recovery is a dynamic process, not a single step.
dynamic.example_zh: 康復是個動態的過程，而非單一的步驟。

dynamics.example: The dynamics of the family changed after his illness.
dynamics.example_zh: 他生病後，家庭的互動關係改變了。

eager.example: Eager to thrive, she followed every doctor's order.
eager.example_zh: 渴望好起來的她，遵循醫師的每一項囑咐。

earthquake.example: The earthquake left the hospital without power.

eccentric.example: Our eccentric professor wears mismatched socks and talks to his plants.
eccentric.example_zh: 我們那位古怪的教授穿著不成對的襪子，還會對植物說話。

echo.example: The scan uses sound echoes to picture the heart.
echo.example_zh: 這項掃描利用聲波的回聲來呈現心臟。

ecological.example: Pollution upset the river's ecological balance.
ecological.example_zh: 汙染破壞了這條河的生態平衡。

economic.example: The illness placed a heavy economic burden on the family.
economic.example_zh: 這場病為家庭帶來沉重的經濟負擔。

economics.example: She studied the economics and equity of public health.
economics.example_zh: 她研究公共衛生的經濟與公平議題。

ecosystem.example: The gut is home to a whole ecosystem of bacteria.
ecosystem.example_zh: 腸道是一整個細菌生態系的家。

edge.example: She felt a sharp edge of pain with each breath.
edge.example_zh: 她每一次呼吸都感到一陣尖銳的疼痛。

educated.example: An educated guess pointed to a mild infection.
educated.example_zh: 一個有根據的推測指向輕微的感染。

education.example: Health education starts in primary school.
education.example_zh: 健康教育從小學就開始。

effect.example: The drug had an immediate calming effect.
effect.example_zh: 這種藥立刻產生了鎮靜的效果。

effective.example: Rest is the most effective remedy for a common cold.
effective.example_zh: 休息是治療普通感冒最有效的方法。

effectiveness.example: Trials proved the effectiveness of the new drug.
effectiveness.example_zh: 試驗證明了這款新藥的有效性。

efficacy.example: Trials confirmed the efficacy of the vaccine.
efficacy.example_zh: 試驗證實了這款疫苗的功效。

efficiency.example: The new layout improved the ward's efficiency.
efficiency.example_zh: 新的格局提升了病房的效率。

efficient.example: The new system is far more efficient.
efficient.example_zh: 這套新系統的效率高出許多。

egoistic.example: His egoistic attitude meant he took all the credit for the team's work.
egoistic.example_zh: 他自我中心的態度，使他把團隊的功勞全攬到自己身上。

elaborate.example: The surgeon explained the procedure in elaborate detail.
elaborate.example_zh: 外科醫生鉅細靡遺地說明了手術過程。

elbow.example: He bruised his elbow when he fell.

election.example: Three doctors were nominated in the election for director.
election.example_zh: 有三位醫師獲提名參選主任。

electron.example: An electron carries a tiny negative charge.
electron.example_zh: 一個電子帶有微小的負電荷。

elegant.example: The solution to the problem was surprisingly elegant.
elegant.example_zh: 這個問題的解法出奇地簡潔優雅。

element.example: Iron is an essential element in the diet.
element.example_zh: 鐵是飲食中不可或缺的元素。

elementary.example: Hand washing is an elementary rule of hygiene.
elementary.example_zh: 洗手是衛生最基本的規則。

elevate.example: Elevate your leg to bring down the swelling.

elevator.example: The elevator took the stretcher up to the ward.
elevator.example_zh: 電梯把擔架送上了病房。

elicit.example: Her questions were designed specifically to elicit the patient's history.
elicit.example_zh: 她的問題是專門設計來引出病人病史的。

eligibility.example: Applicants must meet strict eligibility requirements before they can receive the grant.
eligibility.example_zh: 申請人必須符合嚴格的資格條件，才能領取這筆補助金。

eligible.example: Only patients over sixty-five are eligible for the free vaccine.
eligible.example_zh: 只有六十五歲以上的病人才有資格接種免費疫苗。

eliminate.example: The treatment aims to eliminate the virus completely.
eliminate.example_zh: 這項治療的目標是徹底清除病毒。

elite.example: She trained with an elite team of surgeons.
elite.example_zh: 她和一支頂尖的外科團隊一起受訓。

elitism.example: Critics accused the university of elitism for favoring wealthy applicants.
elitism.example_zh: 批評者指責該大學偏袒富裕申請者，是一種精英主義。

elucidate.example: The professor used a diagram to elucidate the complicated process.
elucidate.example_zh: 教授用一張圖表來闡明這個複雜的過程。

embed.example: A splinter was embedded deep in his foot.
embed.example_zh: 一根刺深深嵌進了他的腳裡。

embellished.example: He embellished the old tale to entertain the children on the ward.
embellished.example_zh: 他把老故事加油添醋，逗病房裡的孩子開心。

embody.example: The nurse seemed to embody patience itself.
embody.example_zh: 這位護理師簡直是耐心的化身。

embrace.example: She embraced her son when he woke from surgery.
embrace.example_zh: 兒子從手術中醒來時，她擁抱了他。

emerge.example: New symptoms emerged a week after the infection.
emerge.example_zh: 感染一週後出現了新的症狀。

emergence.example: The emergence of new drugs gave them hope.
emergence.example_zh: 新藥的問世給了他們希望。

emergency.example: In an emergency, call for an ambulance at once.
emergency.example_zh: 緊急情況下，請立刻叫救護車。

emerging.example: Doctors watched the emerging signs of recovery.
emerging.example_zh: 醫生留意著逐漸顯現的康復跡象。

eminence.example: She achieved eminence in cardiology after decades of pioneering research.
eminence.example_zh: 經過數十年的開創性研究，她在心臟科領域享有崇高聲望。

emission.example: The factory's emission of fumes harmed local health.
emission.example_zh: 工廠排放的煙霧危害了當地居民的健康。

emit.example: The machine emits a soft beep with each heartbeat.
emit.example_zh: 這台機器隨著每次心跳發出輕柔的嗶聲。

emotion.example: He struggled to hide his emotion at the news.
emotion.example_zh: 聽到消息時他努力掩飾自己的情緒。

emotional.example: The diagnosis took a heavy emotional toll.
emotional.example_zh: 這個診斷在情感上造成沉重的負擔。

empathy.example: A good nurse listens with genuine empathy.
empathy.example_zh: 好的護理師會以真誠的同理心傾聽。

emphasis.example: The training places equal emphasis on skill and compassion.
emphasis.example_zh: 這項訓練同樣重視技術與同理心。

emphasize.example: The doctor emphasized the necessity of complete rest.
emphasize.example_zh: 醫師強調完全休息的必要性。

empirical.example: Their conclusion is backed by empirical evidence from years of experiments.
empirical.example_zh: 他們的結論有多年實驗的實證證據支持。

employ.example: The clinic employs three full-time doctors.
employ.example_zh: 這間診所僱用三名全職醫生。

employed.example: The hospital employed two hundred nurses last year.
employed.example_zh: 這家醫院去年僱用了兩百名護理師。

employee.example: Every employee gets a free annual health check.
employee.example_zh: 每位員工都享有免費的年度健檢。

employer.example: His employer gave him time off to recover.
employer.example_zh: 他的雇主給了他時間休養。

empower.example: Good information empowers patients to make choices.
empower.example_zh: 充分的資訊讓病人有能力做出選擇。

empty.example: Take this medicine on an empty stomach.

enable.example: The new device enables him to walk again.
enable.example_zh: 這項新裝置讓他能再次行走。

enact.example: The government enacted a law on drug safety.
enact.example_zh: 政府制定了一項藥品安全的法律。

enclose.example: Please enclose a copy of your test results with the form.
enclose.example_zh: 請隨表格附上一份你的檢查結果。

encompass.example: Good care should encompass both body and mind.
encompass.example_zh: 良好的照護應涵蓋身與心。

encounter.example: During the encounter she noticed a peculiar rash.
encounter.example_zh: 在那次看診中，她注意到一種奇特的疹子。

encourage.example: Nurses encourage patients to walk soon after surgery.
encourage.example_zh: 護理師鼓勵病人在術後盡早走動。

endangered.example: Some herbs come from endangered plants.
endangered.example_zh: 有些草藥取自瀕危的植物。

endeavor.example: Every endeavor was made to save the patient.
endeavor.example_zh: 為了救這名病人，眾人盡了一切努力。

endless.example: The night before surgery felt endless.
endless.example_zh: 手術前一晚感覺漫長無盡。

endorse.example: Doctors widely endorse the new vaccine.
endorse.example_zh: 醫生普遍支持這款新疫苗。

endure.example: He had to endure weeks of painful therapy.
endure.example_zh: 他必須忍受數週痛苦的治療。

energy.example: Rest helps the body preserve energy while fighting an infection.
energy.example_zh: 休息能幫助身體在對抗感染時保存能量。

enforce.example: Hospitals enforce strict hygiene rules to prevent the spread of infection.
enforce.example_zh: 醫院執行嚴格的衛生規定，以防止感染擴散。

engage.example: Staying engaged in hobbies helps the elderly stay sharp.
engage.example_zh: 持續投入嗜好有助於長者保持思緒清晰。

engagement.example: Their engagement was announced at the family dinner.
engagement.example_zh: 他們的婚約在家庭聚餐上宣布。

enhance.example: The new lens enhances the clarity of the scan.
enhance.example_zh: 新鏡頭提升了掃描的清晰度。

enhancement.example: The new lens offers a real enhancement in image quality.
enhancement.example_zh: 新鏡頭在影像品質上有實質的提升。

enlist.example: She enlisted the family's help in his care.
enlist.example_zh: 她請家人一起協助照顧他。

enormous.example: The surgery was an enormous strain on his body.
enormous.example_zh: 這場手術對他的身體是極大的負擔。

enroll.example: She decided to enroll in a first-aid course.
enroll.example_zh: 她決定報名一門急救課程。

ensconced.example: By evening she was ensconced in her favorite armchair with a good book.
ensconced.example_zh: 到了傍晚，她舒舒服服地窩在最愛的扶手椅裡看書。

ensemble.example: The whole care ensemble worked as one.
ensemble.example_zh: 整個照護團隊像一個整體般運作。

ensure.example: Double-check the dose to ensure it is correct.
ensure.example_zh: 再次核對劑量以確保正確。

entail.example: Recovery will entail months of careful exercise.
entail.example_zh: 康復需要好幾個月小心的運動。

enterprise.example: Running a rural clinic is a tough enterprise.
enterprise.example_zh: 經營一間鄉村診所是件辛苦的事業。

entertain.example: Clowns visit the ward to entertain the sick children.
entertain.example_zh: 小丑會到病房逗生病的孩子們開心。

entertainment.example: Reading became a daily ritual and her only entertainment.
entertainment.example_zh: 閱讀成了每日的儀式，也是她唯一的娛樂。

enthusiasm.example: He tackled his recovery with real enthusiasm.
enthusiasm.example_zh: 他以真正的熱忱投入康復。

entitle.example: Full-time staff are entitled to sick leave.
entitle.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有病假。

entitled.example: Full-time employees are entitled to paid annual leave.
entitled.example_zh: 全職員工有資格享有帶薪年假。

entity.example: The clinic is now a separate legal entity.
entity.example_zh: 這間診所現在是獨立的法律實體。

entrance.example: An ambulance waited at the hospital entrance.
entrance.example_zh: 一輛救護車停在醫院入口處等候。

entrepreneur.example: The entrepreneur funded a free clinic for the poor.
entrepreneur.example_zh: 這位企業家資助了一間給窮人的免費診所。

entry.example: Each dose is given its own entry in the log.
entry.example_zh: 每一劑都在紀錄中有自己的一筆登錄。

envelope.example: She sealed the test results inside a white envelope and mailed it.
envelope.example_zh: 她把檢驗結果封進一個白色信封裡寄出。

envision.example: It is hard to envision life without the medicine.
envision.example_zh: 很難想像沒有這種藥的生活。

ephemeral.example: The drug's effect is ephemeral and wears off in an hour.
ephemeral.example_zh: 這種藥的效果短暫，一小時內就消退。

epidemic.example: The clinic was overwhelmed during the flu epidemic.
epidemic.example_zh: 流感疫情期間，診所應接不暇。

episode.example: He had a brief episode of dizziness this morning.
episode.example_zh: 他今天早上有一陣短暫的暈眩發作。

equal.example: All patients are treated as equals here.
equal.example_zh: 在這裡所有病人都被平等對待。

equality.example: She fought for equality in access to healthcare.
equality.example_zh: 她為醫療資源的平等取得而奮鬥。

equation.example: Cost is only one part of the equation in care.
equation.example_zh: 費用只是照護這道難題的一部分。

equip.example: The clinic is well equipped for emergencies.
equip.example_zh: 這間診所配備齊全，足以應付緊急狀況。

equipment.example: The clinic lacks the equipment for major surgery.
equipment.example_zh: 這間診所缺乏進行大手術的設備。

equity.example: The reform aims to bring equity to rural healthcare.
equity.example_zh: 這項改革旨在為鄉村醫療帶來公平。

equivalent.example: One tablet is equivalent to two spoons of the syrup.
equivalent.example_zh: 一顆藥片相當於兩匙糖漿。

equivocal.example: The test results were equivocal, so the doctor ordered another scan.
equivocal.example_zh: 檢驗結果模稜兩可，因此醫師又安排了一次掃描。

era.example: Antibiotics began a new era in medicine.
era.example_zh: 抗生素開啟了醫學的新時代。

eradicate.example: Vaccines have helped eradicate smallpox worldwide.
eradicate.example_zh: 疫苗幫助全球根除了天花。

erase.example: Time slowly erased the memory of the pain.
erase.example_zh: 時間慢慢抹去了疼痛的記憶。

erosion.example: Acid causes slow erosion of the teeth.
erosion.example_zh: 酸會造成牙齒的緩慢腐蝕。

error.example: A small error in the dose could be serious.
error.example_zh: 劑量上的小錯誤可能很嚴重。

erupt.example: A rash can erupt within hours of the bite.
erupt.example_zh: 疹子可能在被咬後數小時內爆發。

escalate.example: A minor disagreement quickly escalated into a public controversy.
escalate.example_zh: 一場小小的分歧很快升級成公開的爭議。

escape.example: No one can fully escape the effects of aging.
escape.example_zh: 沒有人能完全逃過老化的影響。

essence.example: Rest is the essence of a good recovery.
essence.example_zh: 休息是良好康復的關鍵所在。

essential.example: Folic acid is an essential vitamin during pregnancy.
essential.example_zh: 葉酸是懷孕期間必需的維生素。

established.example: It is now an established fact that smoking causes cancer.
established.example_zh: 吸菸致癌如今已是確立的事實。

estate.example: He left his estate to a children's hospital.
estate.example_zh: 他把遺產留給了一家兒童醫院。

estimate.example: Doctors estimate she will recover in a month.
estimate.example_zh: 醫生估計她一個月內會康復。

eternal.example: She faced her illness with eternal hope.
eternal.example_zh: 她以永不熄滅的希望面對病痛。

ethics.example: Medical ethics require doctors to stay neutral and honest.
ethics.example_zh: 醫學倫理要求醫師保持中立與誠實。

ethnic.example: The disease is more common in certain ethnic groups.
ethnic.example_zh: 這種病在某些族群中較常見。

evacuated.example: The ward was evacuated as soon as the alarm sounded.
evacuated.example_zh: 警報一響，病房立刻被疏散。

evaluate.example: Doctors will evaluate her progress next week.
evaluate.example_zh: 醫生下週會評估她的進展。

even.example: He chose to confront the diagnosis, even after the bad news.
even.example_zh: 即使聽到壞消息，他仍選擇直面這個診斷。

evenly.example: Spread the cream evenly over the rash.
evenly.example_zh: 把藥膏均勻地塗在疹子上。

eventually.example: After months of therapy, she eventually walked again.
eventually.example_zh: 經過數月的治療，她終於又能走路了。

everlasting.example: They believed true friendship was everlasting and could endure any hardship.
everlasting.example_zh: 他們相信真正的友誼是永恆的，能夠承受任何艱難。

evidence.example: There is strong evidence that exercise reduces stress.
evidence.example_zh: 有充分的證據顯示運動能減輕壓力。

evident.example: It was evident that the medicine was working.
evident.example_zh: 顯然這種藥正在發揮作用。

evoke.example: The smell of the ward evoked old memories.
evoke.example_zh: 病房的氣味喚起了舊日的回憶。

evolution.example: The slow evolution of the disease is hard to track.
evolution.example_zh: 這種病緩慢的演變很難追蹤。

evolutionary.example: The change was evolutionary, not sudden.
evolutionary.example_zh: 這項改變是漸進的，而非突然的。

evolve.example: The virus can evolve to resist the drug.
evolve.example_zh: 病毒可能演化出對這種藥的抗性。

exact.example: Note the exact time the pain began, and likewise when it eased.
exact.example_zh: 記下疼痛開始的確切時間，同樣記下緩解的時間。

exaggerate.example: Don't exaggerate your symptoms to the doctor.
exaggerate.example_zh: 別向醫生誇大你的症狀。

exceed.example: The dose must not exceed two pills a day.
exceed.example_zh: 劑量一天不可超過兩顆。

excellent.example: The surgeon has an excellent record of success.
excellent.example_zh: 這位外科醫生有著出色的成功紀錄。

exception.example: Every patient is seen in turn; the nurse administers drugs with no exception.
exception.example_zh: 每位病人依序看診；護理師給藥一視同仁，沒有例外。

exceptional.example: She showed exceptional courage during treatment.
exceptional.example_zh: 她在治療期間展現了非凡的勇氣。

excerpt.example: She read an excerpt from a medical journal.
excerpt.example_zh: 她讀了一段醫學期刊的摘錄。

excess.example: An excess of salt in the diet raises blood pressure.
excess.example_zh: 飲食中過量的鹽會使血壓升高。

excessive.example_zh: 過量飲酒損害了他的肝臟。

exchange.example: There was a brief exchange of notes between the doctors.
exchange.example_zh: 醫生之間簡短地交換了筆記。

excite.example: The good news seemed to excite the whole ward.
excite.example_zh: 這個好消息彷彿讓整個病房都振奮起來。

excitement.example: The excitement of going home tired her out.
excitement.example_zh: 要回家的興奮讓她累壞了。

exciting.example: It was an exciting day when she finally went home.
exciting.example_zh: 她終於回家的那天令人振奮。

exclaim.example: She exclaimed with joy at the good news.
exclaim.example_zh: 聽到好消息，她欣喜地驚呼。

exclude.example: The test helped exclude a more serious illness.
exclude.example_zh: 這項檢查幫助排除了更嚴重的疾病。

exclusion.example: The exclusion of salt helped lower her pressure.
exclusion.example_zh: 戒除鹽分有助於降低她的血壓。

exclusive.example: The clinic offers exclusive care to its members.
exclusive.example_zh: 這間診所為會員提供專屬的照護。

exclusively.example: This ward cares exclusively for children.

excuse.example: Tiredness is no excuse to skip your medicine.
excuse.example_zh: 疲倦不是漏服藥物的藉口。

execute.example: The team executed the surgery without a hitch.
execute.example_zh: 團隊毫無差錯地完成了手術。

execution.example: The plan was good, but its execution was poor.
execution.example_zh: 計畫很好，但執行得很糟。

executive.example: The hospital's chief executive announced the plan.
executive.example_zh: 醫院的執行長宣布了這項計畫。

exemplar.example: Her dedication to patients made her an exemplar for every young nurse.
exemplar.example_zh: 她對病人的奉獻使她成為每位年輕護理師的典範。

exemplify.example: This case perfectly exemplifies the dangers of self-medication.
exemplify.example_zh: 這個案例完美地例證了自行用藥的危險。

exert.example: The tumor began to exert pressure on the nerve.
exert.example_zh: 腫瘤開始對神經施加壓力。

exhaust.example: The long illness began to exhaust her.
exhaust.example_zh: 久病開始讓她精疲力竭。

exhaustion.example: After the double shift, the nurse collapsed from sheer exhaustion.
exhaustion.example_zh: 連值兩班後，那位護理師因極度疲憊而昏倒。

exhaustive.example: The doctors ran an exhaustive series of tests before making a diagnosis.
exhaustive.example_zh: 醫師在做出診斷前，進行了一系列詳盡徹底的檢查。

exhibit.example: When patients exhibit signs of recovery, doctors feel optimistic.
exhibit.example_zh: 當病人顯現康復跡象時，醫師便感到樂觀。

exhibition.example: The hospital held an exhibition on heart health.
exhibition.example_zh: 醫院舉辦了一場關於心臟健康的展覽。

exile.example: The old doctor spent his last years in exile.
exile.example_zh: 這位老醫生在流亡中度過了晚年。

exist.example: Few effective drugs existed for the disease back then.
exist.example_zh: 那時候幾乎沒有治療這種病的有效藥物。

exit.example: The nurse showed the family to the exit.
exit.example_zh: 護理師領著家屬走向出口。

exonerated.example: The investigation exonerated the nurse of any blame.
exonerated.example_zh: 調查還了那名護理師清白，免除了一切責任。

exorbitant.example: The clinic charged exorbitant fees that most patients could not afford.
exorbitant.example_zh: 這家診所收取大多數病人都負擔不起的過高費用。

exotic.example: He fell ill after eating an exotic fruit.
exotic.example_zh: 他吃了一種奇特的水果後病倒了。

expand.example: The lungs expand each time you breathe in.
expand.example_zh: 每次吸氣時肺部就會擴張。

expansion.example: The clinic announced a major expansion of its services.
expansion.example_zh: 診所宣布大幅擴充服務項目。

expedition.example: A medical expedition brought care to the mountains.
expedition.example_zh: 一支醫療隊把照護帶進了山區。

expenditure.example: Health expenditure rose sharply last year.
expenditure.example_zh: 去年的醫療支出大幅上升。

experienced.example: An experienced nurse spotted the problem at once.
experienced.example_zh: 一位經驗豐富的護理師立刻發現了問題。

expertise.example: Her expertise in heart surgery is widely known.
expertise.example_zh: 她在心臟手術上的專業廣為人知。

explicable.example: Her fatigue was easily explicable once the blood test revealed anemia.
explicable.example_zh: 血液檢查顯示她貧血後，她的疲倦就變得很容易解釋了。

explicit.example: The doctor gave explicit instructions for the dose.
explicit.example_zh: 醫生對劑量給出了明確的指示。

explode.example: He tried to suppress the anger that threatened to explode.
explode.example_zh: 他試圖壓抑那股快要爆發的怒氣。

exploit.example: Drug makers should not exploit sick people.

exploration.example: Careful exploration of the wound found the splinter.
exploration.example_zh: 仔細探查傷口後找到了那根刺。

explore.example: Doctors will explore other options if the drug fails.
explore.example_zh: 若藥物無效，醫生會探究其他選項。

explosive.example: The lab stores explosive chemicals with great care.
explosive.example_zh: 實驗室非常謹慎地存放易爆的化學品。

expose.example: Do not expose the wound to water, as it can interfere with healing.
expose.example_zh: 別讓傷口碰到水，以免妨礙癒合。

exposure.example: Long exposure to the sun can damage the skin.
exposure.example_zh: 長時間曝曬陽光會傷害皮膚。

extend.example: The doctor extended her leave by another week.
extend.example_zh: 醫生把她的假再延長了一週。

extended.example: She needed an extended stay in hospital to recover fully.
extended.example_zh: 她需要延長住院時間才能完全康復。

extension.example: She was given an extension to finish her training.
extension.example_zh: 她獲准延長時間以完成訓練。

extensive.example: The patient required extensive treatment after the accident.
extensive.example_zh: 那名病人在意外後需要大量的治療。

extent.example: The X-ray showed the full extent of the damage.
extent.example_zh: X 光顯示了損傷的全部範圍。

external.example: The wound healed, but an external scar remained.
external.example_zh: 傷口癒合了，但外部留下了疤痕。

extinguish.example: Firefighters fought all night to extinguish the devastating blaze.
extinguish.example_zh: 消防員奮戰整夜，撲滅了這場毀滅性的大火。

extract.example: The dentist had to extract the decayed tooth.
extract.example_zh: 牙醫不得不拔掉那顆蛀牙。

extradite.example: The government agreed to extradite the fugitive to face trial abroad.
extradite.example_zh: 政府同意將該逃犯引渡至國外受審。

extraordinary.example: The team made an extraordinary effort to save him.
extraordinary.example_zh: 團隊付出了非凡的努力來搶救他。

fabric.example: The dressing uses an elegant, breathable fabric.
fabric.example_zh: 這種敷料採用設計精巧、透氣的布料。

fabricate.example: The researcher was fired for fabricating data in his published study.
fabricate.example_zh: 該研究員因在發表的研究中捏造數據而遭到解僱。

fabulous.example: She made a fabulous recovery in record time.
fabulous.example_zh: 她以破紀錄的速度奇蹟般地康復。

face.example: She had to face the diagnosis with courage.
face.example_zh: 她必須勇敢面對這個診斷。

facilitate.example: A clear chart can facilitate a faster diagnosis.
facilitate.example_zh: 清楚的圖表能促成更快的診斷。

facilitated.example: The new software facilitated faster sharing of records.
facilitated.example_zh: 新軟體促成了病歷更快速的分享。

facility.example: The new facility offers care equivalent to a major city hospital.
facility.example_zh: 這座新院所提供與大型市立醫院同等的照護。

faction.example: A faction of doctors opposed the new rule.
faction.example_zh: 一派醫生反對這項新規定。

factor.example: Age is a major risk factor for heart disease.
factor.example_zh: 年齡是心臟病的主要風險因素。

faculty.example: She joined the faculty of the medical school.
faculty.example_zh: 她加入了醫學院的教職。

fade.example: The bruise will slowly fade over two weeks.
fade.example_zh: 瘀青會在兩週內慢慢褪去。

faint.example: She felt faint and had to sit down quickly.
faint.example_zh: 她感到頭暈，不得不趕緊坐下。

fair.example: The injured worker was awarded fair compensation.
fair.example_zh: 這名受傷的工人獲得了合理的賠償。

fairly.example: She recovered fairly quickly after the operation.
fairly.example_zh: 手術後她恢復得相當快。

faith.example: Her faith helped her through the long illness.
faith.example_zh: 她的信仰幫助她度過了漫長的病痛。

faithful.example: He was faithful in taking his pills every day.

fake.example: He was sold a fake medicine that did nothing.
fake.example_zh: 他被賣了一種毫無作用的假藥。

fallacious.example: The claim that the herb cures cancer is fallacious.
fallacious.example_zh: 宣稱這種草藥能治癒癌症是謬誤的。

fame.example: The surgeon's fame spread far beyond the city.
fame.example_zh: 這位外科醫生的名聲遠播城外。

fancy.example: She had no fancy treatment, just rest and care.
fancy.example_zh: 她沒接受什麼花俏的治療，只是休息與照護。

fantastic.example: She made a fantastic recovery against the odds.
fantastic.example_zh: 她在不被看好的情況下驚人地康復了。

fantasy.example: A quick cure was just a fantasy for the family.
fantasy.example_zh: 對這家人而言，快速治癒只是個幻想。

fascinate.example: The workings of the brain fascinate her.

fascinating.example: She found the workings of the heart fascinating.
fascinating.example_zh: 她覺得心臟的運作十分迷人。

fashion.example: She recovered in a slow but steady fashion.
fashion.example_zh: 她以緩慢卻穩定的方式康復。

fast.example: He had to fast for eight hours before the blood test.
fast.example_zh: 抽血前他必須禁食八小時。

fatal.example: Without quick treatment, the bite can be fatal.
fatal.example_zh: 若不及時治療，這種咬傷可能致命。

fatigue.example: Constant fatigue was the first sign of her illness.
fatigue.example_zh: 持續的疲倦是她生病的第一個徵兆。

fault.example: The error was no fault of the nurse.
fault.example_zh: 這個錯誤不是護理師的過失。

favorable.example: The new drug got a favorable response in trials.
favorable.example_zh: 這款新藥在試驗中獲得良好的反應。

favorably.example: Reviewers responded favorably to the new treatment's promising results.
favorably.example_zh: 評審對這項新療法富有前景的成果反應良好。

feasible.example: Surgery was no longer a feasible option for the elderly patient.
feasible.example_zh: 對這位年長病人來說，手術已不再是可行的選擇。

feature.example: A rash is a common feature of the disease.
feature.example_zh: 疹子是這種病常見的特徵。

federal.example: The drug was approved by the federal health agency.
federal.example_zh: 這種藥獲得聯邦衛生機構核准。

feed.example: A tube was used to feed the unconscious patient.
feed.example_zh: 用一條管子為昏迷的病人餵食。

feedback.example: The doctor welcomed feedback from her patients.
feedback.example_zh: 這位醫生樂於聽取病人的回饋。

feminist.example: She was a feminist who fought for women's health.
feminist.example_zh: 她是位為女性健康奮鬥的女權主義者。

fertile.example: The valley's fertile soil produces three harvests a year.
fertile.example_zh: 山谷肥沃的土壤一年能有三次收成。

festival.example: She was home in time for the autumn festival.
festival.example_zh: 她及時回家過秋天的節慶。

fever.example: The child ran a high fever and needed to be taken to the clinic.
fever.example_zh: 這個孩子發高燒，必須被送到診所。

fiber.example: A diet rich in fiber keeps the gut healthy.
fiber.example_zh: 富含纖維的飲食能讓腸道健康。

fiction.example: His belief in the miracle cure was pure fiction.
fiction.example_zh: 他對神奇療法的相信純屬虛構。

fictional.example: The story was fictional, but the illness was real.
fictional.example_zh: 這個故事是虛構的，但病痛是真實的。

fierce.example: Despite a fierce battle with illness, his strong will prevailed.
fierce.example_zh: 儘管與病魔激烈搏鬥，他堅強的意志最終獲勝。

figure.example: Doctors could not figure out the cause of the fever.
figure.example_zh: 醫生查不出發燒的原因。

file.example: The nurse pulled the patient's file from the cabinet.
file.example_zh: 護理師從櫃子裡抽出病人的檔案。

filter.example: The kidneys filter waste from the blood.
filter.example_zh: 腎臟過濾血液中的廢物。

final.example: The final test confirmed she was cured.
final.example_zh: 最後一次檢查確認她痊癒了。

finance.example: The family struggled to finance the treatment.
finance.example_zh: 這家人費盡心力才籌到治療的費用。

financial.example: A long illness can cause real financial strain.
financial.example_zh: 久病可能帶來實質的財務壓力。

financing.example: The new wing needed years of careful financing.
financing.example_zh: 這座新側翼需要多年謹慎的資金籌措。

fine.example: The X-ray showed everything was fine.

finish.example: Always finish the full course of antibiotics.
finish.example_zh: 抗生素一定要服完整個療程。

firm.example: The bandage should be firm but not too tight.
firm.example_zh: 繃帶應該牢固，但不要太緊。

fiscal.example: The hospital faced a tough fiscal year.
fiscal.example_zh: 這家醫院面臨一個艱困的會計年度。

fishery.example: The coastal fishery supplies fresh fish to the town.
fishery.example_zh: 沿海漁業為這個鎮供應新鮮的魚。

fist.example: He clenched his fist as the needle went in.
fist.example_zh: 針扎進去時他握緊了拳頭。

fit.example: A daily exercise routine kept her fit after surgery.
fit.example_zh: 每日的運動習慣讓她術後保持健康。

fitness.example: Months of training restored his fitness.
fitness.example_zh: 數月的訓練恢復了他的體能。

fixed.example: The broken arm was held in a fixed position.
fixed.example_zh: 斷掉的手臂被固定在一個位置。

flag.example: A red flag in the results alerted the doctor.
flag.example_zh: 結果中的一個警訊提醒了醫生。

flame.example: The nurse passed the needle through a flame.
flame.example_zh: 護理師把針穿過火焰消毒。

flash.example: A flash of pain shot down his arm.
flash.example_zh: 一陣劇痛竄下他的手臂。

flat.example: He had to lie completely flat for an hour after the test.
flat.example_zh: 檢查後他必須整整一小時平躺著。

flatulence.example: Eating beans often causes bloating and flatulence in many people.
flatulence.example_zh: 對許多人來說，吃豆類常會引起腹脹和腸胃脹氣。

flavor.example: The syrup has an artificial cherry flavor.
flavor.example_zh: 這款糖漿有人工櫻桃口味。

flavour.example: The medicine had a faint mint flavour.
flavour.example_zh: 這種藥有股淡淡的薄荷味。

flaw.example: A tiny flaw in the device caused the alarm.
flaw.example_zh: 裝置裡一個微小的瑕疵引發了警報。

flee.example: Families had to flee the area during the outbreak.
flee.example_zh: 疫情期間，許多家庭不得不逃離該區。

fleet.example: A fleet of ambulances stood ready outside.
fleet.example_zh: 一隊救護車在外頭待命。

flexibility.example: Stretching restores flexibility to stiff joints.
flexibility.example_zh: 伸展能讓僵硬的關節恢復柔軟度。

flexible.example: The new joint is surprisingly flexible after surgery.
flexible.example_zh: 手術後這個關節靈活得出乎意料。

flight.example: The long flight left her legs swollen.
flight.example_zh: 漫長的飛行讓她的雙腿腫脹。

flip.example: The doctor flipped through the thick file.
flip.example_zh: 醫生翻閱著那本厚厚的病歷。

float.example: A relaxed body seems to float in warm water.
float.example_zh: 放鬆的身體彷彿漂浮在溫水中。

flood.example: The clinic was flooded after the heavy rain.

flour.example: She is allergic to anything made with wheat flour.
flour.example_zh: 她對任何用小麥麵粉做的東西都過敏。

flourish.example: The garden began to flourish in the spring sun.
flourish.example_zh: 花園在春日的陽光下開始繁茂起來。

fluctuate.example: Blood sugar levels can fluctuate sharply after a heavy meal.
fluctuate.example_zh: 大餐之後血糖值可能會劇烈波動。

fluid.example: The patient was given fluid through a drip.
fluid.example_zh: 病人經由點滴補充體液。

flush.example: Her cheeks flushed red with the fever.
flush.example_zh: 她的雙頰因發燒而泛紅。

foam.example: White foam formed at the corner of his mouth.

focus.example: She struggled to focus after a sleepless night.
focus.example_zh: 一夜沒睡後，她難以集中精神。

fog.example: A thick fog delayed the air ambulance.

fold.example: The nurse helped fold the clean sheets.
fold.example_zh: 護理師幫忙摺好乾淨的床單。

folk.example: Local folk still trust the village healer.
folk.example_zh: 當地居民仍信任村裡的治療師。

folklore.example: According to local folklore, the spring water can cure many illnesses.
folklore.example_zh: 根據當地的民間傳說，這泉水能治癒許多疾病。

foolish.example: It was foolish to ignore such severe pain.
foolish.example_zh: 忽視這麼劇烈的疼痛實在愚蠢。

forbid.example: Doctors forbid him to lift anything heavy.
forbid.example_zh: 醫生禁止他提任何重物。

forecast.example: The model can forecast how the disease will spread.
forecast.example_zh: 這個模型能預測疾病將如何傳播。

foremost.example: Patient safety is foremost in her mind.
foremost.example_zh: 病人安全在她心中是第一位的。

forestall.example: The clinic ordered extra vaccines to forestall a possible shortage.
forestall.example_zh: 診所訂購了額外的疫苗，以預先防止可能的短缺。

forge.example: Trust between doctor and patient takes time to forge.
forge.example_zh: 醫病之間的信任需要時間慢慢建立。

formal.example: The clinic sent a formal apology to the family.
formal.example_zh: 診所向家屬發出了正式的道歉。

format.example: The chart follows a simple, clear format.
format.example_zh: 這份病歷採用簡單清楚的格式。

formation.example: Some clots exploit slow blood flow to begin their formation.
formation.example_zh: 有些血栓會利用緩慢的血流開始形成。

former.example: The former patient now volunteers at the ward.
former.example_zh: 這位曾經的病人如今在病房當志工。

formerly.example: The building was formerly a small clinic.
formerly.example_zh: 這棟建築從前是一間小診所。

formidable.example: Recovery was a formidable challenge for the elderly man.
formidable.example_zh: 康復對這位老先生來說是個艱鉅的挑戰。

formula.example: The nurse mixed the baby's formula carefully.
formula.example_zh: 護理師仔細地調配嬰兒的配方奶。

formulate.example: The team formulated a clear plan of care.
formulate.example_zh: 團隊擬定了一套清楚的照護計畫。

forsake.example: A good doctor will never forsake a patient in need.
forsake.example_zh: 好醫生絕不會棄有需要的病人於不顧。

forth.example: From that day forth, he never smoked again.
forth.example_zh: 從那天起，他再也沒抽過菸。

fortitude.example: She bore the long chemotherapy with remarkable fortitude and never complained.
fortitude.example_zh: 她以驚人的堅毅承受漫長的化療，從不抱怨。

fortunate.example: He was fortunate that the surgery did not involve his heart.
fortunate.example_zh: 他很幸運，手術沒有牽涉到他的心臟。

fortune.example: He spent a small fortune on private treatment.
fortune.example_zh: 他在私人治療上花了一大筆錢。

forum.example: An online forum lets patients share advice.
forum.example_zh: 一個線上論壇讓病人交流建議。

forward.example: The bright prospect of going home spurred her forward.
forward.example_zh: 回家的美好前景督促著她向前。

fossil.example: The museum displayed an ancient fish fossil.
fossil.example_zh: 博物館展出了一塊古老的魚化石。

foster.example: Good mentors foster both curiosity and discipline in their students.
foster.example_zh: 好的導師會在學生身上培養好奇心與紀律。

founder.example: The founder of the clinic was herself a nurse.
founder.example_zh: 這間診所的創辦人本身就是護理師。

fountain.example: A small fountain bubbled in the hospital garden.
fountain.example_zh: 醫院花園裡有一座小噴泉汩汩作響。

fraction.example: Only a fraction of patients had side effects.
fraction.example_zh: 只有一小部分病人出現副作用。

fracture.example: The X-ray revealed a hairline fracture in her wrist.
fracture.example_zh: X 光顯示她的手腕有一道細微骨折。

fragile.example: The elderly patient was frail and fragile.
fragile.example_zh: 這位年長的病人虛弱而脆弱。

fragment.example: A fragment of bone had to be removed.
fragment.example_zh: 一塊骨頭碎片必須取出。

frail.example: The frail elderly patient needed help walking to the examination room.
frail.example_zh: 這位虛弱的年長病患需要人攙扶才能走到診間。

frame.example: His thin frame had grown weak with illness.
frame.example_zh: 他瘦弱的身軀因病而更加虛弱。

framework.example: The recovery framework rests on one premise: gradual progress.
framework.example_zh: 這套康復架構建立在一個前提上：循序漸進。

fraud.example: He was charged with insurance fraud.

frequency.example: The frequency of his seizures slowly decreased.
frequency.example_zh: 他癲癇發作的頻率慢慢降低。

frequent.example: She made frequent trips to the clinic that winter.
frequent.example_zh: 那年冬天她頻繁地往返診所。

freshly.example: The bed was made up with freshly washed sheets.
freshly.example_zh: 床鋪換上了剛洗好的床單。

fright.example: She screamed in fright when the spider suddenly dropped onto her arm.
fright.example_zh: 蜘蛛突然掉到她手臂上時，她驚嚇得尖叫起來。

frightening.example: The first night in hospital was frightening for the child.
frightening.example_zh: 住院的第一晚對孩子來說很可怕。

fringe.example: Such cures sit on the fringe of real medicine.
fringe.example_zh: 這類療法處於正規醫學的邊緣。

frivolous.example: The court dismissed the frivolous lawsuit at once.
frivolous.example_zh: 法院當即駁回了這宗無理取鬧的訴訟。

frontier.example: Gene therapy is a new frontier in medicine.
frontier.example_zh: 基因療法是醫學的一個新領域。

frown.example: A worried frown crossed the doctor's face.
frown.example_zh: 醫生臉上掠過一抹擔憂的皺眉。

frustrate.example: Slow healing began to frustrate the patient.
frustrate.example_zh: 緩慢的癒合開始讓病人感到挫折。

frustrating.example: It was frustrating to heal so slowly.
frustrating.example_zh: 癒合得這麼慢令人沮喪。

frustration.example: Slow progress can provoke deep frustration in patients.
frustration.example_zh: 進展緩慢會引發病人深深的挫折感。

fuel.example: Food is the fuel the healing body needs.
fuel.example_zh: 食物是復原中的身體所需的燃料。

fulfil.example: She worked hard to fulfil her dream of nursing.
fulfil.example_zh: 她努力實現當護理師的夢想。

fulfilling.example: She finds nursing a deeply fulfilling career.
fulfilling.example_zh: 她覺得護理是一份極有成就感的職業。

functional.example: After therapy, her hand was fully functional again.
functional.example_zh: 治療後，她的手又恢復了完全的功能。

fund.example: A special fund pays for treatment the poor cannot afford.
fund.example_zh: 一筆專款支付窮人負擔不起的治療。

fundamental.example: Hand washing is a fundamental rule of hygiene.
fundamental.example_zh: 洗手是衛生的基本準則。

funding.example: Funding cuts can stifle medical innovation.
funding.example_zh: 經費刪減會扼殺醫學創新。

fungible.example: Money is fungible, since one ten-dollar bill is as good as another.
fungible.example_zh: 金錢是可替代的，因為一張十元鈔票和另一張並無差別。

fur.example: Pet fur can trigger her asthma.
fur.example_zh: 寵物的毛會引發她的氣喘。

furious.example: The patient was furious about the long wait.
furious.example_zh: 病人對漫長的等待感到憤怒。

furniture.example: Comfortable furniture was scattered around the waiting room.
furniture.example_zh: 候診室裡四處擺放著舒適的家具。

gaffe.example: The minister's embarrassing gaffe dominated the news for an entire week.
gaffe.example_zh: 部長那次難堪的失言，整整佔據了一週的新聞版面。

galaxy.example: The night sky was full of distant galaxies.
galaxy.example_zh: 夜空中布滿了遙遠的星系。

gallery.example: A bright gallery of portraits lined the hospital corridor.
gallery.example_zh: 一道明亮的肖像長廊沿著醫院走廊排列。

gallon.example: She drank nearly a gallon of water that hot day.
gallon.example_zh: 那個炎熱的日子她喝了將近一加侖的水。

gap.example: New clinics aim to minimize the gap in rural healthcare.
gap.example_zh: 新診所旨在縮小偏鄉醫療的落差。

garbage.example: Medical garbage must be disposed of with care.
garbage.example_zh: 醫療垃圾必須謹慎處理。

garment.example: Each garment was washed at a high heat.
garment.example_zh: 每件衣物都以高溫清洗。

gasoline.example: The smell of gasoline made her feel sick.
gasoline.example_zh: 汽油的味道讓她感到噁心。

gasp.example: She let out a gasp of pain as she sat up.
gasp.example_zh: 她坐起來時痛得倒抽一口氣。

gauge.example: The nurse used a gauge to check his blood pressure.
gauge.example_zh: 護理師用血壓計測量他的血壓。

gaze.example: Her gaze drifted to the window as she rested.
gaze.example_zh: 她休息時，目光飄向了窗外。

gear.example: The hikers carried first-aid gear in their packs.
gear.example_zh: 登山客在背包裡帶了急救裝備。

gene.example: A faulty gene raises the risk of the disease.
gene.example_zh: 一個有缺陷的基因會提高這種病的風險。

general.example: The doctor assessed her general health as good.
general.example_zh: 醫師評估她的整體健康狀況良好。

generally.example: Patients generally feel better within days.
generally.example_zh: 病人通常在幾天內就會好轉。

generate.example: The exercise generates heat in the muscles.
generate.example_zh: 這項運動會在肌肉中產生熱能。

generation.example: The disease can pass from one generation to the next.
generation.example_zh: 這種病可能一代傳一代。

generator.example: A backup generator kept the ward running.
generator.example_zh: 一台備用發電機維持著病房的運作。

generous.example: A generous donor funded the children's ward.
generous.example_zh: 一位慷慨的捐贈者資助了兒童病房。

genetic.example: The disorder has a strong genetic cause.
genetic.example_zh: 這種疾病有很強的遺傳因素。

genius.example: It took no genius to see he needed rest.
genius.example_zh: 不用天才也看得出他需要休息。

genre.example: Calm music of any genre helped her sleep.
genre.example_zh: 任何類型的輕柔音樂都能幫她入睡。

gentle.example: The nurse had a gentle touch with the newborn.
gentle.example_zh: 護理師對新生兒的動作很輕柔。

genuine.example: Patients felt genuine appreciation for her gentle care.
genuine.example_zh: 病人對她溫柔的照護懷有由衷的感激。

geographic.example: The disease has a clear geographic pattern.
geographic.example_zh: 這種病有明顯的地理分布模式。

geopolitical.example: Rising oil prices reflect the geopolitical tensions between the two regions.
geopolitical.example_zh: 油價上漲反映了兩個地區之間的地緣政治緊張。

gesture.example: A kind gesture from the nurse calmed her.
gesture.example_zh: 護理師一個善意的舉動安撫了她。

giant.example: A giant of medicine, she trained hundreds of doctors.
giant.example_zh: 身為醫界巨擘，她培育了數百名醫生。

gifted.example: She was a gifted surgeon, calm under pressure.
gifted.example_zh: 她是位天賦異稟的外科醫生，臨危不亂。

glance.example: The doctor took a quick glance at the chart.
glance.example_zh: 醫生迅速瞄了一眼病歷。

glimpse.example: She caught a glimpse of hope in his eyes.
glimpse.example_zh: 她瞥見了他眼中的一絲希望。

gloat.example: It's unkind to gloat over a rival's misfortune, however much you dislike them.
gloat.example_zh: 無論多麼討厭對手，對他的不幸幸災樂禍都是不厚道的。

global.example: The outbreak quickly became a global concern.
global.example_zh: 這場疫情很快成為全球關注的議題。

glorious.example: It was a glorious feeling to walk again.
glorious.example_zh: 能再次走路是種美妙的感受。

glow.example: A healthy glow returned to her cheeks.
glow.example_zh: 她的雙頰恢復了健康的紅潤。

goal.example: A full recovery is a feasible goal within a few months.
goal.example_zh: 在幾個月內完全康復是個可行的目標。

gorgeous.example: A gorgeous sunset filled the ward window.
gorgeous.example_zh: 一片絢麗的夕陽映滿了病房的窗。

gospel.example: She took the doctor's advice as gospel.
gospel.example_zh: 她把醫生的建議奉為金科玉律。

govern.example: Strict rules govern how the drug is stored.
govern.example_zh: 嚴格的規定規範這種藥的存放方式。

governor.example: The governor came to launch the new children's hospital.
governor.example_zh: 州長前來為新的兒童醫院揭幕。

grab.example: She grabbed the railing to keep from falling.

graduate.example: She will graduate from medical school in June.
graduate.example_zh: 她將在六月從醫學院畢業。

grain.example: Whole grain bread is gentler on blood sugar.
grain.example_zh: 全穀麵包對血糖較溫和。

grand.example: The hospital opened with a grand ceremony.
grand.example_zh: 這家醫院以盛大的典禮揭幕。

grant.example: A research grant funded the cancer study.
grant.example_zh: 一筆研究經費資助了這項癌症研究。

grapevine.example: I heard through the grapevine that the clinic is hiring two new doctors.
grapevine.example_zh: 我從小道消息聽說，那家診所正要聘請兩名新醫師。

graphic.example: The doctor avoided graphic details to spare the family.
graphic.example_zh: 醫生避開血腥的細節，以免家屬難受。

graphics.example: The report used clear graphics to show the data.
graphics.example_zh: 這份報告用清楚的圖表來呈現數據。

grasp.example: He was too weak to grasp the spoon.

grateful.example: She was deeply grateful for the nurses' care.
grateful.example_zh: 她對護理師的照顧深懷感激。

gratify.example: It gratified her to see significant progress in her patient.
gratify.example_zh: 看到病人有顯著進步，令她感到欣慰。

grave.example: The doctor's grave face hinted at the night's drama.
grave.example_zh: 醫師凝重的表情，透露了那一夜的波折。

gravel.example: He scraped his hands on the rough gravel.
gravel.example_zh: 他的手在粗糙的碎石上擦傷了。

gravity.example: She did not grasp the gravity of her condition.
gravity.example_zh: 她沒有意識到自己病情的嚴重性。

green.example: The traffic light turned green and the ambulance sped off.
green.example_zh: 紅綠燈轉綠，救護車疾駛而去。

greenhouse.example: The herbs were grown in a small greenhouse.
greenhouse.example_zh: 這些草藥種在一座小溫室裡。

grief.example: She was overcome with grief at the loss.
grief.example_zh: 失去親人讓她悲痛不已。

grill.example: The chef cooked fish on the grill for the patients.
grill.example_zh: 廚師在烤架上為病人烤魚。

grim.example: The doctor's grim face said it all.
grim.example_zh: 醫生凝重的神情說明了一切。

grin.example: A wide grin spread across the boy's face.
grin.example_zh: 男孩臉上露出了大大的笑容。

grind.example: She had to grind the pills into a fine powder.

grip.example: She kept a firm grip on the handrail while walking.
grip.example_zh: 她走路時緊緊抓著扶手。

gritty.example: Her gritty determination helped her recover fully from the serious injury.
gritty.example_zh: 她堅韌不拔的決心，幫助她從重傷中完全康復。

gross.example: The clinic's gross income rose this year.
gross.example_zh: 這間診所今年的總收入增加了。

group.example: Patients in the treatment group recovered faster.
group.example_zh: 治療組的病人康復得較快。

guarantee.example: No surgery comes with a guarantee of success.
guarantee.example_zh: 沒有任何手術能保證成功。

guilt.example: He felt a heavy guilt for ignoring the warning signs.
guilt.example_zh: 他為忽視了警訊而深感內疚。

guilty.example: She felt guilty for not noticing the symptoms sooner.
guilty.example_zh: 她為沒能更早發現症狀而感到內疚。

gullible.example: He was gullible enough to believe the email promising him a fortune.
gullible.example_zh: 他輕信到相信那封承諾給他財富的電子郵件。

gum.example: Sore gums can make eating painful.
gum.example_zh: 牙齦痠痛會讓進食變得疼痛。

guy.example: The guy in the next bed had a cynical word for every doctor.
guy.example_zh: 隔壁床那個傢伙對每位醫師都有句冷嘲。

gynecologist.example: She made an appointment with her gynecologist for a checkup.
gynecologist.example_zh: 她和婦科醫生預約了一次檢查。

habitat.example: The mosquito's habitat is warm, still water.
habitat.example_zh: 蚊子的棲息地是溫暖、靜止的水域。

habitual.example: His habitual lateness eventually cost him the job.
habitual.example_zh: 他習以為常的遲到習慣最終讓他丟了工作。

hail.example: People hailed the vaccine as a breakthrough.
hail.example_zh: 人們將這款疫苗譽為一大突破。

hall.example: She walked slowly down the hospital hall.
hall.example_zh: 她慢慢走過醫院的走廊。

hallmark.example: Persistent thirst is a hallmark of untreated diabetes.
hallmark.example_zh: 持續口渴是未治療糖尿病的典型特徵。

hallucination.example: High fever can cause hallucinations, making patients see things that aren't there.
hallucination.example_zh: 高燒可能引起幻覺，使病人看見不存在的東西。

hallway.example: She paced the hallway while she waited for news.
hallway.example_zh: 等候消息時她在走廊裡來回踱步。

halt.example: Quick action halted the spread of the infection.
halt.example_zh: 迅速的行動阻止了感染的擴散。

ham.example: He could finally enjoy a slice of ham.
ham.example_zh: 他終於能享用一片火腿了。

hammer.example: Pain pounded in his head like a hammer.
hammer.example_zh: 疼痛像鐵錘般敲打著他的頭。

hamper.example: Heavy rain and thick fog severely hampered the rescue operation.
hamper.example_zh: 大雨和濃霧嚴重妨礙了救援行動。

handful.example: Only a handful of patients reported the side effect.
handful.example_zh: 只有少數幾名病人回報了這項副作用。

handle.example: He gripped the handle of the walking frame.

hang.example: An old chart hung on the wall by the bed.
hang.example_zh: 一張舊圖表掛在床邊的牆上。

haphazard.example: The files were stored in a haphazard, careless way.
haphazard.example_zh: 這些檔案以雜亂無章、隨便的方式存放。

harbor.example: The body can harbor the virus for years.
harbor.example_zh: 身體可能潛藏這種病毒多年。

hardly.example: She had hardly slept for three nights.
hardly.example_zh: 她已經三個晚上幾乎沒睡。

hardware.example: The scanner is the most costly piece of hardware.
hardware.example_zh: 掃描儀是最昂貴的一件硬體設備。

harm.example: Smoking does great harm to the lungs.
harm.example_zh: 吸菸對肺造成極大的傷害。

harmful.example: Too much sun is harmful to the skin.

harmony.example: The team worked in perfect harmony during surgery.
harmony.example_zh: 手術期間團隊配合得天衣無縫。

harsh.example: Harsh soap can dry out sensitive skin.
harsh.example_zh: 刺激性的肥皂會讓敏感肌膚變得乾燥。

harvest.example: The autumn harvest brought fresh food to the village.
harvest.example_zh: 秋收為村莊帶來了新鮮的食物。

hatred.example: Years of pain bred a quiet hatred of hospitals.
hatred.example_zh: 多年的疼痛讓他暗自厭惡醫院。

haul.example: Rescuers had to haul him up the cliff.
haul.example_zh: 救難人員不得不把他從懸崖拉上來。

haunt.example: The loss of the patient continued to haunt her.
haunt.example_zh: 失去這名病人的事一直縈繞在她心頭。

haven.example: The quiet ward was a haven from the busy city.
haven.example_zh: 安靜的病房是逃離忙碌城市的避風港。

hazard.example: Loose wires on the floor are a serious safety hazard.
hazard.example_zh: 地上鬆脫的電線是嚴重的安全危害。

hazardous.example: The lab handles many hazardous chemicals.
hazardous.example_zh: 這間實驗室處理許多危險的化學品。

head.example: Doctors treated the head injury as a serious threat.
head.example_zh: 醫師把這次頭部外傷視為嚴重的威脅。

headquarters.example: The relief team set up headquarters near the clinic.
headquarters.example_zh: 救援隊在診所附近設立了總部。

heal.example: Most cuts heal on their own within a week.
heal.example_zh: 大多數的割傷一週內會自行癒合。

healing.example: Rest is a vital part of the healing process.
healing.example_zh: 休息是癒合過程中重要的一環。

heaven.example: The quiet ward felt like heaven after the busy ER.
heaven.example_zh: 在忙碌的急診之後，安靜的病房宛如天堂。

hedge.example: A low hedge ran along the clinic path.
hedge.example_zh: 一道矮樹籬沿著診所的小徑延伸。

heel.example: The skin on her heel began to peel after the burn.
heel.example_zh: 燙傷後她腳跟的皮膚開始脫落。

height.example: Her height and weight were recorded at the checkup.
height.example_zh: 健檢時記錄了她的身高與體重。

heir.example: He was the sole heir to the family clinic.
heir.example_zh: 他是這家家族診所的唯一繼承人。

held.example: The nurse held the patient's hand firmly until the panic subsided.
held.example_zh: 護理師緊緊握住病人的手，直到他的恐慌平息下來。

helmet.example: Always wear a helmet to protect your head when cycling.
helmet.example_zh: 騎單車時一定要戴安全帽保護頭部。

helpful.example: The nurse gave some very helpful advice.
helpful.example_zh: 護理師給了一些很有幫助的建議。

hence.example: He skipped his pills, hence the relapse.
hence.example_zh: 他漏服了藥，因此病情復發。

herb.example: The old woman brewed a bitter herb for her cough.
herb.example_zh: 老婦人為她的咳嗽熬了一帖苦草藥。
