plague.example: Chronic back pain has plagued him ever since the car accident.
plague.example_zh: 自從那場車禍後，慢性背痛就一直折磨著他。

plain.example: The doctor explained it in plain language.
plain.example_zh: 醫生用淺白的語言解釋了它。

plaintiff.example: The plaintiff claimed the clinic had been negligent.
plaintiff.example_zh: 原告聲稱這間診所有疏失。

plane.example: The patient was flown home on a medical plane.
plane.example_zh: 病人搭乘醫療專機返家。

planet.example: Clean water is scarce in many parts of the planet.
planet.example_zh: 在地球許多地方，乾淨的水都很稀缺。

plantation.example: Many workers on the plantation caught the fever.
plantation.example_zh: 種植園裡許多工人染上了熱病。

plastic.example: The syringe's plastic component is single-use.
plastic.example_zh: 注射器的塑膠部件是一次性的。

plasticity.example: The brain's plasticity allows it to rewire itself after an injury.
plasticity.example_zh: 大腦的可塑性使它能在受傷後重新建立連結。

plate.example: The metal plate holds the broken bone together.
plate.example_zh: 那塊金屬板把斷骨固定在一起。

platform.example: The new health platform runs as a phone application.
platform.example_zh: 這個新的健康平台以手機應用程式的形式運作。

platitude.example: His speech was full of empty platitudes about caring.
platitude.example_zh: 他的演說滿是關於關懷的空洞陳腔濫調。

plausible.example: His explanation for the symptoms sounded plausible.
plausible.example_zh: 他對這些症狀的解釋聽起來似乎合理。

plea.example: The family made a plea for more blood donors.

plead.example: The family will plead until he concedes and eats something.
plead.example_zh: 家人會不斷懇求，直到他讓步吃點東西。

pleasure.example: It was a pleasure to see her face shine with health again.
pleasure.example_zh: 看到她臉上重新煥發健康的光彩，真是令人欣慰。

pledge.example: He took a pledge to donate blood every year.

pledged.example: The foundation pledged a million dollars for the hospital's expansion.
pledged.example_zh: 基金會承諾捐一百萬美元供醫院擴建。

plot.example: The hospital was built on a small plot of land.
plot.example_zh: 這家醫院蓋在一小塊土地上。

plummet.example: His blood pressure began to plummet, alarming the medical team.
plummet.example_zh: 他的血壓開始驟降，讓醫療團隊大為緊張。

plunge.example: Her temperature took a sudden plunge.

poet.example: The old poet wrote of illness as a divine test.
poet.example_zh: 這位老詩人把疾病寫成上天的考驗。

poise.example: The surgeon kept her poise under great pressure.
poise.example_zh: 外科醫生在巨大的壓力下保持鎮定。

poison.example: A common houseplant can be a poison to pets.
poison.example_zh: 一種常見的室內植物對寵物來說可能有毒。

poke.example: The doctor gave the swelling a gentle poke.
poke.example_zh: 醫生輕輕戳了戳那處腫脹。

pole.example: She gripped the metal pole to steady herself.
pole.example_zh: 她抓住金屬柱子穩住身子。

polish.example: The nurse gave the steel tray a final polish.
polish.example_zh: 護理師把鋼盤做了最後的擦亮。

politics.example: She had little interest in hospital politics.
politics.example_zh: 她對醫院裡的權力鬥爭沒什麼興趣。

poll.example: A poll found most people fear hospital visits.
poll.example_zh: 一項民調發現多數人害怕上醫院。

pollution.example: Air pollution worsens many lung diseases.
pollution.example_zh: 空氣汙染會加重許多肺部疾病。

ponder.example: The doctor paused to ponder the strange result.
ponder.example_zh: 醫生停下來思索這個奇怪的結果。

popular.example: Yoga is a popular way to ease back pain.
popular.example_zh: 瑜伽是緩解背痛的熱門方式。

popularity.example: The clinic's popularity meant long waiting times.
popularity.example_zh: 這間診所太受歡迎，候診時間因而很長。

portable.example: A portable monitor tracks her heart at home.
portable.example_zh: 一台可攜式監測儀在家追蹤她的心臟。

portfolio.example: The investor spread risk across a wide portfolio.
portfolio.example_zh: 這名投資人將風險分散在多元的投資組合中。

portion.example: Eat only a small portion, in proportion to your activity.
portion.example_zh: 只吃一小份，與你的活動量成比例。

portrait.example: A portrait of the founder hung in the lobby.
portrait.example_zh: 創辦人的肖像掛在大廳裡。

portray.example: The film portrays the daily life of a country nurse.
portray.example_zh: 這部電影描繪了一位鄉村護理師的日常生活。

pose.example: Untreated high blood pressure can pose a serious risk.
pose.example_zh: 未經治療的高血壓可能構成嚴重風險。

positive.example: The test came back positive for the virus.
positive.example_zh: 檢驗結果對這種病毒呈陽性。

possess.example: She possesses a rare gift for calming patients.
possess.example_zh: 她擁有安撫病人的罕見天賦。

possession.example: The police found stolen drugs in his possession.

post.example: She was given a post in the children's ward.
post.example_zh: 她被分派到兒童病房的職位。

poster.example: A poster on the wall explained how to wash hands.
poster.example_zh: 牆上一張海報說明如何洗手。

posthumously.example: He was posthumously honored for his research.
posthumously.example_zh: 他因其研究在過世後獲得表彰。

posture.example: Good posture can ease lower back pain.
posture.example_zh: 良好的姿勢能緩解下背痛。

postwar.example: The hospital was built in the postwar years.
postwar.example_zh: 這家醫院建於戰後的那些年。

pot.example: She boiled the herbs in a small clay pot.
pot.example_zh: 她用一個小陶罐熬煮草藥。

potency.example: Stored too long, the drug loses much of its potency.
potency.example_zh: 存放太久，藥物會喪失大部分的效力。

potent.example: The new painkiller is far more potent than aspirin.
potent.example_zh: 這款新止痛藥比阿斯匹靈強效得多。

potential.example: The new drug has the potential to save many lives.
potential.example_zh: 這款新藥有拯救許多生命的潛力。

pound.example: Her heart began to pound as the fear escalated.
pound.example_zh: 隨著恐懼升高，她的心臟開始怦怦狂跳。

poverty.example: Poverty and poor health test a society's humanity.
poverty.example_zh: 貧窮與不良的健康狀況考驗著一個社會的人性。

powder.example: The medicine comes as a powder you mix with water.
powder.example_zh: 這種藥是粉末狀，要加水沖泡。

practical.example: The course offers practical training in the ward.
practical.example_zh: 這門課提供病房中的實務訓練。

practically.example: The waiting room was practically empty by evening.
practically.example_zh: 到了傍晚，候診室幾乎空無一人。

practitioner.example: A general practitioner treats everyday illnesses.
practitioner.example_zh: 一般科醫師治療日常的病症。

praise.example: The doctor praised her for taking her pills on time.

preach.example: It is easy to preach exercise but harder to do it.
preach.example_zh: 鼓吹運動容易，要做到卻難。

precede.example: A mild headache often precedes the seizure.
precede.example_zh: 輕微的頭痛常在癲癇發作前出現。

precedence.example: In the emergency room, the most critical cases always take precedence.
precedence.example_zh: 在急診室裡，最危急的病例永遠享有優先處理權。

precedent.example: The unusual case set a new medical precedent.
precedent.example_zh: 這個特殊的病例開創了新的醫學先例。

precious.example: Every minute is precious after a heart attack.
precious.example_zh: 心臟病發作後，每一分鐘都很寶貴。

precipitous.example: After the recall, the company's stock suffered a precipitous decline overnight.
precipitous.example_zh: 召回事件後，公司股價一夜之間暴跌。

precise.example: The dose must be precise for such a small child.
precise.example_zh: 對這麼小的孩子，劑量必須精確。

precision.example: The surgeon worked with great precision.
precision.example_zh: 外科醫生以極高的精準度進行手術。

predator.example: In the wild, a sick animal is easy prey for a predator.
predator.example_zh: 在野外，生病的動物容易成為掠食者的獵物。

predecessor.example: She learned much from her predecessor on the ward.
predecessor.example_zh: 她從病房的前任那裡學到很多。

predict.example: It is hard to predict how the illness will progress.
predict.example_zh: 很難預測這種病將如何發展。

predictable.example: The side effects of the drug are mild and predictable.
predictable.example_zh: 這種藥的副作用輕微且可預測。

prediction.example: The doctor's prediction of a full recovery came true.
prediction.example_zh: 醫生對完全康復的預測成真了。

predispose.example: A family history of heart disease can predispose someone to similar conditions.
predispose.example_zh: 心臟病的家族病史可能使人較易罹患類似的疾病。

predominantly.example: The ward is staffed predominantly by young nurses.
predominantly.example_zh: 這個病房主要由年輕護理師組成。

preference.example: She submitted a clear preference for tablets over injections.
preference.example_zh: 她提出了明確偏好，寧可吃藥也不打針。

pregnant.example: Pregnant women should avoid this medication.
pregnant.example_zh: 孕婦應避免使用這種藥物。

prejudice.example: Patients should not face prejudice over their illness.
prejudice.example_zh: 病人不該因疾病而受到偏見對待。

preliminary.example: Preliminary tests pointed to a mild infection.
preliminary.example_zh: 初步檢查顯示是輕微感染。

premise.example: The advice rests on the premise that the diet is healthy.
premise.example_zh: 這項建議建立在這種飲食健康的前提上。

premium.example: She paid a higher premium for better health cover.
premium.example_zh: 她付了較高的保費以換取更好的醫療保障。

preposterous.example: The idea that the earth is flat is utterly preposterous.
preposterous.example_zh: 認為地球是平的這種想法實在荒謬至極。

prerequisite.example: Passing chemistry is a prerequisite for enrolling in the biochemistry course.
prerequisite.example_zh: 通過化學課是修讀生物化學課程的先決條件。

prescient.example: His prescient warning about the epidemic came years before the outbreak.
prescient.example_zh: 他對這場流行病的預警極具先見之明，比疫情爆發早了好幾年。

prescribe.example: The doctor will prescribe a cream for the rash.
prescribe.example_zh: 醫生會開一款藥膏來治這疹子。

prescription.example: She is eligible for a repeat prescription from her family doctor.
prescription.example_zh: 她有資格向家庭醫師領取連續處方箋。

presence.example: The presence of blood confirmed the suspected ulcer.
presence.example_zh: 驗出血液，證實了原先懷疑的潰瘍。

presentation.example: The doctor's presentation used a clear illustration of the heart.
presentation.example_zh: 醫師的簡報用了一張清楚的心臟圖解。

preservation.example: Cold storage is key to the preservation of the drug.
preservation.example_zh: 冷藏是保存這種藥的關鍵。

preservative.example: Manufacturers add preservatives to processed food to stop it from spoiling.
preservative.example_zh: 廠商在加工食品中添加防腐劑，以防止食物腐壞。

preserve.example: Salt has long been used to preserve food.
preserve.example_zh: 鹽長久以來被用來保存食物。

presidency.example: He fell ill during his second year of the presidency.
presidency.example_zh: 他在總統任期的第二年病倒了。

press.example: Press firmly on the wound to stop the bleeding.

pressure.example: The blood was pumped under high pressure.

presumably.example: He is late, presumably stuck in traffic.
presumably.example_zh: 他遲到了，大概是塞在路上。

presume.example: The doctor presumed the rash was an allergy.
presume.example_zh: 醫生推測這疹子是過敏。

pretend.example: The child pretended that the medicine tasted fine.

prevail.example: Calm finally prevailed in the crowded waiting room.
prevail.example_zh: 擁擠的候診室裡終於恢復了平靜。

prevalence.example: The prevalence of diabetes has risen sharply in recent decades.
prevalence.example_zh: 近幾十年來，糖尿病的盛行率急遽上升。

prevalent.example: Obesity is increasingly prevalent among young people.
prevalent.example_zh: 肥胖在年輕人之間越來越普遍。

prevaricate.example: Instead of admitting his mistake, he continued to prevaricate and dodge questions.
prevaricate.example_zh: 他不肯承認錯誤，反而不斷支吾搪塞、迴避問題。

prevent.example: Maintaining good hygiene helps prevent the spread of infection.
prevent.example_zh: 維持良好衛生有助於防止感染擴散。

previous.example: Tell the doctor about any previous surgery.
previous.example_zh: 告訴醫生你先前是否動過手術。

prey.example: A weak immune system makes the body easy prey.
prey.example_zh: 虛弱的免疫系統讓身體容易被病魔侵襲。

pride.example: She takes great pride in her integrity as a doctor.
pride.example_zh: 她對自己身為醫師的正直深感自豪。

primary.example: Her primary concern was the pain in her chest.
primary.example_zh: 她最主要的擔憂是胸口的疼痛。

prime.example: In the prime of life, he sank into deep depression.
prime.example_zh: 正值壯年，他卻陷入了深深的憂鬱。

primitive.example: Primitive tools made of stone have been found at the site.
primitive.example_zh: 遺址出土了以石頭製成的原始工具。

principal.example: The principal cause of his illness was poor diet.
principal.example_zh: 他生病的主要原因是不良的飲食。

principle.example: The treatment follows a simple principle: rest and fluids.
principle.example_zh: 這項治療遵循一個簡單的原則：休息與補水。

prior.example: Prior heart problems may exclude you from the trial.
prior.example_zh: 先前的心臟問題可能使你被排除在試驗之外。

priority.example: The most urgent patients are given priority.
priority.example_zh: 最緊急的病人會被優先處理。

prison.example: Healthcare in the prison was poor for years.
prison.example_zh: 這座監獄的醫療多年來都很差。

private.example: She was recently moved to a quiet private room.
private.example_zh: 她最近被移到一間安靜的單人房。

privilege.example: It was a privilege to care for her in her last days.
privilege.example_zh: 能在她生命最後的日子裡照顧她是種榮幸。

probe.example: Doctors used a thin probe to examine the artery.
probe.example_zh: 醫生用一根細探針檢查那條動脈。

procedure.example: The procedure takes about an hour under local anesthetic.
procedure.example_zh: 這項手術在局部麻醉下約需一小時。

proceed.example: Once the test results are normal, we can proceed with surgery.
proceed.example_zh: 一旦檢查結果正常，我們就能進行手術。

proceeding.example: The legal proceeding against the clinic dragged on.
proceeding.example_zh: 對這間診所的法律訴訟拖了很久。

process.example: Healing is a slow process that takes patience.
process.example_zh: 癒合是一個需要耐心的緩慢過程。

proclaim.example: The minister proclaimed the end of the epidemic.

proclivity.example: Children with a proclivity for sweets often resist eating vegetables.
proclivity.example_zh: 偏好甜食的孩子往往抗拒吃蔬菜。

procrastination.example: Chronic procrastination meant he always finished his reports at the last minute.
procrastination.example_zh: 長期的拖延習慣，讓他總是拖到最後一刻才完成報告。

produce.example: The body cannot produce enough of the hormone.
produce.example_zh: 身體無法製造足夠的這種荷爾蒙。

productive.example: A good night's sleep made her more productive.
productive.example_zh: 一夜好眠讓她更有效率。

productivity.example: Poor health lowered his productivity at work.
productivity.example_zh: 不佳的健康降低了他工作的生產力。

profession.example: She is proud to belong to the nursing profession.
profession.example_zh: 她以身為護理這一行為榮。

professional.example: Always seek professional advice before stopping a drug.
professional.example_zh: 停藥前務必尋求專業建議。

profile.example: Her risk profile suggested a higher chance of stroke.
profile.example_zh: 她的風險概況顯示中風的機率較高。

profit.example: Private clinics can be lucrative, but this one runs for care, not profit.
profit.example_zh: 私人診所可以很賺錢，但這家以照護為宗旨，不為營利。

profligate.example: His profligate spending soon drained the entire family fortune.
profligate.example_zh: 他揮霍無度的花費，很快就耗盡了整個家族的財產。

profound.example: The diagnosis had a profound effect on her outlook.
profound.example_zh: 這個診斷對她的人生觀產生了深遠的影響。

progress.example: She has made great progress since the surgery.
progress.example_zh: 自手術以來，她進步很大。

progressive.example: The disease causes a progressive loss of memory.
progressive.example_zh: 這種疾病會造成漸進性的記憶喪失。

prohibit.example: The rules prohibit eating in the operating room.
prohibit.example_zh: 規定禁止在手術室內進食。

project.example: The project will analyze data from a thousand children.
project.example_zh: 這項計畫將分析一千名兒童的數據。

projection.example: The scan gives a clear projection of the bone.
projection.example_zh: 這項掃描給出骨頭清晰的投影。

proliferate.example: Cancer cells can proliferate at an alarming rate.
proliferate.example_zh: 癌細胞能以驚人的速度增生。

prolific.example: The prolific author published more than fifty novels in his lifetime.
prolific.example_zh: 這位多產的作家一生出版了五十多部小說。

prolifically.example: The author wrote so prolifically that she published three novels a year.
prolifically.example_zh: 這位作家創作力極為旺盛，一年就出版三部小說。

prolong.example: Early treatment can prolong the lives of patients with chronic illness.
prolong.example_zh: 及早治療能延長慢性病患者的壽命。

prominent.example: A prominent vein stood out on his forearm.
prominent.example_zh: 他前臂上一條明顯的靜脈凸了出來。

promise.example: The new drug shows real promise, but no ultimate cure yet.
promise.example_zh: 這款新藥很有希望，但仍非根本的解藥。

promising.example: Early results of the drug are very promising.
promising.example_zh: 這種藥的早期結果非常有希望。

promote.example: A balanced diet helps promote good health.
promote.example_zh: 均衡的飲食有助於促進健康。

prompt.example: Prompt treatment saved the patient's leg.
prompt.example_zh: 及時的治療保住了病人的腿。

prone.example: People with diabetes are more prone to infections.
prone.example_zh: 糖尿病患者較容易發生感染。

proof.example: The trial offered clear proof that the drug works.
proof.example_zh: 這項試驗提供了藥物有效的明確證據。

prop.example: A pillow was used to prop up his injured leg.
prop.example_zh: 一個枕頭被用來墊高他受傷的腿。

propagate.example: Bacteria propagate rapidly in warm, moist conditions.
propagate.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖潮濕的環境中迅速繁殖。

proper.example: Proper rest is as important as medicine.
proper.example_zh: 適當的休息和藥物一樣重要。

property.example: This herb has a calming property.
property.example_zh: 這種草藥具有鎮靜的特性。

proponent.example: She is a leading proponent of preventive care.
proponent.example_zh: 她是預防性醫療的主要倡導者。

proponents.example: Proponents of the diet claim it lowers cholesterol.
proponents.example_zh: 這種飲食法的支持者宣稱它能降低膽固醇。

proportion.example: A predictable proportion of patients relapse each year.
proportion.example_zh: 每年都有可預期比例的病人復發。

proposal.example: The proposal for a new clinic was approved.
proposal.example_zh: 興建新診所的提案獲得批准。

propose.example: The surgeon proposed a less invasive option.
propose.example_zh: 外科醫生提議了一個侵入性較小的選項。

proposition.example: Quitting smoking was a tough proposition for him.
proposition.example_zh: 戒菸對他來說是件難事。

prosecute.example: The state chose to prosecute the negligent doctor.
prosecute.example_zh: 政府決定起訴這名失職的醫生。

prosecution.example: The clinic faced prosecution for the safety breach.
prosecution.example_zh: 這間診所因違反安全規定而面臨起訴。

prospect.example: The prospect of surgery frightened the young patient.
prospect.example_zh: 手術的前景嚇壞了這名年輕病人。

prospective.example: A prospective donor must pass several tests.
prospective.example_zh: 準捐贈者必須通過數項檢查。

prospects.example: Early treatment greatly improves a patient's prospects.
prospects.example_zh: 早期治療能大幅改善病人的康復前景。

prosperity.example: Better health often follows a country's prosperity.
prosperity.example_zh: 較好的健康往往伴隨著國家的繁榮。

prosperous.example: The clinic grew into a prosperous private hospital.
prosperous.example_zh: 這間診所發展成一家興盛的私人醫院。

protection.example: A mask offers some protection against the virus.
protection.example_zh: 口罩對這種病毒提供一些防護。

protein.example: The body needs protein to repair damaged tissue.
protein.example_zh: 身體需要蛋白質來修復受損的組織。

protest.example: Patients held a protest against the clinic's closure.
protest.example_zh: 病人們為反對診所關閉而抗議。

protocol.example: The nurse followed the safety protocol exactly.
protocol.example_zh: 護理師嚴格遵循安全規範。

prototype.example: The team tested a prototype of the new monitor.
prototype.example_zh: 團隊測試了新型監測儀的原型。

provide.example: The clinic provides free maintenance medication for chronic patients.
provide.example_zh: 診所為慢性病人提供免費的維持性藥物。

province.example: Mosquitoes transmitted the virus across the whole province.
province.example_zh: 蚊子把病毒傳播到全省各地。

provincial.example: She trained at a small provincial hospital.
provincial.example_zh: 她在一家小型的地方醫院受訓。

provision.example: The clinic made provision for emergencies.
provision.example_zh: 這間診所為緊急狀況做了準備。

provocative.example: The researcher published a provocative theory that challenged old beliefs.
provocative.example_zh: 這位研究者發表了一項挑戰舊有觀念、極具爭議性的理論。

provoke.example: Certain foods can provoke a flare-up of the rash.
provoke.example_zh: 某些食物會誘發疹子的發作。

prowess.example: The surgeon was admired for her remarkable technical prowess in the operating room.
prowess.example_zh: 這位外科醫師因在手術室中超凡的技術而備受敬佩。

prudent.example: It is prudent to get a second opinion before surgery.
prudent.example_zh: 手術前徵詢第二意見是明智的。

psychologist.example: A psychologist helped him manage his anxiety.
psychologist.example_zh: 一位心理師幫助他控制焦慮。

psychology.example: He studied the psychology of chronic pain.
psychology.example_zh: 他研究慢性疼痛的心理學。

publication.example: The study appeared in a major medical publication.
publication.example_zh: 這項研究刊登在一份重要的醫學刊物上。

publicity.example: The new vaccine got a lot of publicity.
publicity.example_zh: 這款新疫苗受到大量的宣傳。

pull.example: The nurse will gently pull the suture out and trim the ends.
pull.example_zh: 護理師會輕輕將縫線拉出並修剪末端。

pulse.example: The nurse checked his pulse and noted it was racing.
pulse.example_zh: 護理師量了他的脈搏，發現跳得很快。

pummel.example: The boxer continued to pummel his opponent until the referee stopped the fight.
pummel.example_zh: 那名拳擊手不斷痛擊對手，直到裁判中止比賽。

pump.example: The heart is a powerful pump for the blood.
pump.example_zh: 心臟是輸送血液的強力幫浦。

pumpkin.example: Pumpkin is rich in vitamins and easy to digest.
pumpkin.example_zh: 南瓜富含維生素又好消化。

punch.example: The machine punches a code into each label.
punch.example_zh: 這台機器在每張標籤上打上編碼。

pungent.example: The ointment had a pungent, medicinal smell.
pungent.example_zh: 這款藥膏有股刺鼻的藥味。

pupil.example: The doctor shone a light to check his pupil.
pupil.example_zh: 醫生用光照他的瞳孔做檢查。

purchase.example: The hospital made a large purchase of new beds.
purchase.example_zh: 醫院大量採購了新病床。

pure.example: Store the pure solution in a sealed container.
pure.example_zh: 把純淨的溶液存放在密封的容器中。

purple.example: The bruise slowly turned a deep purple.
purple.example_zh: 瘀青慢慢變成了深紫色。

purse.example: She kept her pills in a small zipped purse.
purse.example_zh: 她把藥放在一個拉鍊小錢包裡。

pursue.example: He decided to pursue a career in medicine.
pursue.example_zh: 他決定追求醫學方面的事業。

puzzle.example: Her odd symptoms puzzled even the experts.
puzzle.example_zh: 她古怪的症狀連專家都困惑。

pyramid.example: The food pyramid puts vegetables near the base.
pyramid.example_zh: 飲食金字塔把蔬菜放在底層附近。

qualified.example: Only a qualified doctor may sign the form.
qualified.example_zh: 只有合格的醫生才能簽署這份表格。

qualify.example: She studied hard to qualify as a nurse.
qualify.example_zh: 她苦讀以取得護理師的資格。

quality.example: The clinic offers a full spectrum of high-quality care.
quality.example_zh: 這家診所提供全方位的高品質照護。

quandary.example: She was in a quandary over whether to accept the risky surgery.
quandary.example_zh: 她陷入兩難，不知是否該接受這項有風險的手術。

quantity.example: Only a small quantity of the drug is needed.

quantum.example: The discovery was a quantum leap in treatment.
quantum.example_zh: 這項發現是治療上的一大飛躍。

quarantine.example: Passengers showing symptoms were placed in quarantine to prevent the disease from spreading.
quarantine.example_zh: 出現症狀的旅客被隔離，以防止疾病擴散。

quarrel.example: The two colleagues had a bitter quarrel over who deserved the credit.
quarrel.example_zh: 這兩位同事為了功勞該歸誰而激烈爭吵。

quarter.example: Nearly a quarter of patients skip their medication.
quarter.example_zh: 將近四分之一的病人會漏服藥物。

quest.example: Her quest for a cure took her around the world.
quest.example_zh: 她尋找解藥的旅程帶她走遍世界。

questionable.example: The clinic's hygiene was of questionable quality.
questionable.example_zh: 這間診所的衛生品質令人存疑。

questionnaire.example: Each patient filled in a short health questionnaire.
questionnaire.example_zh: 每位病人都填了一份簡短的健康問卷。

quilt.example: A warm quilt covered the sleeping child.
quilt.example_zh: 一條溫暖的棉被蓋著熟睡的孩子。

quota.example: The clinic met its quota of free checkups.
quota.example_zh: 這間診所達成了免費健檢的配額。

quote.example: The builder gave a quote for the new clinic.

race.example: He won the race despite an injured ankle.
race.example_zh: 儘管腳踝受傷，他仍贏得了比賽。

rack.example: The test tubes stood in a wooden rack.

radar.example: The disease slipped under the doctor's radar at first.
radar.example_zh: 這種病起初沒被醫生察覺。

radiation.example: She received radiation to shrink the tumor.
radiation.example_zh: 她接受放射治療來縮小腫瘤。

radical.example: The doctor suggested a radical change in his diet.
radical.example_zh: 醫生建議他的飲食做出徹底的改變。

radius.example: The ambulance covers every village within a ten-mile radius.
radius.example_zh: 救護車服務範圍涵蓋十英里半徑內的每個村莊。

rage.example: He could barely contain his rage at the bad news.
rage.example_zh: 聽到壞消息，他幾乎無法抑制怒火。

raid.example: Police carried out a raid on the fake drug seller.
raid.example_zh: 警方突襲了販賣假藥的人。

rail.example: He held the rail tightly as he climbed the stairs.
rail.example_zh: 他爬樓梯時緊握著扶手。

raise.example: Regular exercise can raise your level of good cholesterol.
raise.example_zh: 規律運動能提高你體內好膽固醇的含量。

rally.example: His strength began to rally after the meal.
rally.example_zh: 用餐後他的力氣開始恢復。

ramp.example: A wheelchair ramp led up to the clinic door.
ramp.example_zh: 一道輪椅坡道通向診所的門口。

ranch.example: He grew up working on a cattle ranch.
ranch.example_zh: 他在一個養牛的牧場長大工作。

random.example: Patients were placed in random groups for the trial.
random.example_zh: 病人被隨機分組進行試驗。

range.example: The clinic treats a wide range of conditions.
range.example_zh: 這間診所治療各式各樣的病症。

rank.example: He rose through the ranks to become head nurse.
rank.example_zh: 他一路晉升，當上了護理長。

rap.example: There was a soft rap on the ward door.
rap.example_zh: 病房門上傳來輕輕的敲門聲。

rare.example: She suffers from a rare blood disorder.
rare.example_zh: 她罹患一種罕見的血液疾病。

rarely.example: This complication rarely occurs in healthy adults.
rarely.example_zh: 這種併發症在健康成人身上很少發生。

rash.example: An allergic reaction caused an itchy red rash all over her arms.
rash.example_zh: 過敏反應使她雙臂佈滿發癢的紅疹。

rat.example: The lab rats were deliberately exposed to the toxin.
rat.example_zh: 實驗白鼠被刻意暴露於這種毒素中。

rather.example: I would rather take the stairs than wait for the elevator.
rather.example_zh: 我寧可走樓梯，也不要等電梯。

ratio.example: Nurses worry about the high patient-to-staff ratio.
ratio.example_zh: 護理師擔心病人與人力的比例過高。

rational.example: She made a calm, rational choice about surgery.
rational.example_zh: 她對手術做出了冷靜而理性的選擇。

rattle.example: The pills rattle in the bottle when shaken.
rattle.example_zh: 搖晃時藥丸在瓶子裡嘎嘎作響。

raw.example: Eating raw meat can lead to infection.

ray.example: An X-ray uses a special kind of ray.
ray.example_zh: X 光使用一種特殊的射線。

react.example: Doctors must react fast to stem an allergic reaction.
react.example_zh: 醫師必須快速反應，以遏止過敏反應。

readily.example: The new nurse readily admitted her mistake.
readily.example_zh: 這位新護理師爽快地承認了自己的錯誤。

ready.example: The operating room was ready by dawn.
ready.example_zh: 手術室在天亮前就準備好了。

realization.example: The realization that he was cured brought tears.
realization.example_zh: 意識到自己已痊癒，他流下了眼淚。

realize.example: She did not realize how serious the illness was.
realize.example_zh: 她沒意識到這病有多嚴重。

realm.example: Such cures lie in the realm of folk medicine.
realm.example_zh: 這類療法屬於民俗醫療的範疇。

rear.example: A scar ran across the rear of his head.

reason.example: There is no obvious reason for her sudden fever.
reason.example_zh: 她突然發燒沒有明顯的原因。

reassure.example: The doctor tried to reassure the worried mother.
reassure.example_zh: 醫生試著安撫這位憂心的母親。

rebate.example: Customers who buy the printer can claim a fifty-dollar cash rebate.
rebate.example_zh: 購買這台印表機的顧客可申請五十美元的現金回饋。

rebel.example: His immune system began to rebel against his own body.
rebel.example_zh: 他的免疫系統開始反過來攻擊自己的身體。

rebellion.example: His body's rebellion against the organ worried doctors.
rebellion.example_zh: 他身體對這個器官的反抗讓醫生擔憂。

rebuild.example: Therapy helped him rebuild the strength in his arm.
rebuild.example_zh: 治療幫助他重建了手臂的力量。

recall.example: The maker issued a recall of the faulty device.
recall.example_zh: 製造商發布了這款瑕疵裝置的回收。

recede.example: Once the fever broke, his symptoms gradually began to recede.
recede.example_zh: 燒一退，他的症狀便逐漸開始消退。

receiver.example: He picked up the telephone receiver to call the nurse.
receiver.example_zh: 他拿起電話聽筒打給護理師。

recent.example: A recent study links the drug to fewer strokes.
recent.example_zh: 近期一項研究將這種藥與較少的中風連結起來。

recently.example: He was recently discharged from the hospital.

reception.example: The drug got a warm reception from doctors.
reception.example_zh: 這種藥受到醫生們的熱烈歡迎。

recession.example: During the recession, fewer people sought care.
recession.example_zh: 經濟衰退期間，求醫的人變少了。

recipe.example: The nurse shared a recipe for a healthy soup.
recipe.example_zh: 護理師分享了一道健康湯品的食譜。

recipient.example: The recipient of the kidney is doing well.
recipient.example_zh: 接受腎臟的病人狀況良好。

reciprocal.example: The two countries signed a reciprocal agreement to lower trade tariffs.
reciprocal.example_zh: 兩國簽署了一項互惠協議，以降低貿易關稅。

reciprocate.example: A mere acquaintance helped me, so I tried to reciprocate.
reciprocate.example_zh: 一位只是點頭之交的人幫了我，我也試著回報。

reckon.example: Doctors reckon that the patient will fully recover within a month.
reckon.example_zh: 醫生估計這位病人會在一個月內完全康復。

recognition.example: Her years of service won recognition across the profession.
recognition.example_zh: 她多年的付出贏得了整個專業領域的肯定。

recognize.example: She did not recognize the early signs of a stroke.
recognize.example_zh: 她沒認出中風的早期徵兆。

recommend.example: The doctor recommended plenty of rest.

recommendation.example: On the doctor's recommendation, she changed her diet.
recommendation.example_zh: 在醫生的建議下，她改變了飲食。

reconciliation.example: Illness brought a quiet reconciliation between them.
reconciliation.example_zh: 疾病讓他們之間悄悄地和解了。

reconstruction.example: The surgeon performed a careful reconstruction of the jaw.
reconstruction.example_zh: 外科醫生小心地重建了下顎。

recording.example: A recording of the heartbeat was saved for review.
recording.example_zh: 心跳的錄音被保存下來以供檢視。

recount.example: She recounted her symptoms to the doctor.
recount.example_zh: 她向醫生細述了她的症狀。

recover.example: It took months for him to recover from the surgery.
recover.example_zh: 他花了好幾個月才從手術中康復。

recreation.example: Reading was her only recreation in hospital.
recreation.example_zh: 閱讀是她住院時唯一的消遣。

recreational.example: The ward has a small recreational area.
recreational.example_zh: 這個病房有一個小小的休閒區。

recruit.example: The hospital is trying to recruit more nurses.
recruit.example_zh: 醫院正設法招募更多護理師。

rectify.example: The pharmacist quickly rectified the dosing error.
rectify.example_zh: 藥師迅速糾正了劑量錯誤。

recycle.example: The clinic recycles its paper and glass.
recycle.example_zh: 這間診所回收紙張與玻璃。

reduce.example: Cutting salt can help reduce blood pressure.
reduce.example_zh: 減少鹽分有助於降低血壓。

reduction.example: The new program led to a sharp reduction in errors.
reduction.example_zh: 新計畫使錯誤大幅減少。

refer.example: The doctor will refer her to an associate who treats heart disease.
refer.example_zh: 醫師會把她轉介給一位治療心臟病的同僚。

reflect.example: The mirror reflected the harsh ward lights.
reflect.example_zh: 鏡子反射出病房刺眼的燈光。

reflection.example: Quiet reflection brought her a sense of harmony.
reflection.example_zh: 靜靜的省思讓她感到一種平和。

reform.example: The new minister promised to reform the health system.
reform.example_zh: 新任部長承諾改革醫療體系。

refrigerator.example: The vaccine must be kept in a refrigerator.
refrigerator.example_zh: 這款疫苗必須冷藏在冰箱裡。

refuge.example: The clinic was a refuge for the sick and poor.
refuge.example_zh: 這間診所是病人與窮人的庇護所。

refugee.example: The clinic treats refugee families for free.
refugee.example_zh: 這間診所免費為難民家庭看診。

refuse.example: The patient refused to take the bitter medicine.

regard.example: The doctor is held in high regard by his patients.
regard.example_zh: 這位醫生深受病人敬重。

regardless.example: She kept working regardless of her own fatigue.
regardless.example_zh: 不顧自身的疲憊，她繼續工作。

regime.example: He started a strict new diet regime.
regime.example_zh: 他開始了一套嚴格的新飲食方案。

regional.example: A regional hospital handles the most serious cases.
regional.example_zh: 一家區域醫院處理最嚴重的病例。

register.example: Register at the desk so staff can retrieve your records.
register.example_zh: 請先在櫃台登記，好讓人員調出你的病歷。

regular.example: Take the medicine at regular intervals.
regular.example_zh: 按固定的間隔服用這種藥。

regulate.example: The kidneys help regulate the level of salt in the blood.
regulate.example_zh: 腎臟有助於調節血液中的鹽分濃度。

regulation.example: A new regulation requires approval before the drug is sold.
regulation.example_zh: 新法規要求藥品上市前須先取得核准。

regulatory.example: The drug passed every regulatory check.
regulatory.example_zh: 這種藥通過了每一項法規審查。

rehabilitation.example: He spent months in rehabilitation after the stroke.
rehabilitation.example_zh: 中風後他花了好幾個月做復健。

rehearsal.example: The team did a rehearsal of the emergency drill.
rehearsal.example_zh: 團隊演練了一次緊急應變。

reinforce.example: The results reinforce the need to implement stricter rules.
reinforce.example_zh: 這些結果強化了實施更嚴格規定的必要性。

reiterate.example: The teacher had to reiterate the instructions because no one was listening.
reiterate.example_zh: 因為沒人在聽，老師只好重申一遍指示。

reject.example: The body may reject the transplanted organ.
reject.example_zh: 身體可能排斥移植的器官。

rejection.example: The body showed early signs of rejection of the organ.
rejection.example_zh: 身體出現了排斥這個器官的早期跡象。

relate.example: Her own illness let her relate directly to the patient's fear.
relate.example_zh: 她自身的病痛讓她能直接體會病人的恐懼。

relax.example: Try to relax your shoulders during the scan.
relax.example_zh: 掃描時試著放鬆你的肩膀。

relaxed.example: After the good news, she felt calm and relaxed.
relaxed.example_zh: 聽到好消息後，她感到平靜放鬆。

release.example: The gland releases hormones directly into the bloodstream.
release.example_zh: 腺體將荷爾蒙直接釋放進血液中。

relevant.example: Mention any family history relevant to the theme of the study.
relevant.example_zh: 提及任何與研究主題相關的家族病史。

reliability.example: Doctors trust the reliability of the new test.
reliability.example_zh: 醫生信賴這項新檢查的可靠性。

reliable.example: She is a reliable nurse you can always count on.
reliable.example_zh: 她是個你隨時可以信賴的可靠護理師。

relief.example_zh: 止痛藥立刻帶來了舒緩。

relieve.example: A cold compress can relieve the swelling.

religion.example: The hospital respects every patient's religion.
religion.example_zh: 醫院尊重每位病人的宗教信仰。

religious.example: She found comfort in her religious beliefs.
religious.example_zh: 她從宗教信仰中得到慰藉。

reluctant.example: He was reluctant to take such strong medicine.
reluctant.example_zh: 他不太情願服用這麼強的藥。

reluctantly.example: He reluctantly agreed to consume less salt and alcohol.
reluctantly.example_zh: 他不情願地同意減少鹽分與酒精的攝取。

rely.example: Rural clinics rely on a visiting consultant once a month.
rely.example_zh: 偏鄉診所依賴每月一次的駐診顧問醫師。

remaining.example: The remaining tablets should be returned to the pharmacy.
remaining.example_zh: 剩下的藥片應退還給藥局。

remains.example: The remains were sent to the lab for examination.
remains.example_zh: 這些遺骸被送往實驗室檢驗。

remark.example: A careless remark can sound offensive to an anxious patient.
remark.example_zh: 一句不經意的話，對焦慮的病人可能聽來刺耳。

remarkable.example: He made a remarkable recovery after the stroke.
remarkable.example_zh: 中風後他奇蹟般地康復了。

remarkably.example: She recovered remarkably fast after surgery.
remarkably.example_zh: 手術後她復原得異常快速。

remedy.example: Honey is an old remedy for a sore throat.
remedy.example_zh: 蜂蜜是治喉嚨痛的古老偏方。

remind.example: Set an alarm to remind you to take your pills.

reminder.example: The app sends a daily reminder to take your pills.
reminder.example_zh: 這款應用程式每天提醒你吃藥。

remote.example: The doctor advises patients in remote villages by phone.
remote.example_zh: 醫生透過電話為偏遠村莊的病人看診。

removal.example: The surgeon recommended the removal of the inflamed appendix.
removal.example_zh: 外科醫師建議切除發炎的闌尾。

remove.example: The surgeon will remove the inflamed appendix.
remove.example_zh: 外科醫生將切除發炎的闌尾。

render.example: The shock rendered him unable to speak.
render.example_zh: 這個打擊讓他說不出話來。

renew.example: She had to renew her medical license this year.
renew.example_zh: 她今年必須更新她的醫師執照。

rent.example: Rising rent forced the clinic to move.
rent.example_zh: 上漲的租金迫使診所搬遷。

rental.example: A wheelchair rental helped her get around.
rental.example_zh: 租來的輪椅幫助她四處走動。

repair.example: The surgery will repair the damaged heart valve.
repair.example_zh: 這項手術將修補受損的心臟瓣膜。

repay.example: She worked extra shifts to repay the loan she took for school.
repay.example_zh: 她多排了好幾班，以償還上學時借的貸款。

repeat.example: Repeat the dose at the frequency the label states.
repeat.example_zh: 依標示的頻率重複給藥。

repertoire.example: A good physician keeps a wide repertoire of treatment options.
repertoire.example_zh: 一位優秀的醫師掌握著一整套廣泛的治療方案。

repetition.example: Daily repetition of the exercise rebuilt his strength.
repetition.example_zh: 每日反覆做這項運動重建了他的力量。

replace.example: Surgeons replaced the worn joint and installed an artificial hip.
replace.example_zh: 外科醫師置換了磨損的關節，裝上人工髖關節。

replenish.example: Drink water after exercise to replenish the fluids your body has lost.
replenish.example_zh: 運動後要喝水，以補充身體流失的水分。

represent.example: These few cases represent only the tip of the problem.
represent.example_zh: 這寥寥幾例只代表了問題的冰山一角。

representation.example: The chart gives a clear representation of the data.
representation.example_zh: 這張圖清楚地呈現了數據。

representative.example: A representative from the drug company visited the clinic.
representative.example_zh: 一名藥廠代表造訪了診所。

reprimanded.example: The intern was reprimanded for ignoring the protocol.
reprimanded.example_zh: 實習醫生因無視規範而受到申斥。

reproach.example: His mother reproached him for neglecting his daily medication.
reproach.example_zh: 他母親責備他疏忽了每天的服藥。

reproached.example: She reproached him gently, then persuaded him to take his medication.
reproached.example_zh: 她溫和地責備他，再說服他把藥吃了。

reproduce.example: Bacteria reproduce quickly in warm conditions.
reproduce.example_zh: 細菌在溫暖的環境中迅速繁殖。

reproduction.example: The textbook had a reproduction of an old anatomy chart.
reproduction.example_zh: 這本教科書複製了一張古老的解剖圖。

reproductive.example: The drug may affect the reproductive system.
reproductive.example_zh: 這種藥可能影響生殖系統。

republic.example: The disease spread across the small republic.
republic.example_zh: 這種病蔓延了整個小共和國。

repudiate.example: The scientist was forced to repudiate his earlier claims.
repudiate.example_zh: 這名科學家被迫否認他先前的主張。

reputation.example: The clinic has a fine reputation for safety.
reputation.example_zh: 這間診所在安全方面享有好名聲。

request.example: The hospital granted her request and will permit access to her records.
request.example_zh: 醫院批准了她的要求，將允許她查閱病歷。

requirement.example: Rest is a basic requirement for healing.
requirement.example_zh: 休息是癒合的基本條件。

rescue.example: A quick rescue saved the drowning boy.
rescue.example_zh: 一次迅速的搶救救了這名溺水的男孩。

resemble.example: The rash can resemble an ordinary insect bite.
resemble.example_zh: 這種疹子可能看起來像普通的蟲咬。

resentment.example: Years of pain bred a quiet resentment in him.
resentment.example_zh: 多年的疼痛在他心中埋下了一股暗自的怨恨。

reserve.example: The hospital keeps a reserve of blood for emergencies.
reserve.example_zh: 醫院為緊急狀況保留了一批血液。

reservoir.example: The body keeps a reservoir of stored energy.
reservoir.example_zh: 身體保有一座儲存能量的庫存。

reside.example: The infection can reside in the body for years.
reside.example_zh: 這種感染能在體內潛伏數年。

residence.example: The doctor's residence was just behind the clinic.
residence.example_zh: 醫生的住所就在診所後面。

resident.example: A young resident, visibly concerned, examined the patient first.
resident.example_zh: 一位年輕的住院醫師面帶憂色，先為病人做了檢查。

residential.example: The clinic sits in a quiet residential area.
residential.example_zh: 這間診所位於一個寧靜的住宅區。

resignation.example: The doctor handed in her resignation after the scandal.
resignation.example_zh: 醜聞之後，這位醫生遞出了辭呈。

resilient.example: Children are often remarkably resilient after surgery.
resilient.example_zh: 孩子在手術後往往恢復力驚人。

resist.example: A healthy body can resist many infections.
resist.example_zh: 健康的身體能抵抗許多感染。

resistance.example: Overuse of antibiotics breeds drug resistance.
resistance.example_zh: 抗生素的濫用會孳生抗藥性。

resolution.example: A new resolution motivated her to exercise daily.
resolution.example_zh: 一個新的決心激勵她每天運動。

resolve.example: The fever resolved on its own within a week.
resolve.example_zh: 這場發燒在一週內自行退了。

resort.example: Surgery was the last resort after drugs failed.
resort.example_zh: 藥物無效後，手術是最後的手段。

resource.example: Time is a doctor's most precious resource.
resource.example_zh: 時間是醫生最寶貴的資源。

respect.example: A sincere compliment shows respect for the patient's effort.
respect.example_zh: 一句真誠的稱讚，表達了對病人努力的尊重。

respective.example: The two nurses returned to their respective wards.
respective.example_zh: 兩名護理師回到各自的病房。

respectively.example: The two drugs ease pain and fever respectively.
respectively.example_zh: 這兩種藥分別緩解疼痛與發燒。

respond.example: The infection did not respond to the antibiotic.
respond.example_zh: 這個感染對抗生素沒有反應。

respondent.example: Each respondent answered a short health survey.
respondent.example_zh: 每位受訪者都填了一份簡短的健康問卷。

response.example: Her response to the new drug was excellent.

responsibility.example: It is the doctor's responsibility to explain the risks.
responsibility.example_zh: 向病人說明風險是醫生的責任。

responsible.example: The doctor on call is responsible for the whole ward.
responsible.example_zh: 值班醫生負責整個病房。

restoration.example: Physical therapy aims at the restoration of movement.
restoration.example_zh: 物理治療的目標是恢復活動能力。

restore.example: Physical therapy helped restore movement to her injured arm.
restore.example_zh: 物理治療幫助她受傷的手臂恢復了活動能力。

restrain.example: She could barely restrain her anger during the meeting.
restrain.example_zh: 會議中她幾乎無法抑制自己的怒氣。

restrained.example: The agitated patient had to be gently restrained.
restrained.example_zh: 躁動的病人不得不被溫和地約束。

restraint.example: The agitated patient needed gentle restraint.
restraint.example_zh: 躁動的病人需要溫和的約束。

restrict.example: The diet restricts the amount of salt you may eat.
restrict.example_zh: 這種飲食法限制你能攝取的鹽量。

restriction.example: The diet places a strict restriction on salt.
restriction.example_zh: 這種飲食法對鹽分有嚴格的限制。

resume.example: She was eager to resume work after her recovery.
resume.example_zh: 康復後她迫不及待想恢復工作。

resurgence.example: Doctors warn of a resurgence of measles in unvaccinated areas.
resurgence.example_zh: 醫生警告未接種地區麻疹可能捲土重來。

retail.example: The drug costs less than its retail price here.
retail.example_zh: 這種藥在這裡比零售價便宜。

retailer.example: The retailer recalled the contaminated cough syrup.
retailer.example_zh: 這家零售商回收了受汙染的咳嗽糖漿。

retain.example: Patients have the right to retain their identity and dignity in care.
retain.example_zh: 病人有權在受照護時保有自己的身分與尊嚴。

retire.example: He plans to retire after forty years of nursing.
retire.example_zh: 他打算在當了四十年護理師後退休。

retirement.example: After retirement, he made gardening a permanent habit.
retirement.example_zh: 退休後，他把園藝養成了一個長久的習慣。

retract.example: The journal forced the author to retract his fraudulent study.
retract.example_zh: 期刊迫使作者撤回他造假的研究。

retreat.example: She went to a quiet retreat to recover her strength.
retreat.example_zh: 她去了一處寧靜的休養所恢復元氣。

retrieve.example: The nurse hurried to retrieve the patient's file.
retrieve.example_zh: 護理師趕忙去取病人的檔案。

retrospective.example: A retrospective study reviewed records from the past decade.
retrospective.example_zh: 一項回顧性研究檢視了過去十年的病歷。

reveal.example: The scan revealed a small crack in the bone.
reveal.example_zh: 掃描顯示骨頭上有一道小裂縫。

revelation.example: The test result was a shocking revelation.
revelation.example_zh: 這項檢查結果是個令人震驚的揭露。

revenge.example: She had no thought of revenge, only of healing.
revenge.example_zh: 她沒有任何報復的念頭，只想著康復。

revenue.example: The clinic's revenue grew after it expanded.
revenue.example_zh: 診所擴張後，收入有所成長。

reverse.example: Quitting smoking can reverse some of the damage.
reverse.example_zh: 戒菸能逆轉部分的傷害。

review.example: The radiologist will review and interpret the scan.
review.example_zh: 放射科醫師會檢視並判讀這張掃描。

revise.example: The doctor revised the dose after the blood test.
revise.example_zh: 抽血後醫生修改了劑量。

revision.example: The treatment plan needed a small revision.
revision.example_zh: 這套治療計畫需要稍作修訂。

revival.example: A short rest brought a revival of her strength.
revival.example_zh: 短暫的休息讓她恢復了元氣。

revive.example: The team worked fast to revive the patient.
revive.example_zh: 團隊迅速搶救，讓病人甦醒。

revoked.example: His medical license was revoked after the scandal.
revoked.example_zh: 醜聞之後，他的醫師執照被撤銷。

revolution.example: Antibiotics brought a revolution in medicine.
revolution.example_zh: 抗生素為醫學帶來了一場革命。

revolutionary.example: The new scanner was a revolutionary step in diagnosis.
revolutionary.example_zh: 這台新掃描儀是診斷上革命性的一步。

reward.example: The reward of good health justified every sacrifice.
reward.example_zh: 健康這份回報，值得一切的犧牲。

rhetoric.example: His speech was full of fine rhetoric but few facts.
rhetoric.example_zh: 他的演說滿是華麗的辭藻，卻少有事實。

rhythm.example: The drug helped steady the heart's rhythm.
rhythm.example_zh: 這種藥幫助穩定了心臟的節律。

rib.example: He cracked a rib when he fell.
rib.example_zh: 他跌倒時裂了一根肋骨。

ribbon.example: A small ribbon marked the patient's chart.
ribbon.example_zh: 一條小緞帶標記著病人的病歷。

rid.example: Antibiotics helped rid her body of the infection.
rid.example_zh: 抗生素幫她的身體擺脫了感染。

rider.example: The injured rider was thrown from his horse.
rider.example_zh: 那名受傷的騎手從馬背上摔了下來。

ridge.example: The doctor felt a hard ridge along the bone.
ridge.example_zh: 醫生摸到骨頭上有一道堅硬的稜脊。

ridiculous.example: It seemed ridiculous to wait so long for a simple test.
ridiculous.example_zh: 為一項簡單的檢查等這麼久似乎很荒謬。

rifle.example: The hunter cleaned his rifle by the fire.
rifle.example_zh: 獵人在火堆旁擦拭他的步槍。

rigid.example: His joints had grown rigid with age.
rigid.example_zh: 他的關節隨著年齡變得僵硬。

rigor.example: The empirical study was carried out with great scientific rigor.
rigor.example_zh: 這項實證研究以高度的科學嚴謹進行。

rim.example: A red rim formed around the infected cut.
rim.example_zh: 受感染的傷口周圍形成了一圈紅暈。

ring.example: A dark ring formed around the bruise.
ring.example_zh: 瘀青周圍形成了一圈深色。

riot.example: News of the shortage nearly caused a riot at the pharmacy.
riot.example_zh: 短缺的消息差點在藥局引發暴動。

rip.example: Be careful not to rip the stitches open.

ripe.example: She waited for the fruit to grow ripe and sweet.
ripe.example_zh: 她等著水果長到成熟香甜。

risk.example: Smoking greatly increases the risk of cancer.
risk.example_zh: 吸菸大幅增加罹癌的風險。

risky.example: It was too risky to operate so late at night.
risky.example_zh: 在這麼晚的夜裡動手術風險太大。

ritual.example: Hand washing became a daily ritual on the ward.
ritual.example_zh: 洗手成了病房裡每天的例行儀式。

rival.example: The two clinics were longtime rivals.
rival.example_zh: 這兩間診所是多年的對手。

roam.example: After weeks in bed, she was glad to roam the garden.
roam.example_zh: 臥床數週後，她樂於在花園裡漫步。

roar.example: He let out a roar of pain as the bone was set.
roar.example_zh: 接骨時他痛得大吼一聲。

robe.example: The patient slipped into a clean hospital robe.
robe.example_zh: 病人換上了一件乾淨的病人服。

rocky.example: The road to recovery was long and rocky.

rod.example: A metal rod was placed to support the broken leg.
rod.example_zh: 醫生植入一根金屬棒來支撐斷腿。

role.example: Sleep plays a vital role in healing.
role.example_zh: 睡眠在癒合中扮演關鍵的角色。

roll.example: The nurse helped him roll onto his side.

rollout.example: The company delayed the rollout of its new app until the bugs were fixed.
rollout.example_zh: 公司推遲了新應用程式的首次推出，直到漏洞全部修復為止。

romance.example: Their romance began in the hospital ward.
romance.example_zh: 他們的戀情始於醫院病房。

roof.example: Rain leaked through the old clinic's roof.
roof.example_zh: 雨水從這間舊診所的屋頂滲了進來。

rookie.example: The rookie nurse learned fast on the busy ward.
rookie.example_zh: 這位菜鳥護理師在忙碌的病房裡學得很快。

rope.example: Rescuers used a rope to guide the hiker to safety.
rope.example_zh: 救難人員用繩索引導登山客脫困。

rotate.example: Staff rotate through the night shift each month.

rotation.example: The interns work on a monthly rotation.
rotation.example_zh: 實習醫生以每月輪調的方式工作。

rough.example: A rough, dry patch of skin appeared on his arm.
rough.example_zh: 他手臂上出現一塊粗糙乾燥的皮膚。

roughly.example: The wound was roughly the size of a coin.
roughly.example_zh: 傷口大約有一枚硬幣的大小。

routine.example: The routine checkup covers several tests, including a blood test.
routine.example_zh: 例行檢查包含數項檢驗，包括血液檢查。

routinely.example: Blood pressure is checked routinely at each visit.
routinely.example_zh: 每次就診都會例行測量血壓。

row.example: The pills were lined up in a neat row.

rub.example: Gently rub the cream into the skin.
rub.example_zh: 把藥膏輕輕揉進皮膚裡。

ruin.example: Heavy drinking can ruin the liver.

rule.example: It is a strict rule that visitors wash their hands.
rule.example_zh: 訪客洗手是一條嚴格的規定。

rumor.example: A rumor spread that the clinic would close.
rumor.example_zh: 診所要關閉的謠言傳了開來。

rundown.example: Before the meeting, she gave us a quick rundown of the main points.
rundown.example_zh: 會議前，她向我們簡要說明了主要重點的概要。

rural.example: Rural patients are often isolated from specialist care.
rural.example_zh: 偏鄉病人往往與專科照護隔絕。

rush.example: Patients were rushed to the emergency room.
rush.example_zh: 病患被緊急送往急診室。

sack.example: He carried a sack of rice to the clinic kitchen.
sack.example_zh: 他扛了一袋米到診所廚房。

sacred.example: She proclaimed the duty of care almost sacred.
sacred.example_zh: 她宣稱照護的責任近乎神聖。

sacrifice.example: She made many sacrifices to care for her sick father.
sacrifice.example_zh: 為了照顧生病的父親，她做了許多犧牲。

saddle.example: A bad fall from the saddle broke his collarbone.
saddle.example_zh: 從馬鞍上重重摔下，他摔斷了鎖骨。

safe.example: It is definitely not safe to mix these two drugs.
safe.example_zh: 把這兩種藥混用絕對不安全。

sail.example: After recovering, he was eager to sail again.
sail.example_zh: 康復後，他迫不及待想再次出海。

sake.example: For the sake of your health, please stop smoking.

sale.example: Regulators prohibit the sale of the faulty drug.
sale.example_zh: 主管機關禁止這款瑕疵藥品販售。

salmon.example: Salmon has a favorable effect on heart health.
salmon.example_zh: 鮭魚對心臟健康有正面的影響。

salubrious.example: Patients were sent to a salubrious mountain resort to recover.
salubrious.example_zh: 病人被送往一處有益健康的山區療養地休養。

sample.example: A small sample of tissue was sent for testing.
sample.example_zh: 一小塊組織樣本被送去檢驗。

sanction.example: Strong sanctions were placed on the unsafe clinic.
sanction.example_zh: 這間不安全的診所受到嚴厲的處分。

sanctuary.example: The quiet ward was a sanctuary from the noise.
sanctuary.example_zh: 安靜的病房是逃離喧囂的避風港。

sandy.example: He twisted his ankle on the soft, sandy path.
sandy.example_zh: 他在鬆軟的沙地小徑上扭傷了腳踝。

sanitation.example: Poor sanitation in crowded camps allowed the disease to spread rapidly.
sanitation.example_zh: 擁擠營區裡惡劣的衛生條件，讓疾病迅速蔓延。

sarcastic.example: His sarcastic remark hurt the new intern.
sarcastic.example_zh: 他諷刺的話傷了那位新來的實習生。

satellite.example: A satellite clinic serves the nearby villages.
satellite.example_zh: 一間附屬診所服務附近的村莊。

satisfaction.example: She felt satisfaction in fulfilling her obligation to every patient.
satisfaction.example_zh: 善盡對每位病人的義務，使她感到滿足。

satisfy.example: The results were enough to satisfy the cautious doctor.
satisfy.example_zh: 這些結果足以讓謹慎的醫生放心。

saturated.example: Too much saturated fat harms the heart.
saturated.example_zh: 過多的飽和脂肪會傷害心臟。

save.example: Quick first aid can save a life.
save.example_zh: 迅速的急救能挽救一條生命。

savory.example: After the bland hospital food, the soup tasted wonderfully savory.
savory.example_zh: 在清淡的醫院餐後，這碗湯嚐起來特別鮮美。

savvy.example: A tech-savvy nurse quickly mastered the hospital's new digital records system.
savvy.example_zh: 一位精通科技的護理師很快就上手了醫院的新數位病歷系統。

scale.example: The nurse weighed the baby on a small scale.
scale.example_zh: 護理師用一台小磅秤幫嬰兒量體重。

scan.example: The scan showed no sign of a tumor.
scan.example_zh: 掃描沒有顯示出腫瘤的跡象。

scandal.example: The press condemned the hospital after the safety scandal.
scandal.example_zh: 安全醜聞爆發後，媒體譴責了這家醫院。

scar.example: The surgery left a thin scar on her arm.
scar.example_zh: 手術在她手臂上留下一道細疤。

scare.example: The strange reading gave the doctor a scare.
scare.example_zh: 這個異常的數值嚇了醫生一跳。

scarf.example: She wrapped a warm scarf around her neck.
scarf.example_zh: 她在脖子上圍了一條溫暖的圍巾。

scatter.example: The pills scattered across the floor when she dropped them.
scatter.example_zh: 她把藥丸掉在地上，散落一地。

scenario.example: Doctors planned for the scenario where the patient might contract an infection.
scenario.example_zh: 醫師為病人可能感染的情況預作準備。

scene.example: Paramedics reached the scene within minutes.
scene.example_zh: 救護人員在幾分鐘內趕到現場。

scent.example: The faint scent of herbs filled the room.
scent.example_zh: 淡淡的草藥香瀰漫了整個房間。

schedule.example: The surgery is scheduled for early Monday morning.
schedule.example_zh: 手術安排在週一一大早。

scheme.example: The clinic joined a free vaccination scheme.
scheme.example_zh: 這間診所加入了一項免費接種計畫。

scholar.example: The old scholar spent his life studying herbs.
scholar.example_zh: 這位老學者畢生研究草藥。

scholarly.example: She wrote a scholarly paper on the disease.
scholarly.example_zh: 她寫了一篇關於這種病的學術論文。

scholarship.example: She won a scholarship to study nursing.
scholarship.example_zh: 她贏得了攻讀護理的獎學金。

school.example: She is studying medicine at a school in Taipei.
school.example_zh: 她在台北一所學校攻讀醫學。

scope.example: The illness was beyond the scope of the small clinic.

score.example_zh: 他在記憶測驗中得分偏低。

scramble.example_zh: 護理師們手忙腳亂地為病人找床位。

scrap.example_zh: 他的盤子裡一點食物都沒剩。

scrape.example_zh: 她膝蓋上有一道小擦傷。

screen.example_zh: 篩檢是及早發現這種疾病的可靠方法。

screw.example_zh: 一根小螺絲把斷骨固定在一起。

scrutinize.example_zh: 委員會將仔細審查臨床試驗數據的每一個細節。

scrutiny.example: Every dose came under careful scrutiny.
scrutiny.example_zh: 每一劑都受到仔細的檢視。

sculpture.example_zh: 醫院花園裡立著一座小雕塑。

seal.example_zh: 緊密的封口能讓傷口敷料保持乾淨。

seasonal.example_zh: 花粉熱是常見的季節性病症。

secondary.example_zh: 這頭痛是高血壓引起的次發症狀。

secret.example_zh: 為病人保密病歷是一項法律義務。

section.example_zh: 報告的最後一節列出了副作用。

sector.example: The public health sector was short of funds.

secular.example: The hospital offered both secular and religious comfort.
secular.example_zh: 醫院同時提供世俗與宗教的慰藉。

secure.example_zh: 牢固的敷料能保護傷口不沾染髒污。

security.example: A sense of security helps patients heal faster.
security.example_zh: 安全感有助於病人更快康復。

segment.example_zh: 只有一小部分病人出現副作用。

seize.example_zh: 醫護人員必須把握時機讓他的心臟恢復跳動。

seldom.example_zh: 即使疼痛，他也很少抱怨。

select.example_zh: 醫生會為你挑選最安全的藥。

selection.example_zh: 這家藥局提供種類繁多的維他命可供選擇。

senator.example_zh: 一位參議員力推增加醫院的經費。

sensation.example_zh: 她的手指有一種刺麻的感覺。

sensible.example_zh: 覺得不舒服時休息是明智的。

sensitive.example_zh: 治療後她的皮膚變得敏感。

separate.example_zh: 把生肉與其他食物分開放。

separately.example_zh: 這兩種藥必須分開服用。

setting.example_zh: 這間診所在平靜友善的環境中提供照護。

shake.example_zh: 他的手因發燒而開始顫抖。

sheet.example_zh: 護理師每天早上更換床單。

shine.example_zh: 一道強光被照進她的眼睛。

shock.example_zh: 病人休克後，醫療團隊立即啟動輸血。

shocked.example_zh: 突如其來的診斷讓她震驚。

shoehorn.example_zh: 編輯硬是把三個主題塞進一篇短文章裡。

shore.example_zh: 她沿著海岸散步，讓思緒沉澱。

shortage.example_zh: 護理人力短缺迫使病房關閉床位。

shortages.example_zh: 人力短缺迫使病房關閉了兩張床。

shove.example_zh: 請別推擠，每個人都會輪到看診。

shower.example_zh: 他幾乎恢復正常，能自己淋浴了。

shrimp.example_zh: 他吃了蝦之後起了疹子。

shrine.example_zh: 村裡的診所附近有一座古老的神龕。

shrink.example_zh: 第一次治療後，腫瘤開始縮小。

shrug.example_zh: 這個問題只引出醫師無奈的一聳肩。

shuttle.example_zh: 一輛免費接駁車載送病人去診所。

shy.example_zh: 害羞的男孩在診所躲在母親身後。

sigh.example_zh: 聽到好消息，她鬆了一口氣。

sight.example_zh: 起初視線模糊，術後她的視力慢慢恢復。

signature.example_zh: 沒有醫生的簽名，這份表格便無效。

significance.example_zh: 初步結果的意義尚不明確。

silence.example_zh: 他以一個小小的安慰手勢打破了沉默。

silly.example_zh: 他忽視這個警訊真是太傻了。

silver.example_zh: 老先生的頭髮已轉為柔和的銀白色。

sin.example: In her eyes, wasting medicine was almost a sin.
sin.example_zh: 在她眼中，浪費藥幾乎是一種罪過。

sink.example: He felt his heart sink at the diagnosis.

sip.example_zh: 吃完藥後她喝了一小口水。

site.example_zh: 注射部位需要特別照護以免感染。

skeptical.example_zh: 他對這種草藥的療效宣稱抱持懷疑。

sketch.example: He drew a quick sketch of where it hurt.
sketch.example_zh: 他快速畫了張圖標出哪裡痛。

skillet.example_zh: 她用一個小煎鍋把清湯熱了一下。

skip.example: Never skip a dose of your antibiotics.
skip.example_zh: 千萬別漏服一劑抗生素。

skirt.example: The new road skirts the old town.

skull.example: The fall left a small crack in his skull.
skull.example_zh: 這次跌倒讓他的頭骨出現一道小裂縫。

slap.example: She gave the newborn a gentle slap to start it breathing.
slap.example_zh: 她輕拍新生兒讓他開始呼吸。

slash.example: The budget cuts will slash the clinic's funding.
slash.example_zh: 預算刪減將大幅砍掉診所的經費。

slaughter.example_zh: 如此多無辜平民慘遭無謂屠殺，震驚了全世界。

slave.example_zh: 他像奴隸般拼命工作以扶養生病的母親。

slice.example_zh: 她只勉強吃了一片吐司的一小部分。

slide.example_zh: 醫生展示了一張受感染細胞的幻燈片。

slight.example_zh: 輕微的傷口很少會致命。

slightly.example: Her temperature was slightly above normal.
slightly.example_zh: 她的體溫略高於正常值。

slim.example_zh: 完全康復的機會很渺茫。

slip.example_zh: 一次在沒看見的障礙物上滑倒，就摔斷了她的髖部。

slogan.example_zh: 這項活動的口號呼籲民眾洗手。

slope.example_zh: 輪椅坡道的斜度很平緩。

slot.example_zh: 護理師把她排進了當天最後一個空檔。

sluggish.example_zh: 吃完豐盛的午餐後，他覺得昏沉遲鈍，幾乎無法專心。

smell.example: A strange smell from the wound worried the nurse.
smell.example_zh: 傷口傳來的怪味讓護理師擔憂。

smoke.example: Years of smoke had blackened his lungs.
smoke.example_zh: 多年的菸燻使他的肺發黑。

smooth.example: Her smooth recovery advanced her discharge date.
smooth.example_zh: 她順利的康復使她的出院日期提前了。

smoothly.example: The operation went smoothly from start to finish.
smoothly.example_zh: 手術從頭到尾都很順利。

snake.example: He was rushed to hospital after a snake bite.
snake.example_zh: 被蛇咬後他被緊急送醫。

snap.example: The dry bone could snap under light pressure.
snap.example_zh: 乾燥易脆的骨頭在輕微的壓力下就可能折斷。

snatch.example: He managed only to snatch a few hours of sleep.
snatch.example_zh: 他只勉強搶到了幾個小時的睡眠。

sneak.example: He tried to sneak chocolate past the nurse.
sneak.example_zh: 他試圖瞞著護理師偷吃巧克力。

sniff.example: She gave the medicine a careful sniff.
sniff.example_zh: 她小心地聞了聞這帖藥。

soak.example_zh: 取下繃帶前先用溫水浸泡。

soap.example: Wash your hands well with soap and water.
soap.example_zh: 用肥皂和水把手洗乾淨。

soar.example_zh: 這款疫苗的需求持續飆升。

soared.example: After the recall, demand for the vaccine soared.
soared.example_zh: 回收事件後，這款疫苗的需求量暴增。

sock.example_zh: 一隻乾淨的襪子套住了包紮好的腳。

sodium.example: Too much sodium in the diet raises blood pressure.
sodium.example_zh: 飲食中鈉含量過高會使血壓升高。

soil.example: The bacteria live naturally in the soil.
soil.example_zh: 這種細菌自然存在於土壤中。

solar.example: Solar panels now power the rural clinic.
solar.example_zh: 太陽能板現在為這間鄉村診所供電。

soldier.example: After recovering, the soldier was eager to resume his duties.
soldier.example_zh: 康復後，這名士兵急著想重返崗位。

sole.example: Rest was the sole treatment she needed.
sole.example_zh: 休息是她唯一需要的治療。

solely.example: Her illness was not caused solely by stress.
solely.example_zh: 她的病不僅僅是壓力造成的。

solo.example_zh: 經過數月的協助，她邁出了第一步自己走的路。

solution.example_zh: 傷口以無菌生理食鹽水溶液清潔。

solve.example: The new test helped solve the mystery illness.
solve.example_zh: 這項新檢查幫助解開了這場神秘的病症。

somewhat.example: She felt somewhat better after the nap.
somewhat.example_zh: 小睡之後她覺得好了一些。

sophisticated.example: The scanner is a sophisticated piece of equipment.
sophisticated.example_zh: 這台掃描儀是一件精密的設備。

soporific.example: The lecture was so soporific that half the class dozed off.
soporific.example_zh: 那場演講太催人入睡，半數的學生都打起了瞌睡。

sort.example_zh: 護理師把藥丸分裝進每日藥盒。

soul.example: Music seemed to lift the patient's weary soul.
soul.example_zh: 音樂似乎振奮了病人疲憊的心靈。

soup.example: A bowl of warm soup was all she wanted.
soup.example_zh: 一碗溫熱的湯是她唯一想要的。

sour.example: The milk had turned sour in the warm room.
sour.example_zh: 牛奶在溫暖的房間裡變酸了。

sovereignty.example: The small nation guarded its sovereignty fiercely.
sovereignty.example_zh: 這個小國堅決捍衛它的主權。

soy.example: He switched to soy milk after the allergy test.
soy.example_zh: 過敏檢查後他改喝豆漿。

space.example: There was barely enough space in the ward for another bed.
space.example_zh: 病房裡幾乎沒有空間再擺一張床。

span.example: The illness covered a span of three long months.
span.example_zh: 這場病橫跨了漫長的三個月。

spare.example: The nurse kept a spare dressing in her pocket.
spare.example_zh: 護理師口袋裡備了一份多餘的敷料。

spark.example: A single spark of hope kept her going.
spark.example_zh: 一絲希望的火花支撐著她繼續走下去。

spasm.example_zh: 腿部突然的肌肉痙攣讓她在半夜驚醒。

spatial.example: The illness affected her spatial awareness.
